1.zh: 起初，　神创造天地。
1.en: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

1.zh: 地是空虚混沌，渊面黑暗；　神的灵运行在水面上。
1.en: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

1.zh: 神说：「要有光」，就有了光。
1.en: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

1.zh: 神看光是好的，就把光暗分开了。
1.en: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

1.zh: 神称光为「昼」，称暗为「夜」。有晚上，有早晨，这是头一日。
1.en: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

1.zh: 神说：「诸水之间要有空气，将水分为上下。」
1.en: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

1.zh: 神就造出空气，将空气以下的水、空气以上的水分开了。事就这样成了。
1.en: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.

1.zh: 神称空气为「天」。有晚上，有早晨，是第二日。
1.en: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

1.zh: 神说：「天下的水要聚在一处，使旱地露出来。」事就这样成了。
1.en: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.

1.zh: 神称旱地为「地」，称水的聚处为「海」。　神看着是好的。
1.en: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.

1.zh: 神说：「地要发生青草和结种子的菜蔬，并结果子的树木，各从其类，果子都包着核。」事就这样成了。
1.en: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.

1.zh: 于是地发生了青草和结种子的菜蔬，各从其类；并结果子的树木，各从其类；果子都包着核。　神看着是好的。
1.en: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

1.zh: 有晚上，有早晨，是第三日。
1.en: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

1.zh: 神说：「天上要有光体，可以分昼夜，作记号，定节令、日子、年岁，
1.en: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;

1.zh: 并要发光在天空，普照在地上。」事就这样成了。
1.en: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.

1.zh: 于是　神造了两个大光，大的管昼，小的管夜，又[造]众星，
1.en: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.

1.zh: 就把这些光摆列在天空，普照在地上，
1.en: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,

1.zh: 管理昼夜，分别明暗。　神看着是好的。
1.en: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

1.zh: 有晚上，有早晨，是第四日。
1.en: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

1.zh: 神说：「水要多多滋生有生命的物；要有雀鸟飞在地面以上，天空之中。」
1.en: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”

1.zh: 神就造出大鱼和水中所滋生各样有生命的动物，各从其类；又造出各样飞鸟，各从其类。　神看着是好的。
1.en: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.

1.zh: 神就赐福给这一切，说：「滋生繁多，充满海中的水；雀鸟也要多生在地上。」
1.en: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

1.zh: 有晚上，有早晨，是第五日。
1.en: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

1.zh: 神说：「地要生出活物来，各从其类；牲畜、昆虫、野兽，各从其类。」事就这样成了。
1.en: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.

1.zh: 于是　神造出野兽，各从其类；牲畜，各从其类；地上一切昆虫，各从其类。　神看着是好的。
1.en: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.

1.zh: 神说：「我们要照着我们的形象、按着我们的样式造人，使他们管理海里的鱼、空中的鸟、地上的牲畜，和全地，并地上所爬的一切昆虫。」
1.en: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”

1.zh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。
1.en: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

1.zh: 神就赐福给他们，又对他们说：「要生养众多，遍满地面，治理这地，也要管理海里的鱼、空中的鸟，和地上各样行动的活物。」
1.en: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”

1.zh: 神说：「看哪，我将遍地上一切结种子的菜蔬和一切树上所结有核的果子全赐给你们作食物。
1.en: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.

1.zh: 至于地上的走兽和空中的飞鸟，并各样爬在地上有生命的物，[我将]青草[赐给]它们作食物。」事就这样成了。
1.en: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.

1.zh: 神看着一切所造的都甚好。有晚上，有早晨，是第六日。
1.en: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.

2.zh: 天地万物都造齐了。
2.en: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.

2.zh: 到第七日，　神造物的工已经完毕，就在第七日歇了他一切的工，安息了。
2.en: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.

2.zh: 神赐福给第七日，定为圣日；因为在这日，　神歇了他一切创造的工，就安息了。
2.en: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.

2.zh: 创造天地的来历，在耶和华　神造天地的日子，乃是这样，
2.en: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.

2.zh: 野地还没有草木，田间的菜蔬还没有长起来；因为耶和华　神还没有降雨在地上，也没有人耕地，
2.en: No plant of the field was yet on the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for the LORD God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,

2.zh: 但有雾气从地上腾，滋润遍地。
2.en: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.

2.zh: 耶和华　神用地上的尘土造人，将生气吹在他鼻孔里，他就成了有灵的活人，[名叫 亚当]。
2.en: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

2.zh: 耶和华　神在东方的伊甸立了一个园子，把所造的人安置在那里。
2.en: The LORD God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

2.zh: 耶和华　神使各样的树从地里长出来，可以悦人的眼目，[其上的果子]好作食物。园子当中又有生命树和分别善恶的树。
2.en: Out of the ground the LORD God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

2.zh: 有河从伊甸流出来，滋润那园子，从那里分为四道：
2.en: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.

2.zh: 第一道名叫比逊，就是环绕哈腓拉全地的。在那里有金子，
2.en: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

2.zh: 并且那地的金子是好的；在那里又有珍珠和红玛瑙。
2.en: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.

2.zh: 第二道河名叫基训，就是环绕古实全地的。
2.en: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.

2.zh: 第三道河名叫底格里斯，流在亚述的东边。第四道河就是幼发拉底河。
2.en: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.

2.zh: 耶和华　神将那人安置在伊甸园，使他修理，看守。
2.en: The LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

2.zh: 耶和华　神吩咐他说：「园中各样树上的果子，你可以随意吃，
2.en: The LORD God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;

2.zh: 只是分别善恶树上的果子，你不可吃，因为你吃的日子必定死！」
2.en: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”

2.zh: 耶和华　神说：「那人独居不好，我要为他造一个配偶帮助他。」
2.en: The LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”

2.zh: 耶和华　神用土所造成的野地各样走兽和空中各样飞鸟都带到那人面前，看他叫什么。那人怎样叫各样的活物，那就是它的名字。
2.en: Out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.

2.zh: 那人便给一切牲畜和空中飞鸟、野地走兽都起了名；只是那人没有遇见配偶帮助他。
2.en: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.

2.zh: 耶和华　神使他沉睡，他就睡了；于是取下他的一条肋骨，又把肉合起来。
2.en: The LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.

2.zh: 耶和华　神就用那人身上所取的肋骨造成一个女人，领她到那人跟前。
2.en: The LORD God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.

2.zh: 那人说： 这是我骨中的骨， 肉中的肉， 可以称她为「女人」， 因为她是从「男人」身上取出来的。
2.en: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”

2.zh: 因此，人要离开父母，与妻子连合，二人成为一体。
2.en: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

2.zh: 当时夫妻二人赤身露体，并不羞耻。
2.en: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.

3.zh: 耶和华　神所造的，惟有蛇比田野一切的活物更狡猾。蛇对女人说：「　神岂是真说不许你们吃园中所有树上的果子吗？」
3.en: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which the LORD God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden’?”

3.zh: 女人对蛇说：「园中树上的果子，我们可以吃，
3.en: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,

3.zh: 惟有园当中那棵树上的果子，　神曾说：『你们不可吃，也不可摸，免得你们死。』」
3.en: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”

3.zh: 蛇对女人说：「你们不一定死；
3.en: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,

3.zh: 因为　神知道，你们吃的日子眼睛就明亮了，你们便如　神能知道善恶。」
3.en: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”

3.zh: 于是女人见那棵树[的果子]好作食物，也悦人的眼目，且是可喜爱的，能使人有智慧，就摘下果子来吃了，又给她丈夫，她丈夫也吃了。
3.en: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate. Then she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.

3.zh: 他们二人的眼睛就明亮了，才知道自己是赤身露体，便拿无花果树的叶子为自己编做裙子。
3.en: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.

3.zh: 天起了凉风，耶和华　神在园中行走。那人和他妻子听见　神的声音，就藏在园里的树木中，躲避耶和华　神的面。
3.en: They heard the LORD God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.

3.zh: 耶和华　神呼唤那人，对他说：「你在哪里？」
3.en: The LORD God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”

3.zh: 他说：「我在园中听见你的声音，我就害怕；因为我赤身露体，我便藏了。」
3.en: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”

3.zh: 耶和华说：「谁告诉你赤身露体呢？莫非你吃了我吩咐你不可吃的那树上的果子吗？」
3.en: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”

3.zh: 那人说：「你所赐给我、与我同居的女人，她把那树上的果子给我，我就吃了。」
3.en: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”

3.zh: 耶和华　神对女人说：「你做的是什么事呢？」女人说：「那蛇引诱我，我就吃了。」
3.en: The LORD God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

3.zh: 耶和华　神对蛇说： 你既做了这事，就必受咒诅， 比一切的牲畜野兽更甚； 你必用肚子行走， 终身吃土。
3.en: The LORD God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.

3.zh: 我又要叫你和女人彼此为仇； 你的后裔和女人的后裔也彼此为仇。 女人的后裔要伤你的头； 你要伤他的脚跟。
3.en: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”

3.zh: 又对女人说： 我必多多加增你怀胎的苦楚； 你生产儿女必多受苦楚。 你必恋慕你丈夫； 你丈夫必管辖你。
3.en: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”

3.zh: 又对亚当说： 你既听从妻子的话， 吃了我所吩咐你不可吃的那树上的果子， 地必为你的缘故受咒诅； 你必终身劳苦才能从地里得吃的。
3.en: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and have eaten from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for your sake. You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.

3.zh: 地必给你长出荆棘和蒺藜来； 你也要吃田间的菜蔬。
3.en: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.

3.zh: 你必汗流满面才得糊口， 直到你归了土， 因为你是从土而出的。 你本是尘土，仍要归于尘土。
3.en: You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are dust, and you shall return to dust.”

3.zh: 亚当给他妻子起名叫夏娃，因为她是众生之母。
3.en: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.

3.zh: 耶和华　神为亚当和他妻子用皮子做衣服给他们穿。
3.en: The LORD God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.

3.zh: 耶和华　神说：「那人已经与我们相似，能知道善恶；现在恐怕他伸手又摘生命树的果子吃，就永远活着。」
3.en: The LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”

3.zh: 耶和华　神便打发他出伊甸园去，耕种他所自出之土。
3.en: Therefore the LORD God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.

3.zh: 于是把他赶出去了；又在伊甸园的东边安设基路伯和四面转动发火焰的剑，要把守生命树的道路。
3.en: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.

4.zh: 有一日，那人和他妻子夏娃同房，夏娃就怀孕，生了该隐，便说：「耶和华使我得了一个男子。」
4.en: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with the LORD’s help.”

4.zh: 又生了该隐的兄弟亚伯。亚伯是牧羊的；该隐是种地的。
4.en: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

4.zh: 有一日，该隐拿地里的出产为供物献给耶和华；
4.en: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground.

4.zh: 亚伯也将他羊群中头生的和羊的脂油献上。耶和华看中了亚伯和他的供物，
4.en: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. The LORD respected Abel and his offering,

4.zh: 只是看不中该隐和他的供物。该隐就大大地发怒，变了脸色。
4.en: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.

4.zh: 耶和华对该隐说：「你为什么发怒呢？你为什么变了脸色呢？
4.en: The LORD said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?

4.zh: 你若行得好，岂不蒙悦纳？你若行得不好，罪就伏在门前。它必恋慕你，你却要制伏它。」
4.en: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”

4.zh: 该隐与他兄弟亚伯说话；二人正在田间。该隐起来打他兄弟亚伯，把他杀了。
4.en: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.

4.zh: 耶和华对该隐说：「你兄弟亚伯在哪里？」他说：「我不知道！我岂是看守我兄弟的吗？」
4.en: The LORD said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”

4.zh: 耶和华说：「你做了什么事呢？你兄弟的血有声音从地里向我哀告。
4.en: The LORD said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.

4.zh: 地开了口，从你手里接受你兄弟的血。现在你必从这地受咒诅。
4.en: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

4.zh: 你种地，地不再给你效力；你必流离飘荡在地上。」
4.en: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.”

4.zh: 该隐对耶和华说：「我的刑罚太重，过于我所能当的。
4.en: Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.

4.zh: 你如今赶逐我离开这地，以致不见你面；我必流离飘荡在地上，凡遇见我的必杀我。」
4.en: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”

4.zh: 耶和华对他说：「凡杀该隐的，必遭报七倍。」耶和华就给该隐立一个记号，免得人遇见他就杀他。
4.en: The LORD said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” The LORD appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.

4.zh: 于是该隐离开耶和华的面，去住在伊甸东边挪得之地。
4.en: Cain left the LORD’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

4.zh: 该隐与妻子同房，他妻子就怀孕，生了以诺。该隐建造了一座城，就按着他儿子的名将那城叫做以诺。
4.en: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.

4.zh: 以诺生以拿；以拿生米户雅利；米户雅利生玛土撒利；玛土撒利生拉麦。
4.en: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.

4.zh: 拉麦娶了两个妻：一个名叫亚大，一个名叫洗拉。
4.en: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.

4.zh: 亚大生雅八；雅八就是住帐棚、牧养牲畜之人的祖师。
4.en: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.

4.zh: 雅八的兄弟名叫犹八；他是一切弹琴吹箫之人的祖师。
4.en: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.

4.zh: 洗拉又生了土八·该隐；他是打造各样铜铁利器的。土八·该隐的妹子是拿玛。
4.en: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.

4.zh: 拉麦对他两个妻子说： 亚大、洗拉，听我的声音； 拉麦的妻子，细听我的话语： 壮年人伤我，我把他杀了； 少年人损我，我把他害了。
4.en: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.

4.zh: 若杀该隐，遭报七倍， 杀拉麦，必遭报七十七倍。
4.en: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”

4.zh: 亚当又与妻子同房，她就生了一个儿子，起名叫塞特，意思说：「　神另给我立了一个儿子代替亚伯，因为该隐杀了他。」
4.en: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”

4.zh: 塞特也生了一个儿子，起名叫以挪士。那时候，人才求告耶和华的名。
4.en: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on the LORD’s name.

5.zh: 亚当的后代记在下面。（当　神造人的日子，是照着自己的样式造的，
5.en: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

5.zh: 并且造男造女。在他们被造的日子，　神赐福给他们，称他们为「人」。）
5.en: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.

5.zh: 亚当活到一百三十岁，生了一个儿子，形象样式和自己相似，就给他起名叫塞特。
5.en: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

5.zh: 亚当生塞特之后，又在世八百年，并且生儿养女。
5.en: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.

5.zh: 亚当共活了九百三十岁就死了。
5.en: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

5.zh: 塞特活到一百零五岁，生了以挪士。
5.en: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.

5.zh: 塞特生以挪士之后，又活了八百零七年，并且生儿养女。
5.en: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

5.zh: 塞特共活了九百一十二岁就死了。
5.en: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.

5.zh: 以挪士活到九十岁，生了该南。
5.en: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

5.zh: 以挪士生该南之后，又活了八百一十五年，并且生儿养女。
5.en: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

5.zh: 以挪士共活了九百零五岁就死了。
5.en: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

5.zh: 该南活到七十岁，生了玛勒列。
5.en: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.

5.zh: 该南生玛勒列之后，又活了八百四十年，并且生儿养女。
5.en: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters

5.zh: 该南共活了九百一十岁就死了。
5.en: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.

5.zh: 玛勒列活到六十五岁，生了雅列。
5.en: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.

5.zh: 玛勒列生雅列之后，又活了八百三十年，并且生儿养女。
5.en: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

5.zh: 玛勒列共活了八百九十五岁就死了。
5.en: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.

5.zh: 雅列活到一百六十二岁，生了以诺。
5.en: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.

5.zh: 雅列生以诺之后，又活了八百年，并且生儿养女。
5.en: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

5.zh: 雅列共活了九百六十二岁就死了。
5.en: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.

5.zh: 以诺活到六十五岁，生了玛土撒拉。
5.en: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.

5.zh: 以诺生玛土撒拉之后，与　神同行三百年，并且生儿养女。
5.en: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

5.zh: 以诺共活了三百六十五岁。
5.en: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

5.zh: 以诺与　神同行，　神将他取去，他就不在世了。
5.en: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.

5.zh: 玛土撒拉活到一百八十七岁，生了拉麦。
5.en: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.

5.zh: 玛土撒拉生拉麦之后，又活了七百八十二年，并且生儿养女。
5.en: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

5.zh: 玛土撒拉共活了九百六十九岁就死了。
5.en: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

5.zh: 拉麦活到一百八十二岁，生了一个儿子，
5.en: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.

5.zh: 给他起名叫挪亚，说：「这个儿子必为我们的操作和手中的劳苦安慰我们；这操作劳苦是因为耶和华咒诅地。」
5.en: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which the LORD has cursed.”

5.zh: 拉麦生挪亚之后，又活了五百九十五年，并且生儿养女。
5.en: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

5.zh: 拉麦共活了七百七十七岁就死了。
5.en: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

5.zh: 挪亚五百岁生了闪、含、雅弗。
5.en: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

6.zh: 当人在世上多起来、又生女儿的时候，
6.en: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,

6.zh: 神的儿子们看见人的女子美貌，就随意挑选，娶来为妻。
6.en: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.

6.zh: 耶和华说：「人既属乎血气，我的灵就不永远住在他里面；然而他的日子还可到一百二十年。」
6.en: The LORD said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred twenty years.”

6.zh: 那时候有伟人在地上，后来　神的儿子们和人的女子们交合生子；那就是上古英武有名的人。
6.en: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.

6.zh: 耶和华见人在地上罪恶很大，终日所思想的尽都是恶，
6.en: The LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great on the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.

6.zh: 耶和华就后悔造人在地上，心中忧伤。
6.en: The LORD was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.

6.zh: 耶和华说：「我要将所造的人和走兽，并昆虫，以及空中的飞鸟，都从地上除灭，因为我造他们后悔了。」
6.en: The LORD said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky—for I am sorry that I have made them.”

6.zh: 惟有挪亚在耶和华眼前蒙恩。
6.en: But Noah found favor in the LORD’s eyes.

6.zh: 挪亚的后代记在下面。挪亚是个义人，在当时的世代是个完全人。挪亚与　神同行。
6.en: This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.

6.zh: 挪亚生了三个儿子，就是闪、含、雅弗。
6.en: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

6.zh: 世界在　神面前败坏，地上满了强暴。
6.en: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

6.zh: 神观看世界，见是败坏了；凡有血气的人在地上都败坏了行为。
6.en: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.

6.zh: 神就对挪亚说：「凡有血气的人，他的尽头已经来到我面前；因为地上满了他们的强暴，我要把他们和地一并毁灭。
6.en: God said to Noah, “I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.

6.zh: 你要用歌斐木造一只方舟，分一间一间地造，里外抹上松香。
6.en: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.

6.zh: 方舟的造法乃是这样：要长三百肘，宽五十肘，高三十肘。
6.en: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

6.zh: 方舟上边要留透光处，高一肘。方舟的门要开在旁边。方舟要分上、中、下三层。
6.en: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.

6.zh: 看哪，我要使洪水泛滥在地上，毁灭天下；凡地上有血肉、有气息的活物，无一不死。
6.en: I, even I, will bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is on the earth will die.

6.zh: 我却要与你立约；你同你的妻，与儿子儿妇，都要进入方舟。
6.en: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

6.zh: 凡有血肉的活物，每样两个，一公一母，你要带进方舟，好在你那里保全生命。
6.en: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.

6.zh: 飞鸟各从其类，牲畜各从其类，地上的昆虫各从其类，每样两个，要到你那里，好保全生命。
6.en: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive.

6.zh: 你要拿各样食物积蓄起来，好作你和它们的食物。」
6.en: Take with you some of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”

6.zh: 挪亚就这样行。凡　神所吩咐的，他都照样行了。
6.en: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.

7.zh: 耶和华对挪亚说：「你和你的全家都要进入方舟；因为在这世代中，我见你在我面前是义人。
7.en: The LORD said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.

7.zh: 凡洁净的畜类，你要带七公七母；不洁净的畜类，你要带一公一母；
7.en: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

7.zh: 空中的飞鸟也要带七公七母，可以留种，活在全地上；
7.en: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.

7.zh: 因为再过七天，我要降雨在地上四十昼夜，把我所造的各种活物都从地上除灭。」
7.en: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”

7.zh: 挪亚就遵着耶和华所吩咐的行了。
7.en: Noah did everything that the LORD commanded him.

7.zh: 当洪水泛滥在地上的时候，挪亚整六百岁。
7.en: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.

7.zh: 挪亚就同他的妻和儿子儿妇都进入方舟，躲避洪水。
7.en: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.

7.zh: 洁净的畜类和不洁净的畜类，飞鸟并地上一切的昆虫，
7.en: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground

7.zh: 都是一对一对地，有公有母，到挪亚那里进入方舟，正如　神所吩咐挪亚的。
7.en: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

7.zh: 过了那七天，洪水泛滥在地上。
7.en: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.

7.zh: 当挪亚六百岁，二月十七日那一天，大渊的泉源都裂开了，天上的窗户也敞开了，
7.en: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.

7.zh: 四十昼夜降大雨在地上。
7.en: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.

7.zh: 正当那日，挪亚和他三个儿子闪、含、雅弗，并挪亚的妻子和三个儿妇，都进入方舟。
7.en: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—

7.zh: 他们和百兽，各从其类，一切牲畜，各从其类，爬在地上的昆虫，各从其类，一切禽鸟，各从其类，都进入方舟。
7.en: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

7.zh: 凡有血肉、有气息的活物，都一对一对地到挪亚那里，进入方舟。
7.en: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.

7.zh: 凡有血肉进入方舟的，都是有公有母，正如　神所吩咐挪亚的。耶和华就把他关在方舟里头。
7.en: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then the LORD shut him in.

7.zh: 洪水泛滥在地上四十天，水往上长，把方舟从地上漂起。
7.en: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.

7.zh: 水势浩大，在地上大大地往上长，方舟在水面上漂来漂去。
7.en: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.

7.zh: 水势在地上极其浩大，天下的高山都淹没了。
7.en: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.

7.zh: 水势比山高过十五肘，山岭都淹没了。
7.en: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.

7.zh: 凡在地上有血肉的动物，就是飞鸟、牲畜、走兽，和爬在地上的昆虫，以及所有的人，都死了。
7.en: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

7.zh: 凡在旱地上、鼻孔有气息的生灵都死了。
7.en: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.

7.zh: 凡地上各类的活物，连人带牲畜、昆虫，以及空中的飞鸟，都从地上除灭了，只留下挪亚和那些与他同在方舟里的。
7.en: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.

7.zh: 水势浩大，在地上共一百五十天。
7.en: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.

8.zh: 神记念挪亚和挪亚方舟里的一切走兽牲畜。　神叫风吹地，水势渐落。
8.en: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.

8.zh: 渊源和天上的窗户都闭塞了，天上的大雨也止住了。
8.en: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.

8.zh: 水从地上渐退。过了一百五十天，水就渐消。
8.en: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.

8.zh: 七月十七日，方舟停在亚拉腊山上。
8.en: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.

8.zh: 水又渐消，到十月初一日，山顶都现出来了。
8.en: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.

8.zh: 过了四十天，挪亚开了方舟的窗户，
8.en: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,

8.zh: 放出一只乌鸦去；那乌鸦飞来飞去，直到地上的水都干了。
8.en: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.

8.zh: 他又放出一只鸽子去，要看看水从地上退了没有。
8.en: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,

8.zh: 但遍地上都是水，鸽子找不着落脚之地，就回到方舟挪亚那里，挪亚伸手把鸽子接进方舟来。
8.en: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.

8.zh: 他又等了七天，再把鸽子从方舟放出去。
8.en: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.

8.zh: 到了晚上，鸽子回到他那里，嘴里叼着一个新拧下来的橄榄叶子，挪亚就知道地上的水退了。
8.en: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.

8.zh: 他又等了七天，放出鸽子去，鸽子就不再回来了。
8.en: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.

8.zh: 到挪亚六百零一岁，正月初一日，地上的水都干了。挪亚撤去方舟的盖观看，便见地面上干了。
8.en: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.

8.zh: 到了二月二十七日，地就都干了。
8.en: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

8.zh: 神对挪亚说：
8.en: God spoke to Noah, saying,

8.zh: 「你和你的妻子、儿子、儿妇都可以出方舟。
8.en: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.

8.zh: 在你那里凡有血肉的活物，就是飞鸟、牲畜，和一切爬在地上的昆虫，都要带出来，叫它在地上多多滋生，大大兴旺。」
8.en: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly on the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”

8.zh: 于是挪亚和他的妻子、儿子、儿妇都出来了。
8.en: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.

8.zh: 一切走兽、昆虫、飞鸟，和地上所有的动物，各从其类，也都出了方舟。
8.en: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.

8.zh: 挪亚为耶和华筑了一座坛，拿各类洁净的牲畜、飞鸟献在坛上为燔祭。
8.en: Noah built an altar to the LORD, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

8.zh: 耶和华闻那馨香之气，就心里说：「我不再因人的缘故咒诅地（人从小时心里怀着恶念），也不再按着我才行的灭各种的活物了。
8.en: The LORD smelled the pleasant aroma. The LORD said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.

8.zh: 地还存留的时候，稼穑、寒暑、冬夏、昼夜就永不停息了。」
8.en: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”

9.zh: 神赐福给挪亚和他的儿子，对他们说：「你们要生养众多，遍满了地。
9.en: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.

9.zh: 凡地上的走兽和空中的飞鸟都必惊恐，惧怕你们，连地上一切的昆虫并海里一切的鱼都交付你们的手。
9.en: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.

9.zh: 凡活着的动物都可以作你们的食物。这一切我都赐给你们，如同菜蔬一样。
9.en: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.

9.zh: 惟独肉带着血，那就是它的生命，你们不可吃。
9.en: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.

9.zh: 流你们血、害你们命的，无论是兽是人，我必讨他的罪，就是向各人的弟兄也是如此。
9.en: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.

9.zh: 凡流人血的，他的血也必被人所流，因为　神造人是照自己的形象造的。
9.en: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.

9.zh: 你们要生养众多，在地上昌盛繁茂。」
9.en: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly on the earth, and multiply in it.”

9.zh: 神晓谕挪亚和他的儿子说：
9.en: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,

9.zh: 「我与你们和你们的后裔立约，
9.en: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,

9.zh: 并与你们这里的一切活物—就是飞鸟、牲畜、走兽，凡从方舟里出来的活物—立约。
9.en: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.

9.zh: 我与你们立约，凡有血肉的，不再被洪水灭绝，也不再有洪水毁坏地了。」
9.en: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”

9.zh: 神说：「我与你们并你们这里的各样活物所立的永约是有记号的。
9.en: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

9.zh: 我把虹放在云彩中，这就可作我与地立约的记号了。
9.en: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

9.zh: 我使云彩盖地的时候，必有虹现在云彩中，
9.en: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,

9.zh: 我便记念我与你们和各样有血肉的活物所立的约，水就再不泛滥、毁坏一切有血肉的物了。
9.en: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

9.zh: 虹必现在云彩中，我看见，就要记念我与地上各样有血肉的活物所立的永约。」
9.en: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”

9.zh: 神对挪亚说：「这就是我与地上一切有血肉之物立约的记号了。」
9.en: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”

9.zh: 出方舟挪亚的儿子就是闪、含、雅弗。含是迦南的父亲。
9.en: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.

9.zh: 这是挪亚的三个儿子，他们的后裔分散在全地。
9.en: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.

9.zh: 挪亚作起农夫来，栽了一个葡萄园。
9.en: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.

9.zh: 他喝了园中的酒便醉了，在帐棚里赤着身子。
9.en: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.

9.zh: 迦南的父亲含看见他父亲赤身，就到外边告诉他两个弟兄。
9.en: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

9.zh: 于是闪和雅弗拿件衣服搭在肩上，倒退着进去，给他父亲盖上；他们背着脸就看不见父亲的赤身。
9.en: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.

9.zh: 挪亚醒了酒，知道小儿子向他所做的事，
9.en: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.

9.zh: 就说： 迦南当受咒诅， 必给他弟兄作奴仆的奴仆；
9.en: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers.”

9.zh: 又说： 耶和华—闪的　神是应当称颂的！ 愿迦南作闪的奴仆。
9.en: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.

9.zh: 愿　神使雅弗扩张， 使他住在闪的帐棚里； 又愿迦南作他的奴仆。
9.en: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”

9.zh: 洪水以后，挪亚又活了三百五十年。
9.en: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.

9.zh: 挪亚共活了九百五十岁就死了。
9.en: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.

10.zh: 挪亚的儿子闪、含、雅弗的后代记在下面。洪水以后，他们都生了儿子。
10.en: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

10.zh: 雅弗的儿子是歌篾、玛各、玛代、雅完、土巴、米设、提拉。
10.en: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

10.zh: 歌篾的儿子是亚实基拿、利法、陀迦玛。
10.en: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

10.zh: 雅完的儿子是以利沙、他施、基提、多单。
10.en: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

10.zh: 这些人的后裔将各国的地土、海岛分开居住，各随各的方言、宗族立国。
10.en: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

10.zh: 含的儿子是古实、麦西、弗、迦南。
10.en: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

10.zh: 古实的儿子是西巴、哈腓拉、撒弗他、拉玛、撒弗提迦。拉玛的儿子是示巴、底但。
10.en: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.

10.zh: 古实又生宁录，他为世上英雄之首。
10.en: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

10.zh: 他在耶和华面前是个英勇的猎户，所以俗语说：「像宁录在耶和华面前是个英勇的猎户。」
10.en: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD”.

10.zh: 他国的起头是巴别、以力、亚甲、甲尼，都在示拿地。
10.en: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

10.zh: 他从那地出来往亚述去，建造尼尼微、利河伯、迦拉，
10.en: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

10.zh: 和尼尼微、迦拉中间的利鲜，这就是那大城。
10.en: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.

10.zh: 麦西生路低人、亚拿米人、利哈比人、拿弗土希人、
10.en: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

10.zh: 帕斯鲁细人、迦斯路希人、迦斐托人；从迦斐托出来的有非利士人。
10.en: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

10.zh: 迦南生长子西顿，又生赫
10.en: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

10.zh: 和耶布斯人、亚摩利人、革迦撒人、
10.en: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

10.zh: 希未人、亚基人、西尼人、
10.en: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

10.zh: 亚瓦底人、洗玛利人、哈马人，后来迦南的诸族分散了。
10.en: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

10.zh: 迦南的境界是从西顿向基拉耳的路上，直到迦萨，又向所多玛、蛾摩拉、押玛、洗扁的路上，直到拉沙。
10.en: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.

10.zh: 这就是含的后裔，各随他们的宗族、方言，所住的地土、邦国。
10.en: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

10.zh: 雅弗的哥哥闪，是希伯子孙之祖，他也生了儿子。
10.en: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.

10.zh: 闪的儿子是以拦、亚述、亚法撒、路德、亚兰。
10.en: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

10.zh: 亚兰的儿子是乌斯、户勒、基帖、玛施。
10.en: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

10.zh: 亚法撒生沙拉；沙拉生希伯。
10.en: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

10.zh: 希伯生了两个儿子，一个名叫法勒，因为那时人就分地居住；法勒的兄弟名叫约坍。
10.en: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

10.zh: 约坍生亚摩答、沙列、哈萨玛非、耶拉、
10.en: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

10.zh: 哈多兰、乌萨、德拉、
10.en: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

10.zh: 俄巴路、亚比玛利、示巴、
10.en: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

10.zh: 阿斐、哈腓拉、约巴，这都是约坍的儿子。
10.en: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

10.zh: 他们所住的地方是从米沙直到西发东边的山。
10.en: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

10.zh: 这就是闪的子孙，各随他们的宗族、方言，所住的地土、邦国。
10.en: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

10.zh: 这些都是挪亚三个儿子的宗族，各随他们的支派立国。洪水以后，他们在地上分为邦国。
10.en: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these on the earth after the flood.

11.zh: 那时，天下人的口音、言语都是一样。
11.en: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

11.zh: 他们往东边迁移的时候，在示拿地遇见一片平原，就住在那里。
11.en: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.

11.zh: 他们彼此商量说：「来吧！我们要做砖，把砖烧透了。」他们就拿砖当石头，又拿石漆当灰泥。
11.en: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.

11.zh: 他们说：「来吧！我们要建造一座城和一座塔，塔顶通天，为要传扬我们的名，免得我们分散在全地上。」
11.en: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”

11.zh: 耶和华降临，要看看世人所建造的城和塔。
11.en: The LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.

11.zh: 耶和华说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。
11.en: The LORD said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.

11.zh: 我们下去，在那里变乱他们的口音，使他们的言语彼此不通。」
11.en: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

11.zh: 于是耶和华使他们从那里分散在全地上；他们就停工，不造那城了。
11.en: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

11.zh: 因为耶和华在那里变乱天下人的言语，使众人分散在全地上，所以那城名叫巴别。
11.en: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth. From there, the LORD scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.

11.zh: 闪的后代记在下面。洪水以后二年，闪一百岁生了亚法撒。
11.en: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.

11.zh: 闪生亚法撒之后又活了五百年，并且生儿养女。
11.en: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

11.zh: 亚法撒活到三十五岁，生了沙拉。
11.en: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.

11.zh: 亚法撒生沙拉之后又活了四百零三年，并且生儿养女。
11.en: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

11.zh: 沙拉活到三十岁，生了希伯。
11.en: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.

11.zh: 沙拉生希伯之后又活了四百零三年，并且生儿养女。
11.en: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

11.zh: 希伯活到三十四岁，生了法勒。
11.en: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.

11.zh: 希伯生法勒之后又活了四百三十年，并且生儿养女。
11.en: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

11.zh: 法勒活到三十岁，生了拉吴。
11.en: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

11.zh: 法勒生拉吴之后又活了二百零九年，并且生儿养女。
11.en: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

11.zh: 拉吴活到三十二岁，生了西鹿。
11.en: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.

11.zh: 拉吴生西鹿之后又活了二百零七年，并且生儿养女。
11.en: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

11.zh: 西鹿活到三十岁，生了拿鹤。
11.en: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.

11.zh: 西鹿生拿鹤之后又活了二百年，并且生儿养女。
11.en: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

11.zh: 拿鹤活到二十九岁，生了他拉。
11.en: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.

11.zh: 拿鹤生他拉之后又活了一百一十九年，并且生儿养女。
11.en: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

11.zh: 他拉活到七十岁，生了亚伯兰、拿鹤、哈兰。
11.en: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

11.zh: 他拉的后代记在下面。他拉生亚伯兰、拿鹤、哈兰；哈兰生罗得。
11.en: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

11.zh: 哈兰死在他的本地迦勒底的吾珥，在他父亲他拉之先。
11.en: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.

11.zh: 亚伯兰、拿鹤各娶了妻：亚伯兰的妻子名叫撒莱；拿鹤的妻子名叫密迦，是哈兰的女儿；哈兰是密迦和亦迦的父亲。
11.en: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.

11.zh: 撒莱不生育，没有孩子。
11.en: Sarai was barren. She had no child.

11.zh: 他拉带着他儿子亚伯兰和他孙子哈兰的儿子罗得，并他儿妇亚伯兰的妻子撒莱，出了迦勒底的吾珥，要往迦南地去；他们走到哈兰，就住在那里。
11.en: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.

11.zh: 他拉共活了二百零五岁，就死在哈兰。
11.en: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.

12.zh: 耶和华对亚伯兰说：「你要离开本地、本族、父家，往我所要指示你的地去。
12.en: Now the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.

12.zh: 我必叫你成为大国。我必赐福给你，叫你的名为大；你也要叫别人得福。
12.en: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.

12.zh: 为你祝福的，我必赐福与他；那咒诅你的，我必咒诅他。地上的万族都要因你得福。」
12.en: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”

12.zh: 亚伯兰就照着耶和华的吩咐去了；罗得也和他同去。亚伯兰出哈兰的时候年七十五岁。
12.en: So Abram went, as the LORD had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.

12.zh: 亚伯兰将他妻子撒莱和侄儿罗得，连他们在哈兰所积蓄的财物、所得的人口，都带往迦南地去。他们就到了迦南地。
12.en: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.

12.zh: 亚伯兰经过那地，到了示剑地方、摩利橡树那里。那时迦南人住在那地。
12.en: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land.

12.zh: 耶和华向亚伯兰显现，说：「我要把这地赐给你的后裔。」亚伯兰就在那里为向他显现的耶和华筑了一座坛。
12.en: The LORD appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” He built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.

12.zh: 从那里他又迁到伯特利东边的山，支搭帐棚；西边是伯特利，东边是艾。他在那里又为耶和华筑了一座坛，求告耶和华的名。
12.en: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the LORD and called on the LORD’s name.

12.zh: 后来亚伯兰又渐渐迁往南地去。
12.en: Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.

12.zh: 那地遭遇饥荒。因饥荒甚大，亚伯兰就下埃及去，要在那里暂居。
12.en: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.

12.zh: 将近埃及，就对他妻子撒莱说：「我知道你是容貌俊美的妇人。
12.en: When he had come near to enter Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.

12.zh: 埃及人看见你必说：『这是他的妻子』，他们就要杀我，却叫你存活。
12.en: It will happen that when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ They will kill me, but they will save you alive.

12.zh: 求你说，你是我的妹子，使我因你得平安，我的命也因你存活。」
12.en: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”

12.zh: 及至亚伯兰到了埃及，埃及人看见那妇人极其美貌。
12.en: When Abram had come into Egypt, some Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.

12.zh: 法老的臣宰看见了她，就在法老面前夸奖她。那妇人就被带进法老的宫去。
12.en: The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

12.zh: 法老因这妇人就厚待亚伯兰，亚伯兰得了许多牛、羊、骆驼、公驴、母驴、仆婢。
12.en: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.

12.zh: 耶和华因亚伯兰妻子撒莱的缘故，降大灾与法老和他的全家。
12.en: The LORD afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.

12.zh: 法老就召了亚伯兰来，说：「你这向我做的是什么事呢？为什么没有告诉我她是你的妻子？
12.en: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?

12.zh: 为什么说她是你的妹子，以致我把她取来要作我的妻子？现在你的妻子在这里，可以带她走吧。」
12.en: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”

12.zh: 于是法老吩咐人将亚伯兰和他妻子，并他所有的都送走了。
12.en: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.

13.zh: 亚伯兰带着他的妻子与罗得，并一切所有的，都从埃及上南地去。
13.en: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.

13.zh: 亚伯兰的金、银、牲畜极多。
13.en: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.

13.zh: 他从南地渐渐往伯特利去，到了伯特利和艾的中间，就是从前支搭帐棚的地方，
13.en: He went on his journeys from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,

13.zh: 也是他起先筑坛的地方；他又在那里求告耶和华的名。
13.en: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on the LORD’s name.

13.zh: 与亚伯兰同行的罗得也有牛群、羊群、帐棚。
13.en: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.

13.zh: 那地容不下他们；因为他们的财物甚多，使他们不能同居。
13.en: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together; for their possessions were so great that they couldn’t live together.

13.zh: 当时，迦南人与比利洗人在那地居住。亚伯兰的牧人和罗得的牧人相争。
13.en: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.

13.zh: 亚伯兰就对罗得说：「你我不可相争，你的牧人和我的牧人也不可相争，因为我们是骨肉。
13.en: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.

13.zh: 遍地不都在你眼前吗？请你离开我：你向左，我就向右；你向右，我就向左。」
13.en: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”

13.zh: 罗得举目看见约旦河的全平原，直到琐珥，都是滋润的，那地在耶和华未灭所多玛、蛾摩拉以先如同耶和华的园子，也像埃及地。
13.en: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.

13.zh: 于是罗得选择约旦河的全平原，往东迁移；他们就彼此分离了。
13.en: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one another.

13.zh: 亚伯兰住在迦南地，罗得住在平原的城邑，渐渐挪移帐棚，直到所多玛。
13.en: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.

13.zh: 所多玛人在耶和华面前罪大恶极。
13.en: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against the LORD.

13.zh: 罗得离别亚伯兰以后，耶和华对亚伯兰说：「从你所在的地方，你举目向东西南北观看；
13.en: The LORD said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,

13.zh: 凡你所看见的一切地，我都要赐给你和你的后裔，直到永远。
13.en: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.

13.zh: 我也要使你的后裔如同地上的尘沙那样多，人若能数算地上的尘沙才能数算你的后裔。
13.en: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.

13.zh: 你起来，纵横走遍这地，因为我必把这地赐给你。」
13.en: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”

13.zh: 亚伯兰就搬了帐棚，来到希伯 、幔利的橡树那里居住，在那里为耶和华筑了一座坛。
13.en: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to the LORD.

14.zh: 当暗拉非作示拿王，亚略作以拉撒王，基大老玛作以拦王，提达作戈印王的时候，
14.en: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar; Arioch, king of Ellasar; Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; and Tidal, king of Goiim,

14.zh: 他们都攻打所多玛王比拉、蛾摩拉王比沙、押玛王示纳、洗扁王善以别，和比拉王；比拉就是琐珥。
14.en: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom; Birsha, king of Gomorrah; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).

14.zh: 这五王都在西订谷会合；西订谷就是盐海。
14.en: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).

14.zh: 他们已经事奉基大老玛十二年，到十三年就背叛了。
14.en: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

14.zh: 十四年，基大老玛和同盟的王都来在亚特律·加宁，杀败了利乏音人，在哈麦杀败了苏西人，在沙微·基列亭杀败了以米人，
14.en: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

14.zh: 在何利人的西珥山杀败了何利人，一直杀到靠近旷野的伊勒·巴兰。
14.en: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.

14.zh: 他们回到安·密巴，就是加低斯，杀败了亚玛力全地的人，以及住在哈洗逊·他玛的亚摩利人。
14.en: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.

14.zh: 于是所多玛王、蛾摩拉王、押玛王、洗扁王，和比拉王（比拉就是琐珥）都出来，在西订谷摆阵，与他们交战，
14.en: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim

14.zh: 就是与以拦王基大老玛、戈印王提达、示拿王暗拉非、以拉撒王亚略交战；乃是四王与五王交战。
14.en: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.

14.zh: 西订谷有许多石漆坑。所多玛王和蛾摩拉王逃跑，有掉在坑里的，其余的人都往山上逃跑。
14.en: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there. Those who remained fled to the hills.

14.zh: 四王就把所多玛和蛾摩拉所有的财物，并一切的粮食都掳掠去了；
14.en: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.

14.zh: 又把亚伯兰的侄儿罗得和罗得的财物掳掠去了。当时罗得正住在所多玛。
14.en: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

14.zh: 有一个逃出来的人告诉希伯来人亚伯兰；亚伯兰正住在亚摩利人幔利的橡树那里。幔利和以实各并亚乃都是弟兄，曾与亚伯兰联盟。
14.en: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner. They were allies of Abram.

14.zh: 亚伯兰听见他侄儿被掳去，就率领他家里生养的精练壮丁三百一十八人，直追到但，
14.en: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men, born in his house, and pursued as far as Dan.

14.zh: 便在夜间，自己同仆人分队杀败敌人，又追到大马士革左边的何把，
14.en: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

14.zh: 将被掳掠的一切财物夺回来，连他侄儿罗得和他的财物，以及妇女、人民也都夺回来。
14.en: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.

14.zh: 亚伯兰杀败基大老玛和与他同盟的王回来的时候，所多玛王出来，在沙微谷迎接他；沙微谷就是王谷。
14.en: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).

14.zh: 又有撒冷王麦基洗德带着饼和酒出来迎接；他是至高　神的祭司。
14.en: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.

14.zh: 他为亚伯兰祝福，说：「愿天地的主、至高的　神赐福与亚伯兰！
14.en: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth.

14.zh: 至高的　神把敌人交在你手里，是应当称颂的！」亚伯兰就把所得的拿出十分之一来，给麦基洗德。
14.en: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.

14.zh: 所多玛王对亚伯兰说：「你把人口给我，财物你自己拿去吧！」
14.en: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”

14.zh: 亚伯兰对所多玛王说：「我已经向天地的主—至高的　神耶和华起誓：
14.en: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to the LORD, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,

14.zh: 凡是你的东西，就是一根线、一根鞋带，我都不拿，免得你说：『我使亚伯兰富足！』
14.en: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’

14.zh: 只有仆人所吃的，并与我同行的亚乃、以实各、幔利所应得的分，可以任凭他们拿去。」
14.en: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”

15.zh: 这事以后，耶和华在异象中有话对亚伯兰说：「亚伯兰，你不要惧怕！我是你的盾牌，必大大地赏赐你。」
15.en: After these things the LORD’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”

15.zh: 亚伯兰说：「主耶和华啊，我既无子，你还赐我什么呢？并且要承受我家业的是大马士革人以利以谢。」
15.en: Abram said, “Lord GOD, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”

15.zh: 亚伯兰又说：「你没有给我儿子；那生在我家中的人就是我的后嗣。」
15.en: Abram said, “Behold, you have given no children to me: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”

15.zh: 耶和华又有话对他说：「这人必不成为你的后嗣；你本身所生的才成为你的后嗣。」
15.en: Behold, the LORD’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”

15.zh: 于是领他走到外边，说：「你向天观看，数算众星，能数得过来吗？」又对他说：「你的后裔将要如此。」
15.en: The LORD brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So your offspring will be.”

15.zh: 亚伯兰信耶和华，耶和华就以此为他的义。
15.en: He believed in the LORD, who credited it to him for righteousness.

15.zh: 耶和华又对他说：「我是耶和华，曾领你出了迦勒底的吾珥，为要将这地赐你为业。」
15.en: He said to Abram, “I am the LORD who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”

15.zh: 亚伯兰说：「主耶和华啊，我怎能知道必得这地为业呢？」
15.en: He said, “Lord GOD, how will I know that I will inherit it?”

15.zh: 他说：「你为我取一只三年的母牛，一只三年的母山羊，一只三年的公绵羊，一只斑鸠，一只雏鸽。」
15.en: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”

15.zh: 亚伯兰就取了这些来，每样劈开，分成两半，一半对着一半地摆列，只有鸟没有劈开。
15.en: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.

15.zh: 有鸷鸟下来，落在那死畜的肉上，亚伯兰就把它吓飞了。
15.en: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.

15.zh: 日头正落的时候，亚伯兰沉沉地睡了；忽然有惊人的大黑暗落在他身上。
15.en: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.

15.zh: 耶和华对亚伯兰说：「你要的确知道，你的后裔必寄居别人的地，又服事那地的人；那地的人要苦待他们四百年。
15.en: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.

15.zh: 并且他们所要服事的那国，我要惩罚，后来他们必带着许多财物从那里出来。
15.en: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth;

15.zh: 但你要享大寿数，平平安安地归到你列祖那里，被人埋葬。
15.en: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.

15.zh: 到了第四代，他们必回到此地，因为亚摩利人的罪孽还没有满盈。」
15.en: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”

15.zh: 日落天黑，不料有冒烟的炉并烧着的火把从那些肉块中经过。
15.en: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.

15.zh: 当那日，耶和华与亚伯兰立约，说：「我已赐给你的后裔，从埃及河直到幼发拉底大河之地，
15.en: In that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

15.zh: 就是基尼人、基尼洗人、甲摩尼人、
15.en: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,

15.zh: 赫人、比利洗人、利乏音人、
15.en: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,

15.zh: 亚摩利人、迦南人、革迦撒人、耶布斯人之地。」
15.en: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”

16.zh: 亚伯兰的妻子撒莱不给他生儿女。撒莱有一个使女，名叫夏甲，是埃及人。
16.en: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

16.zh: 撒莱对亚伯兰说：「耶和华使我不能生育。求你和我的使女同房，或者我可以因她得孩子。」亚伯兰听从了撒莱的话。
16.en: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, the LORD has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.

16.zh: 于是亚伯兰的妻子撒莱将使女埃及人夏甲给了丈夫为妾；那时亚伯兰在迦南已经住了十年。
16.en: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.

16.zh: 亚伯兰与夏甲同房，夏甲就怀了孕；她见自己有孕，就小看她的主母。
16.en: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

16.zh: 撒莱对亚伯兰说：「我因你受屈。我将我的使女放在你怀中，她见自己有了孕，就小看我。愿耶和华在你我中间判断。」
16.en: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, she despised me. May the LORD judge between me and you.”

16.zh: 亚伯兰对撒莱说：「使女在你手下，你可以随意待她。」撒莱苦待她，她就从撒莱面前逃走了。
16.en: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.

16.zh: 耶和华的使者在旷野书珥路上的水泉旁遇见她，
16.en: The LORD’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.

16.zh: 对她说：「撒莱的使女夏甲，你从哪里来？要往哪里去？」夏甲说：「我从我的主母撒莱面前逃出来。」
16.en: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”

16.zh: 耶和华的使者对她说：「你回到你主母那里，服在她手下」；
16.en: The LORD’s angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”

16.zh: 又说：「我必使你的后裔极其繁多，甚至不可胜数」；
16.en: The LORD’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”

16.zh: 并说：「你如今怀孕要生一个儿子，可以给他起名叫以实玛利，因为耶和华听见了你的苦情。
16.en: The LORD’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because the LORD has heard your affliction.

16.zh: 他为人必像野驴。他的手要攻打人，人的手也要攻打他；他必住在众弟兄的东边。」
16.en: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposed to all of his brothers.”

16.zh: 夏甲就称那对她说话的耶和华为「看顾人的　神」。因而说：「在这里我也看见那看顾我的吗？」
16.en: She called the name of the LORD who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”

16.zh: 所以这井名叫庇耳·拉海·莱。这井正在加低斯和巴列中间。
16.en: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

16.zh: 后来夏甲给亚伯兰生了一个儿子；亚伯兰给他起名叫以实玛利。
16.en: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.

16.zh: 夏甲给亚伯兰生以实玛利的时候，亚伯兰年八十六岁。
16.en: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.

17.zh: 亚伯兰年九十九岁的时候，耶和华向他显现，对他说：「我是全能的　神。你当在我面前作完全人，
17.en: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and be blameless.

17.zh: 我就与你立约，使你[的后裔]极其繁多。」
17.en: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”

17.zh: 亚伯兰俯伏在地；　神又对他说：
17.en: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,

17.zh: 「我与你立约：你要作多国的父。
17.en: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.

17.zh: 从此以后，你的名不再叫亚伯兰，要叫亚伯拉罕，因为我已立你作多国的父。
17.en: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.

17.zh: 我必使你[的后裔]极其繁多；国度从你而立，君王从你而出。
17.en: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.

17.zh: 我要与你并你世世代代的后裔坚立我的约，作永远的约，是要作你和你后裔的　神。
17.en: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.

17.zh: 我要将你现在寄居的地，就是迦南全地，赐给你和你的后裔永远为业，我也必作他们的　神。」
17.en: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”

17.zh: 神又对亚伯拉罕说：「你和你的后裔必世世代代遵守我的约。
17.en: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you shall keep my covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.

17.zh: 你们所有的男子都要受割礼；这就是我与你并你的后裔所立的约，是你们所当遵守的。
17.en: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.

17.zh: 你们都要受割礼；这是我与你们立约的证据。
17.en: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.

17.zh: 你们世世代代的男子，无论是家里生的，是在你后裔之外用银子从外人买的，生下来第八日，都要受割礼。
17.en: He who is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring.

17.zh: 你家里生的和你用银子买的，都必须受割礼。这样，我的约就立在你们肉体上作永远的约。
17.en: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

17.zh: 但不受割礼的男子必从民中剪除，因他背了我的约。」
17.en: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”

17.zh: 神又对亚伯拉罕说：「你的妻子撒莱不可再叫撒莱，她的名要叫撒拉。
17.en: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name shall be Sarah.

17.zh: 我必赐福给她，也要使你从她得一个儿子。我要赐福给她，她也要作多国之[母]；必有百姓的君王从她而出。」
17.en: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”

17.zh: 亚伯拉罕就俯伏在地喜笑，心里说：「一百岁的人还能得孩子吗？撒拉已经九十岁了，还能生养吗？」
17.en: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”

17.zh: 亚伯拉罕对　神说：「但愿以实玛利活在你面前。」
17.en: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”

17.zh: 神说：「不然，你妻子撒拉要给你生一个儿子，你要给他起名叫以撒。我要与他坚定所立的约，作他后裔永远的约。
17.en: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.

17.zh: 至于以实玛利，我也应允你：我必赐福给他，使他昌盛，极其繁多。他必生十二个族长；我也要使他成为大国。
17.en: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.

17.zh: 到明年这时节，撒拉必给你生以撒，我要与他坚定所立的约。」
17.en: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”

17.zh: 神和亚伯拉罕说完了话，就离开他上升去了。
17.en: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.

17.zh: 正当那日，亚伯拉罕遵着　神的命，给他的儿子以实玛利和家里的一切男子，无论是在家里生的，是用银子买的，都行了割礼。
17.en: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money: every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.

17.zh: 亚伯拉罕受割礼的时候年九十九岁。
17.en: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

17.zh: 他儿子以实玛利受割礼的时候年十三岁。
17.en: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

17.zh: 正当那日，亚伯拉罕和他儿子以实玛利一同受了割礼。
17.en: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.

17.zh: 家里所有的人，无论是在家里生的，是用银子从外人买的，也都一同受了割礼。
17.en: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

18.zh: 耶和华在幔利橡树那里向亚伯拉罕显现出来。那时正热，亚伯拉罕坐在帐棚门口，
18.en: The LORD appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.

18.zh: 举目观看，见有三个人在对面站着。他一见，就从帐棚门口跑去迎接他们，俯伏在地，
18.en: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood near him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,

18.zh: 说：「我主，我若在你眼前蒙恩，求你不要离开仆人往前去。
18.en: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.

18.zh: 容我拿点水来，你们洗洗脚，在树下歇息歇息。
18.en: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.

18.zh: 我再拿一点饼来，你们可以加添心力，然后往前去。你们既到仆人这里来，理当如此。」他们说：「就照你说的行吧。」
18.en: I will get a piece of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.” They said, “Very well, do as you have said.”

18.zh: 亚伯拉罕急忙进帐棚见撒拉，说：「你速速拿三细亚细面调和做饼。」
18.en: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”

18.zh: 亚伯拉罕又跑到牛群里，牵了一只又嫩又好的牛犊来，交给仆人，仆人急忙预备好了。
18.en: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.

18.zh: 亚伯拉罕又取了奶油和奶，并预备好的牛犊来，摆在他们面前，自己在树下站在旁边，他们就吃了。
18.en: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.

18.zh: 他们问亚伯拉罕说：「你妻子撒拉在哪里？」他说：「在帐棚里。」
18.en: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “There, in the tent.”

18.zh: 三人中有一位说：「到明年这时候，我必要回到你这里；你的妻子撒拉必生一个儿子。」撒拉在那人后边的帐棚门口也听见了这话。
18.en: He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.

18.zh: 亚伯拉罕和撒拉年纪老迈，撒拉的月经已断绝了。
18.en: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.

18.zh: 撒拉心里暗笑，说：「我既已衰败，我主也老迈，岂能有这喜事呢？」
18.en: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”

18.zh: 耶和华对亚伯拉罕说：「撒拉为什么暗笑，说：『我既已年老，果真能生养吗？』
18.en: The LORD said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child when I am old?’

18.zh: 耶和华岂有难成的事吗？到了日期，明年这时候，我必回到你这里，撒拉必生一个儿子。」
18.en: Is anything too hard for the LORD? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes around, and Sarah will have a son.”

18.zh: 撒拉就害怕，不承认，说：「我没有笑。」那位说：「不然，你实在笑了。」
18.en: Then Sarah denied it, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He said, “No, but you did laugh.”

18.zh: 三人就从那里起行，向所多玛观看，亚伯拉罕也与他们同行，要送他们一程。
18.en: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.

18.zh: 耶和华说：「我所要做的事岂可瞒着亚伯拉罕呢？
18.en: The LORD said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,

18.zh: 亚伯拉罕必要成为强大的国；地上的万国都必因他得福。
18.en: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?

18.zh: 我眷顾他，为要叫他吩咐他的众子和他的眷属遵守我的道，秉公行义，使我所应许亚伯拉罕的话都成就了。」
18.en: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of the LORD, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that the LORD may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”

18.zh: 耶和华说：「所多玛和蛾摩拉的罪恶甚重，声闻于我。
18.en: The LORD said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,

18.zh: 我现在要下去，察看他们所行的，果然尽像那达到我耳中的声音一样吗？若是不然，我也必知道。」
18.en: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”

18.zh: 二人转身离开那里，向所多玛去；但亚伯拉罕仍旧站在耶和华面前。
18.en: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.

18.zh: 亚伯拉罕近前来，说：「无论善恶，你都要剿灭吗？
18.en: Abraham came near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?

18.zh: 假若那城里有五十个义人，你还剿灭那地方吗？不为城里这五十个义人饶恕其中的人吗？
18.en: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?

18.zh: 将义人与恶人同杀，将义人与恶人一样看待，这断不是你所行的。审判全地的主岂不行公义吗？」
18.en: May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”

18.zh: 耶和华说：「我若在所多玛城里见有五十个义人，我就为他们的缘故饶恕那地方的众人。」
18.en: The LORD said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”

18.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：「我虽然是灰尘，还敢对主说话。
18.en: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.

18.zh: 假若这五十个义人短了五个，你就因为短了五个毁灭全城吗？」他说：「我在那里若见有四十五个，也不毁灭那城。」
18.en: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He said, “I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there.”

18.zh: 亚伯拉罕又对他说：「假若在那里见有四十个怎么样呢？」他说：「为这四十个的缘故，我也不做这事。」
18.en: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s sake.”

18.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：「求主不要动怒，容我说，假若在那里见有三十个怎么样呢？」他说：「我在那里若见有三十个，我也不做这事。」
18.en: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He said, “I will not do it if I find thirty there.”

18.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：「我还敢对主说话，假若在那里见有二十个怎么样呢？」他说：「为这二十个的缘故，我也不毁灭那城。」
18.en: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”

18.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：「求主不要动怒，我再说这一次，假若在那里见有十个呢？」他说：「为这十个的缘故，我也不毁灭那城。」
18.en: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.”

18.zh: 耶和华与亚伯拉罕说完了话就走了；亚伯拉罕也回到自己的地方去了。
18.en: The LORD went his way as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.

19.zh: 那两个天使晚上到了所多玛；罗得正坐在所多玛城门口，看见他们，就起来迎接，脸伏于地下拜，
19.en: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,

19.zh: 说：「我主啊，请你们到仆人家里洗洗脚，住一夜，清早起来再走。」他们说：「不！我们要在街上过夜。」
19.en: and he said, “See now, my lords, please come into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.” They said, “No, but we will stay in the street all night.”

19.zh: 罗得切切地请他们，他们这才进去，到他屋里。罗得为他们预备筵席，烤无酵饼，他们就吃了。
19.en: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.

19.zh: 他们还没有躺下，所多玛城里各处的人，连老带少，都来围住那房子，
19.en: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.

19.zh: 呼叫罗得说：「今日晚上到你这里来的人在哪里呢？把他们带出来，任我们所为。」
19.en: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”

19.zh: 罗得出来，把门关上，到众人那里，
19.en: Lot went out to them through the door, and shut the door after himself.

19.zh: 说：「众弟兄，请你们不要做这恶事。
19.en: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.

19.zh: 我有两个女儿，还是处女，容我领出来，任凭你们的心愿而行；只是这两个人既然到我舍下，不要向他们做什么。」
19.en: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”

19.zh: 众人说：「退去吧！」又说：「这个人来寄居，还想要作官哪！现在我们要害你比害他们更甚。」众人就向前拥挤罗得，要攻破房门。
19.en: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now we will deal worse with you than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and came near to break the door.

19.zh: 只是那二人伸出手来，将罗得拉进屋去，把门关上，
19.en: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.

19.zh: 并且使门外的人，无论老少，眼都昏迷；他们摸来摸去，总寻不着房门。
19.en: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

19.zh: 二人对罗得说：「你这里还有什么人吗？无论是女婿是儿女，和这城中一切属你的人，你都要将他们从这地方带出去。
19.en: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whomever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:

19.zh: 我们要毁灭这地方；因为城内罪恶的声音在耶和华面前甚大，耶和华差我们来，要毁灭这地方。」
19.en: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown so great before the LORD that the LORD has sent us to destroy it.”

19.zh: 罗得就出去，告诉娶了他女儿的女婿们说：「你们起来离开这地方，因为耶和华要毁灭这城。」他女婿们却以为他说的是戏言。
19.en: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for the LORD will destroy the city!” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.

19.zh: 天明了，天使催逼罗得说：「起来！带着你的妻子和你在这里的两个女儿出去，免得你因这城里的罪恶同被剿灭。」
19.en: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”

19.zh: 但罗得迟延不走。二人因为耶和华怜恤罗得，就拉着他的手和他妻子的手，并他两个女儿的手，把他们领出来，安置在城外；
19.en: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, the LORD being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.

19.zh: 领他们出来以后，就说：「逃命吧！不可回头看，也不可在平原站住。要往山上逃跑，免得你被剿灭。」
19.en: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”

19.zh: 罗得对他们说：「我主啊，不要如此！
19.en: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.

19.zh: 你仆人已经在你眼前蒙恩；你又向我显出莫大的慈爱，救我的性命。我不能逃到山上去，恐怕这灾祸临到我，我便死了。
19.en: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.

19.zh: 看哪，这座城又小又近，容易逃到，这不是一个小的吗？求你容我逃到那里，我的性命就得存活。」
19.en: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”

19.zh: 天使对他说：「这事我也应允你；我不倾覆你所说的这城。
19.en: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.

19.zh: 你要速速地逃到那城；因为你还没有到那里，我不能做什么。」因此那城名叫琐珥。
19.en: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

19.zh: 罗得到了琐珥，日头已经出来了。
19.en: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

19.zh: 当时，耶和华将硫磺与火从天上耶和华那里降与所多玛和蛾摩拉，
19.en: Then the LORD rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from the LORD out of the sky.

19.zh: 把那些城和全平原，并城里所有的居民，连地上生长的，都毁灭了。
19.en: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.

19.zh: 罗得的妻子在后边回头一看，就变成了一根盐柱。
19.en: But Lot’s wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

19.zh: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，到了他从前站在耶和华面前的地方，
19.en: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the LORD.

19.zh: 向所多玛和蛾摩拉与平原的全地观看，不料，那地方烟气上腾，如同烧窑一般。
19.en: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

19.zh: 当　神毁灭平原诸城的时候，他记念亚伯拉罕，正在倾覆罗得所住之城的时候，就打发罗得从倾覆之中出来。
19.en: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.

19.zh: 罗得因为怕住在琐珥，就同他两个女儿从琐珥上去，住在山里；他和两个女儿住在一个洞里。
19.en: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.

19.zh: 大女儿对小女儿说：「我们的父亲老了，地上又无人按着世上的常规进到我们这里。
