19.en: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man on the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.

19.zh: 来！我们可以叫父亲喝酒，与他同寝。这样，我们好从他存留后裔。」
19.en: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”

19.zh: 于是，那夜她们叫父亲喝酒，大女儿就进去和她父亲同寝；她几时躺下，几时起来，父亲都不知道。
19.en: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.

19.zh: 第二天，大女儿对小女儿说：「我昨夜与父亲同寝。今夜我们再叫他喝酒，你可以进去与他同寝。这样，我们好从父亲存留后裔。」
19.en: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let’s make him drink wine again tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”

19.zh: 于是，那夜她们又叫父亲喝酒，小女儿起来与她父亲同寝；她几时躺下，几时起来，父亲都不知道。
19.en: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.

19.zh: 这样，罗得的两个女儿都从她父亲怀了孕。
19.en: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.

19.zh: 大女儿生了儿子，给他起名叫摩押，就是现今摩押人的始祖。
19.en: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.

19.zh: 小女儿也生了儿子，给他起名叫便·亚米，就是现今亚扪人的始祖。
19.en: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.

20.zh: 亚伯拉罕从那里向南地迁去，寄居在加低斯和书珥中间的基拉耳。
20.en: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.

20.zh: 亚伯拉罕称他的妻撒拉为妹子，基拉耳王亚比米勒差人把撒拉取了去。
20.en: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

20.zh: 但夜间，　神来，在梦中对亚比米勒说：「你是个死人哪！因为你取了那女人来；她原是别人的妻子。」
20.en: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man’s wife.”

20.zh: 亚比米勒却还没有亲近撒拉；他说：「主啊，连有义的国，你也要毁灭吗？
20.en: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?

20.zh: 那人岂不是自己对我说『她是我的妹子』吗？就是女人也自己说：『他是我的哥哥。』我做这事是心正手洁的。」
20.en: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister’? She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”

20.zh: 神在梦中对他说：「我知道你做这事是心中正直；我也拦阻了你，免得你得罪我，所以我不容你沾着她。
20.en: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. Therefore I didn’t allow you to touch her.

20.zh: 现在你把这人的妻子归还他；因为他是先知，他要为你祷告，使你存活。你若不归还他，你当知道，你和你所有的人都必要死。」
20.en: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t restore her, know for sure that you will die, you, and all who are yours.”

20.zh: 亚比米勒清早起来，召了众臣仆来，将这些事都说给他们听，他们都甚惧怕。
20.en: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.

20.zh: 亚比米勒召了亚伯拉罕来，对他说：「你怎么向我这样行呢？我在什么事上得罪了你，你竟使我和我国里的人陷在大罪里？你向我行不当行的事了！」
20.en: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”

20.zh: 亚比米勒又对亚伯拉罕说：「你见了什么才做这事呢？」
20.en: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”

20.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：「我以为这地方的人总不惧怕　神，必为我妻子的缘故杀我。
20.en: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’

20.zh: 况且她也实在是我的妹子；她与我是同父异母，后来作了我的妻子。
20.en: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

20.zh: 当　神叫我离开父家、飘流在外的时候，我对她说：『我们无论走到什么地方，你可以对人说：他是我的哥哥；这就是你待我的恩典了。』」
20.en: When God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”

20.zh: 亚比米勒把牛、羊、仆婢赐给亚伯拉罕，又把他的妻子撒拉归还他。
20.en: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.

20.zh: 亚比米勒又说：「看哪，我的地都在你面前，你可以随意居住」；
20.en: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”

20.zh: 又对撒拉说：「我给你哥哥一千银子，作为你在合家人面前遮羞的，你就在众人面前没有不是了。」
20.en: To Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all you are vindicated.”

20.zh: 亚伯拉罕祷告　神，　神就医好了亚比米勒和他的妻子，并他的众女仆，她们便能生育。
20.en: Abraham prayed to God. So God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.

20.zh: 因耶和华为亚伯拉罕的妻子撒拉的缘故，已经使亚比米勒家中的妇人不能生育。
20.en: For the LORD had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.

21.zh: 耶和华按着先前的话眷顾撒拉，便照他所说的给撒拉成就。
21.en: The LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did to Sarah as he had spoken.

21.zh: 当亚伯拉罕年老的时候，撒拉怀了孕；到　神所说的日期，就给亚伯拉罕生了一个儿子。
21.en: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

21.zh: 亚伯拉罕给撒拉所生的儿子起名叫以撒。
21.en: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.

21.zh: 以撒生下来第八日，亚伯拉罕照着　神所吩咐的，给以撒行了割礼。
21.en: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

21.zh: 他儿子以撒生的时候，亚伯拉罕年一百岁。
21.en: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.

21.zh: 撒拉说：「　神使我喜笑，凡听见的必与我一同喜笑」；
21.en: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”

21.zh: 又说：「谁能预先对亚伯拉罕说『撒拉要乳养婴孩』呢？因为在他年老的时候，我给他生了一个儿子。」
21.en: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”

21.zh: 孩子渐长，就断了奶。以撒断奶的日子，亚伯拉罕设摆丰盛的筵席。
21.en: The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

21.zh: 当时，撒拉看见埃及人夏甲给亚伯拉罕所生的儿子戏笑，
21.en: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.

21.zh: 就对亚伯拉罕说：「你把这使女和她儿子赶出去！因为这使女的儿子不可与我的儿子以撒一同承受产业。」
21.en: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this servant and her son! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”

21.zh: 亚伯拉罕因他儿子的缘故很忧愁。
21.en: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.

21.zh: 神对亚伯拉罕说：「你不必为这童子和你的使女忧愁。凡撒拉对你说的话，你都该听从；因为从以撒生的，才要称为你的后裔。
21.en: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.

21.zh: 至于使女的儿子，我也必使他[的后裔]成立一国，因为他是你所生的。」
21.en: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”

21.zh: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，拿饼和一皮袋水，给了夏甲，搭在她的肩上，又把孩子[交给她]，打发她走。夏甲就走了，在别是巴的旷野走迷了路。
21.en: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

21.zh: 皮袋的水用尽了，夏甲就把孩子撇在小树底下，
21.en: The water in the container was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.

21.zh: 自己走开约有一箭之远，相对而坐，说：「我不忍见孩子死」，就相对而坐，放声大哭。
21.en: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat opposite him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.

21.zh: 神听见童子的声音；　神的使者从天上呼叫夏甲说：「夏甲，你为何这样呢？不要害怕，　神已经听见童子的声音了。
21.en: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

21.zh: 起来！把童子抱在怀中，我必使他[的后裔]成为大国。」
21.en: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him with your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”

21.zh: 神使夏甲的眼睛明亮，她就看见一口水井，便去将皮袋盛满了水，给童子喝。
21.en: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the container with water, and gave the boy a drink.

21.zh: 神保佑童子，他就渐长，住在旷野，成了弓箭手。
21.en: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and as he grew up, he became an archer.

21.zh: 他住在巴兰的旷野；他母亲从埃及地给他娶了一个妻子。
21.en: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.

21.zh: 当那时候，亚比米勒同他军长非各对亚伯拉罕说：「凡你所行的事都有　神的保佑。
21.en: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.

21.zh: 我愿你如今在这里指着　神对我起誓，不要欺负我与我的儿子，并我的子孙。我怎样厚待了你，你也要照样厚待我与你所寄居这地的民。」
21.en: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”

21.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：「我情愿起誓。」
21.en: Abraham said, “I will swear.”

21.zh: 从前，亚比米勒的仆人霸占了一口水井，亚伯拉罕为这事指责亚比米勒。
21.en: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

21.zh: 亚比米勒说：「谁做这事，我不知道，你也没有告诉我，今日我才听见了。」
21.en: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.”

21.zh: 亚伯拉罕把羊和牛给了亚比米勒，二人就彼此立约。
21.en: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.

21.zh: 亚伯拉罕把七只母羊羔另放在一处。
21.en: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

21.zh: 亚比米勒问亚伯拉罕说：「你把这七只母羊羔另放在一处，是什么意思呢？」
21.en: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs, which you have set by themselves, mean?”

21.zh: 他说：「你要从我手里受这七只母羊羔，作我挖这口井的证据。」
21.en: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”

21.zh: 所以他给那地方起名叫别是巴，因为他们二人在那里起了誓。
21.en: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.

21.zh: 他们在别是巴立了约，亚比米勒就同他军长非各起身回非利士地去了。
21.en: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

21.zh: 亚伯拉罕在别是巴栽上一棵垂丝柳树，又在那里求告耶和华—永生　神的名。
21.en: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of the LORD, the Everlasting God.

21.zh: 亚伯拉罕在非利士人的地寄居了多日。
21.en: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.

22.zh: 这些事以后，　神要试验亚伯拉罕，就呼叫他说：「亚伯拉罕！」他说：「我在这里。」
22.en: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

22.zh: 神说：「你带着你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，你所爱的以撒，往摩利亚地去，在我所要指示你的山上，把他献为燔祭。」
22.en: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”

22.zh: 亚伯拉罕清早起来，备上驴，带着两个仆人和他儿子以撒，也劈好了燔祭的柴，就起身往　神所指示他的地方去了。
22.en: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.

22.zh: 到了第三日，亚伯拉罕举目远远地看见那地方。
22.en: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.

22.zh: 亚伯拉罕对他的仆人说：「你们和驴在此等候，我与童子往那里去拜一拜，就回到你们这里来。」
22.en: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go over there. We will worship, and come back to you.”

22.zh: 亚伯拉罕把燔祭的柴放在他儿子以撒身上，自己手里拿着火与刀；于是二人同行。
22.en: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.

22.zh: 以撒对他父亲亚伯拉罕说：「父亲哪！」亚伯拉罕说：「我儿，我在这里。」以撒说：「请看，火与柴都有了，但燔祭的羊羔在哪里呢？」
22.en: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”

22.zh: 亚伯拉罕说：「我儿，　神必自己预备作燔祭的羊羔。」于是二人同行。
22.en: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.

22.zh: 他们到了　神所指示的地方，亚伯拉罕在那里筑坛，把柴摆好，捆绑他的儿子以撒，放在坛的柴上。
22.en: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.

22.zh: 亚伯拉罕就伸手拿刀，要杀他的儿子。
22.en: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.

22.zh: 耶和华的使者从天上呼叫他说：「亚伯拉罕！亚伯拉罕！」他说：「我在这里。」
22.en: The LORD’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

22.zh: 天使说：「你不可在这童子身上下手。一点不可害他！现在我知道你是敬畏　神的了；因为你没有将你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，留下不给我。」
22.en: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”

22.zh: 亚伯拉罕举目观看，不料，有一只公羊，两角扣在稠密的小树中，亚伯拉罕就取了那只公羊来，献为燔祭，代替他的儿子。
22.en: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.

22.zh: 亚伯拉罕给那地方起名叫「耶和华以勒」，直到今日人还说：「在耶和华的山上必有预备。」
22.en: Abraham called the name of that place “The LORD Will Provide”. As it is said to this day, “On the LORD’s mountain, it will be provided.”

22.zh: 耶和华的使者第二次从天上呼叫亚伯拉罕说：
22.en: The LORD’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,

22.zh: 「耶和华说：『你既行了这事，不留下你的儿子，就是你独生的儿子，我便指着自己起誓说：
22.en: and said, “‘I have sworn by myself,’ says the LORD, ‘because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,

22.zh: 论福，我必赐大福给你；论子孙，我必叫你的子孙多起来，如同天上的星，海边的沙。你子孙必得着仇敌的城门，
22.en: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.

22.zh: 并且地上万国都必因你的后裔得福，因为你听从了我的话。』」
22.en: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.’”

22.zh: 于是亚伯拉罕回到他仆人那里，他们一同起身往别是巴去，亚伯拉罕就住在别是巴。
22.en: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.

22.zh: 这事以后，有人告诉亚伯拉罕说：「密迦给你兄弟拿鹤生了几个儿子，
22.en: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

22.zh: 长子是乌斯，他的兄弟是布斯和亚兰的父亲基母利，
22.en: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

22.zh: 并基薛、哈琐、必达、益拉、彼土利（彼土利生利百加）。」
22.en: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”

22.zh: 这八个人都是密迦给亚伯拉罕的兄弟拿鹤生的。
22.en: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

22.zh: 拿鹤的妾名叫流玛，生了提八、迦含、他辖，和玛迦。
22.en: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

23.zh: 撒拉享寿一百二十七岁，这是撒拉一生的岁数。
23.en: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.

23.zh: 撒拉死在迦南地的基列·亚巴，就是希伯 。亚伯拉罕为她哀恸哭号。
23.en: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

23.zh: 后来亚伯拉罕从死人面前起来，对赫人说：
23.en: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,

23.zh: 「我在你们中间是外人，是寄居的。求你们在这里给我一块地，我好埋葬我的死人，使她不在我眼前。」
23.en: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”

23.zh: 赫人回答亚伯拉罕说：
23.en: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,

23.zh: 「我主请听。你在我们中间是一位尊大的王子，只管在我们最好的坟地里埋葬你的死人；我们没有一人不容你在他的坟地里埋葬你的死人。」
23.en: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”

23.zh: 亚伯拉罕就起来，向那地的赫人下拜，
23.en: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth.

23.zh: 对他们说：「你们若有意叫我埋葬我的死人，使她不在我眼前，就请听我的话，为我求琐辖的儿子以弗 ；
23.en: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

23.zh: 把田头上那麦比拉洞给我；他可以按着足价卖给我，作我在你们中间的坟地。」
23.en: that he may sell me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him sell it to me among you as a possession for a burial place.”

23.zh: 当时以弗 正坐在赫人中间。于是，赫人以弗 在城门出入的赫人面前对亚伯拉罕说：
23.en: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all who went in at the gate of his city, saying,

23.zh: 「不然，我主请听。我送给你这块田，连田间的洞也送给你，在我同族的人面前都给你，可以埋葬你的死人。」
23.en: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”

23.zh: 亚伯拉罕就在那地的人民面前下拜，
23.en: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.

23.zh: 在他们面前对以弗 说：「你若应允，请听我的话。我要把田价给你，求你收下，我就在那里埋葬我的死人。」
23.en: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”

23.zh: 以弗 回答亚伯拉罕说：
23.en: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

23.zh: 「我主请听。值四百舍客勒银子的一块田，在你我中间还算什么呢？只管埋葬你的死人吧！」
23.en: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”

23.zh: 亚伯拉罕听从了以弗 ，照着他在赫人面前所说的话，把买卖通用的银子平了四百舍客勒给以弗 。
23.en: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.

23.zh: 于是，麦比拉、幔利前、以弗 的那块田和其中的洞，并田间四围的树木，
23.en: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded

23.zh: 都定准归与亚伯拉罕，乃是他在赫人面前并城门出入的人面前买妥的。
23.en: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.

23.zh: 此后，亚伯拉罕把他妻子撒拉埋葬在迦南地幔利前的麦比拉田间的洞里。（幔利就是希伯 ）。
23.en: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.

23.zh: 从此，那块田和田间的洞就借着赫人定准归与亚伯拉罕作坟地。
23.en: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.

24.zh: 亚伯拉罕年纪老迈，向来在一切事上耶和华都赐福给他。
24.en: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. The LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.

24.zh: 亚伯拉罕对管理他全业最老的仆人说：「请你把手放在我大腿底下。
24.en: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.

24.zh: 我要叫你指着耶和华—天地的主起誓，不要为我儿子娶这迦南地中的女子为妻。
24.en: I will make you swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.

24.zh: 你要往我本地本族去，为我的儿子以撒娶一个妻子。」
24.en: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”

24.zh: 仆人对他说：「倘若女子不肯跟我到这地方来，我必须将你的儿子带回你原出之地吗？」
24.en: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”

24.zh: 亚伯拉罕对他说：「你要谨慎，不要带我的儿子回那里去。
24.en: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.

24.zh: 耶和华—天上的主曾带领我离开父家和本族的地，对我说话，向我起誓说：『我要将这地赐给你的后裔。』他必差遣使者在你面前，你就可以从那里为我儿子娶一个妻子。
24.en: The LORD, the God of heaven—who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your offspring—he will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.

24.zh: 倘若女子不肯跟你来，我使你起的誓就与你无干了，只是不可带我的儿子回那里去。」
24.en: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”

24.zh: 仆人就把手放在他主人亚伯拉罕的大腿底下，为这事向他起誓。
24.en: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.

24.zh: 那仆人从他主人的骆驼里取了十匹骆驼，并带些他主人各样的财物，起身往美索不达米亚去，到了拿鹤的城。
24.en: The servant took ten of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.

24.zh: 天将晚，众女子出来打水的时候，他便叫骆驼跪在城外的水井那里。
24.en: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.

24.zh: 他说：「耶和华—我主人亚伯拉罕的　神啊，求你施恩给我主人亚伯拉罕，使我今日遇见好机会。
24.en: He said, “LORD, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

24.zh: 我现今站在井旁，城内居民的女子们正出来打水。
24.en: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.

24.zh: 我向那一个女子说：『请你拿下水瓶来，给我水喝』，她若说：『请喝！我也给你的骆驼喝。』愿那女子就作你所预定给你仆人以撒的妻。这样，我便知道你施恩给我主人了。」
24.en: Let it happen, that the young lady to whom I will say, ‘Please let down your pitcher, that I may drink,’ then she says, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink,’—let her be the one you have appointed for your servant Isaac. By this I will know that you have shown kindness to my master.”

24.zh: 话还没有说完，不料，利百加肩头上扛着水瓶出来。利百加是彼土利所生的；彼土利是亚伯拉罕兄弟拿鹤妻子密迦的儿子。
24.en: Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah came out, who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Nahor, Abraham’s brother, with her pitcher on her shoulder.

24.zh: 那女子容貌极其俊美，还是处女，也未曾有人亲近她。她下到井旁，打满了瓶，又上来。
24.en: The young lady was very beautiful to look at, a virgin. No man had known her. She went down to the spring, filled her pitcher, and came up.

24.zh: 仆人跑上前去迎着她，说：「求你将瓶里的水给我一点喝。」
24.en: The servant ran to meet her, and said, “Please give me a drink, a little water from your pitcher.”

24.zh: 女子说：「我主请喝！」就急忙拿下瓶来，托在手上给他喝。
24.en: She said, “Drink, my lord.” She hurried, and let down her pitcher on her hand, and gave him a drink.

24.zh: 女子给他喝了，就说：「我再为你的骆驼打水，叫骆驼也喝足。」
24.en: When she had finished giving him a drink, she said, “I will also draw for your camels, until they have finished drinking.”

24.zh: 她就急忙把瓶里的水倒在槽里，又跑到井旁打水，就为所有的骆驼打上水来。
24.en: She hurried, and emptied her pitcher into the trough, and ran again to the well to draw, and drew for all his camels.

24.zh: 那人定睛看她，一句话也不说，要晓得耶和华赐他通达的道路没有。
24.en: The man looked steadfastly at her, remaining silent, to know whether the LORD had made his journey prosperous or not.

24.zh: 骆驼喝足了，那人就拿一个金环，重半舍客勒，两个金镯，重十舍客勒，给了那女子，
24.en: As the camels had finished drinking, the man took a golden ring of half a shekel weight, and two bracelets for her hands of ten shekels weight of gold,

24.zh: 说：「请告诉我，你是谁的女儿？你父亲家里有我们住宿的地方没有？」
24.en: and said, “Whose daughter are you? Please tell me. Is there room in your father’s house for us to stay?”

24.zh: 女子说：「我是密迦与拿鹤之子彼土利的女儿」；
24.en: She said to him, “I am the daughter of Bethuel the son of Milcah, whom she bore to Nahor.”

24.zh: 又说：「我们家里足有粮草，也有住宿的地方。」
24.en: She said moreover to him, “We have both straw and feed enough, and room to lodge in.”

24.zh: 那人就低头向耶和华下拜，
24.en: The man bowed his head, and worshiped the LORD.

24.zh: 说：「耶和华—我主人亚伯拉罕的　神是应当称颂的，因他不断地以慈爱诚实待我主人。至于我，耶和华在路上引领我，直走到我主人的兄弟家里。」
24.en: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who has not forsaken his loving kindness and his truth toward my master. As for me, the LORD has led me on the way to the house of my master’s relatives.”

24.zh: 女子跑回去，照着这些话告诉她母亲和她家里的人。
24.en: The young lady ran, and told her mother’s house about these words.

24.zh: 利百加有一个哥哥，名叫拉班，看见金环，又看见金镯在他妹子的手上，并听见他妹子利百加的话，说那人对我如此如此说。拉班就跑出来往井旁去，到那人跟前，见他仍站在骆驼旁边的井旁那里，
24.en: Rebekah had a brother, and his name was Laban. Laban ran out to the man, to the spring.

When he saw the ring, and the bracelets on his sister’s hands, and when he heard the words of Rebekah his sister, saying, “This is what the man said to me,” he came to the man. Behold, he was standing by the camels at the spring.

24.zh: 便对他说：「你这蒙耶和华赐福的，请进来，为什么站在外边？我已经收拾了房屋，也为骆驼预备了地方。」
24.en: He said, “Come in, you blessed of the LORD. Why do you stand outside? For I have prepared the house, and room for the camels.”

24.zh: 那人就进了拉班的家。拉班卸了骆驼，用草料喂上，拿水给那人和跟随的人洗脚；
24.en: The man came into the house, and he unloaded the camels. He gave straw and feed for the camels, and water to wash his feet and the feet of the men who were with him.

24.zh: 把饭摆在他面前，叫他吃，他却说：「我不吃，等我说明白我的事情再吃。」拉班说：「请说。」
24.en: Food was set before him to eat, but he said, “I will not eat until I have told my message.” Laban said, “Speak on.”

24.zh: 他说：「我是亚伯拉罕的仆人。
24.en: He said, “I am Abraham’s servant.

24.zh: 耶和华大大地赐福给我主人，使他昌大，又赐给他羊群、牛群、金银、仆婢、骆驼，和驴。
24.en: The LORD has blessed my master greatly. He has become great. The LORD has given him flocks and herds, silver and gold, male servants and female servants, and camels and donkeys.

24.zh: 我主人的妻子撒拉年老的时候给我主人生了一个儿子；我主人也将一切所有的都给了这个儿子。
24.en: Sarah, my master’s wife, bore a son to my master when she was old. He has given all that he has to him.

24.zh: 我主人叫我起誓说：『你不要为我儿子娶迦南地的女子为妻。
24.en: My master made me swear, saying, ‘You shall not take a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites, in whose land I live,

24.zh: 你要往我父家、我本族那里去，为我的儿子娶一个妻子。』
24.en: but you shall go to my father’s house, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son.’

24.zh: 我对我主人说：『恐怕女子不肯跟我来。』
24.en: I asked my master, ‘What if the woman will not follow me?’

24.zh: 他就说：『我所事奉的耶和华必要差遣他的使者与你同去，叫你的道路通达，你就得以在我父家、我本族那里，给我的儿子娶一个妻子。
24.en: He said to me, ‘The LORD, before whom I walk, will send his angel with you, and prosper your way. You shall take a wife for my son from my relatives, and of my father’s house.

24.zh: 只要你到了我本族那里，我使你起的誓就与你无干。他们若不把女子交给你，我使你起的誓也与你无干。』
24.en: Then you will be clear from my oath, when you come to my relatives. If they don’t give her to you, you shall be clear from my oath.’

24.zh: 「我今日到了井旁，便说：『耶和华—我主人亚伯拉罕的　神啊，愿你叫我所行的道路通达。
24.en: I came today to the spring, and said, ‘The LORD, the God of my master Abraham, if now you do prosper my way which I go—

24.zh: 我如今站在井旁，对哪一个出来打水的女子说：请你把你瓶里的水给我一点喝；
24.en: behold, I am standing by this spring of water. Let it happen, that the maiden who comes out to draw, to whom I will say, “Please give me a little water from your pitcher to drink,”

24.zh: 她若说：你只管喝，我也为你的骆驼打水；愿那女子就作耶和华给我主人儿子所预定的妻。』
24.en: then she tells me, “Drink, and I will also draw for your camels,”—let her be the woman whom the LORD has appointed for my master’s son.’

24.zh: 我心里的话还没有说完，利百加就出来，肩头上扛着水瓶，下到井旁打水。我便对她说：『请你给我水喝。』
24.en: Before I had finished speaking in my heart, behold, Rebekah came out with her pitcher on her shoulder. She went down to the spring, and drew. I said to her, ‘Please let me drink.’

24.zh: 她就急忙从肩头上拿下瓶来，说：『请喝！我也给你的骆驼喝。』我便喝了；她又给我的骆驼喝了。
24.en: She hurried and let down her pitcher from her shoulder, and said, ‘Drink, and I will also give your camels a drink.’ So I drank, and she also gave the camels a drink.

24.zh: 我问她说：『你是谁的女儿？』她说：『我是密迦与拿鹤之子彼土利的女儿。』我就把环子戴在她鼻子上，把镯子戴在她两手上。
24.en: I asked her, and said, ‘Whose daughter are you?’ She said, ‘The daughter of Bethuel, Nahor’s son, whom Milcah bore to him.’ I put the ring on her nose, and the bracelets on her hands.

24.zh: 随后我低头向耶和华下拜，称颂耶和华—我主人亚伯拉罕的　神；因为他引导我走合式的道路，使我得着我主人兄弟的孙女，给我主人的儿子为妻。
24.en: I bowed my head, and worshiped the LORD, and blessed the LORD, the God of my master Abraham, who had led me in the right way to take my master’s brother’s daughter for his son.

24.zh: 现在你们若愿以慈爱诚实待我主人，就告诉我；若不然，也告诉我，使我可以或向左，或向右。」
24.en: Now if you will deal kindly and truly with my master, tell me. If not, tell me, that I may turn to the right hand, or to the left.”

24.zh: 拉班和彼土利回答说：「这事乃出于耶和华，我们不能向你说好说歹。
24.en: Then Laban and Bethuel answered, “The thing proceeds from the LORD. We can’t speak to you bad or good.

24.zh: 看哪，利百加在你面前，可以将她带去，照着耶和华所说的，给你主人的儿子为妻。」
24.en: Behold, Rebekah is before you. Take her, and go, and let her be your master’s son’s wife, as the LORD has spoken.”

24.zh: 亚伯拉罕的仆人听见他们这话，就向耶和华俯伏在地。
24.en: When Abraham’s servant heard their words, he bowed himself down to the earth to the LORD.

24.zh: 当下仆人拿出金器、银器，和衣服送给利百加，又将宝物送给她哥哥和她母亲。
24.en: The servant brought out jewels of silver, and jewels of gold, and clothing, and gave them to Rebekah. He also gave precious things to her brother and her mother.

24.zh: 仆人和跟从他的人吃了喝了，住了一夜。早晨起来，仆人就说：「请打发我回我主人那里去吧。」
24.en: They ate and drank, he and the men who were with him, and stayed all night. They rose up in the morning, and he said, “Send me away to my master.”

24.zh: 利百加的哥哥和她母亲说：「让女子同我们再住几天，至少十天，然后她可以去。」
24.en: Her brother and her mother said, “Let the young lady stay with us a few days, at least ten. After that she will go.”

24.zh: 仆人说：「耶和华既赐给我通达的道路，你们不要耽误我，请打发我走，回我主人那里去吧。」
24.en: He said to them, “Don’t hinder me, since the LORD has prospered my way. Send me away that I may go to my master.”

24.zh: 他们说：「我们把女子叫来问问她」，
24.en: They said, “We will call the young lady, and ask her.”

24.zh: 就叫了利百加来，问她说：「你和这人同去吗？」利百加说：「我去。」
24.en: They called Rebekah, and said to her, “Will you go with this man?” She said, “I will go.”

24.zh: 于是他们打发妹子利百加和她的乳母，同亚伯拉罕的仆人，并跟从仆人的，都走了。
24.en: They sent away Rebekah, their sister, with her nurse, Abraham’s servant, and his men.

24.zh: 他们就给利百加祝福说： 我们的妹子啊，愿你作千万人的母！ 愿你的后裔得着仇敌的城门！
24.en: They blessed Rebekah, and said to her, “Our sister, may you be the mother of thousands of ten thousands, and let your offspring possess the gate of those who hate them.”

24.zh: 利百加和她的使女们起来，骑上骆驼，跟着那仆人，仆人就带着利百加走了。
24.en: Rebekah arose with her ladies. They rode on the camels, and followed the man. The servant took Rebekah, and went his way.

24.zh: 那时，以撒住在南地，刚从庇耳·拉海·莱回来。
24.en: Isaac came from the way of Beer Lahai Roi, for he lived in the land of the South.

24.zh: 天将晚，以撒出来在田间默想，举目一看，见来了些骆驼。
24.en: Isaac went out to meditate in the field at the evening. He lifted up his eyes and looked. Behold, there were camels coming.

24.zh: 利百加举目看见以撒，就急忙下了骆驼，
24.en: Rebekah lifted up her eyes, and when she saw Isaac, she got off the camel.

24.zh: 问那仆人说：「这田间走来迎接我们的是谁？」仆人说：「是我的主人。」利百加就拿帕子蒙上脸。
24.en: She said to the servant, “Who is the man who is walking in the field to meet us?” The servant said, “It is my master.” She took her veil, and covered herself.

24.zh: 仆人就将所办的一切事都告诉以撒。
24.en: The servant told Isaac all the things that he had done.

24.zh: 以撒便领利百加进了他母亲撒拉的帐棚，娶了她为妻，并且爱她。以撒自从他母亲不在了，这才得了安慰。
24.en: Isaac brought her into his mother Sarah’s tent, and took Rebekah, and she became his wife. He loved her. So Isaac was comforted after his mother’s death.

25.zh: 亚伯拉罕又娶了一妻，名叫基土拉。
25.en: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.

25.zh: 基土拉给他生了心兰、约珊、米但、米甸、伊施巴，和书亚。
25.en: She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.

25.zh: 约珊生了示巴和底但。底但的子孙是亚书利族、利都是族，和利乌米族。
25.en: Jokshan became the father of Sheba, and Dedan. The sons of Dedan were Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.

25.zh: 米甸的儿子是以法、以弗、哈诺、亚比大，和以勒大。这都是基土拉的子孙。
25.en: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.

25.zh: 亚伯拉罕将一切所有的都给了以撒。
25.en: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,

25.zh: 亚伯拉罕把财物分给他庶出的众子，趁着自己还在世的时候打发他们离开他的儿子以撒，往东方去。
25.en: but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham’s concubines. While he still lived, he sent them away from Isaac his son, eastward, to the east country.

25.zh: 亚伯拉罕一生的年日是一百七十五岁。
25.en: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.

25.zh: 亚伯拉罕寿高年迈，气绝而死，归到他列祖那里。
25.en: Abraham gave up his spirit, and died at a good old age, an old man, and full of years, and was gathered to his people.

25.zh: 他两个儿子以撒、以实玛利把他埋葬在麦比拉洞里。这洞在幔利前、赫人琐辖的儿子以弗 的田中，
25.en: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is near Mamre,

25.zh: 就是亚伯拉罕向赫人买的那块田。亚伯拉罕和他妻子撒拉都葬在那里。
25.en: the field which Abraham purchased from the children of Heth. Abraham was buried there with Sarah, his wife.

25.zh: 亚伯拉罕死了以后，　神赐福给他的儿子以撒。以撒靠近庇耳·拉海·莱居住。
25.en: After the death of Abraham, God blessed Isaac, his son. Isaac lived by Beer Lahai Roi.

25.zh: 撒拉的使女埃及人夏甲给亚伯拉罕所生的儿子是以实玛利。
25.en: Now this is the history of the generations of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah’s servant, bore to Abraham.

25.zh: 以实玛利儿子们的名字，按着他们的家谱记在下面。以实玛利的长子是尼拜约，又有基达、亚德别、米比衫、
25.en: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to the order of their birth: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth, then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

25.zh: 米施玛、度玛、玛撒、
25.en: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,

25.zh: 哈大、提玛、伊突、拿非施、基底玛。
25.en: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

25.zh: 这是以实玛利众子的名字，照着他们的村庄、营寨，作了十二族的族长。
25.en: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.

25.zh: 以实玛利享寿一百三十七岁，气绝而死，归到他列祖那里。
25.en: These are the years of the life of Ishmael: one hundred thirty-seven years. He gave up his spirit and died, and was gathered to his people.

25.zh: 他子孙的住处在他众弟兄东边，从哈腓拉直到埃及前的书珥，正在亚述的道上。
25.en: They lived from Havilah to Shur that is before Egypt, as you go toward Assyria. He lived opposite all his relatives.

25.zh: 亚伯拉罕的儿子以撒的后代记在下面。亚伯拉罕生以撒。
25.en: This is the history of the generations of Isaac, Abraham’s son. Abraham became the father of Isaac.

25.zh: 以撒娶利百加为妻的时候正四十岁。利百加是巴旦·亚兰地的亚兰人彼土利的女儿，是亚兰人拉班的妹子。
25.en: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Paddan Aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian, to be his wife.

25.zh: 以撒因他妻子不生育，就为她祈求耶和华；耶和华应允他的祈求，他的妻子利百加就怀了孕。
25.en: Isaac entreated the LORD for his wife, because she was barren. The LORD was entreated by him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

25.zh: 孩子们在她腹中彼此相争，她就说：「若是这样，我为什么活着呢？」她就去求问耶和华。
25.en: The children struggled together within her. She said, “If it is like this, why do I live?” She went to inquire of the LORD.

25.zh: 耶和华对她说： 两国在你腹内； 两族要从你身上出来。 这族必强于那族； 将来大的要服事小的。
25.en: The LORD said to her, “Two nations are in your womb. Two peoples will be separated from your body. The one people will be stronger than the other people. The elder will serve the younger.”

25.zh: 生产的日子到了，腹中果然是双子。
25.en: When her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, there were twins in her womb.

25.zh: 先产的身体发红，浑身有毛，如同皮衣，他们就给他起名叫以扫。
25.en: The first came out red all over, like a hairy garment. They named him Esau.

25.zh: 随后又生了以扫的兄弟，手抓住以扫的脚跟，因此给他起名叫雅各。利百加生下两个儿子的时候，以撒年正六十岁。
25.en: After that, his brother came out, and his hand had hold on Esau’s heel. He was named Jacob. Isaac was sixty years old when she bore them.

25.zh: 两个孩子渐渐长大，以扫善于打猎，常在田野；雅各为人安静，常住在帐棚里。
25.en: The boys grew. Esau was a skillful hunter, a man of the field. Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.

25.zh: 以撒爱以扫，因为常吃他的野味；利百加却爱雅各。
25.en: Now Isaac loved Esau, because he ate his venison. Rebekah loved Jacob.

25.zh: 有一天，雅各熬汤，以扫从田野回来累昏了。
25.en: Jacob boiled stew. Esau came in from the field, and he was famished.

25.zh: 以扫对雅各说：「我累昏了，求你把这红[汤]给我喝。」因此以扫又叫以东。
25.en: Esau said to Jacob, “Please feed me with some of that red stew, for I am famished.” Therefore his name was called Edom.

25.zh: 雅各说：「你今日把长子的名分卖给我吧。」
25.en: Jacob said, “First, sell me your birthright.”

25.zh: 以扫说：「我将要死，这长子的名分于我有什么益处呢？」
25.en: Esau said, “Behold, I am about to die. What good is the birthright to me?”

25.zh: 雅各说：「你今日对我起誓吧。」以扫就对他起了誓，把长子的名分卖给雅各。
25.en: Jacob said, “Swear to me first.” He swore to him. He sold his birthright to Jacob.

25.zh: 于是雅各将饼和红豆汤给了以扫，以扫吃了喝了，便起来走了。这就是以扫轻看了他长子的名分。
25.en: Jacob gave Esau bread and lentil stew. He ate and drank, rose up, and went his way. So Esau despised his birthright.

26.zh: 在亚伯拉罕的日子，那地有一次饥荒；这时又有饥荒，以撒就往基拉耳去，到非利士人的王亚比米勒那里。
26.en: There was a famine in the land, in addition to the first famine that was in the days of Abraham. Isaac went to Abimelech king of the Philistines, to Gerar.

26.zh: 耶和华向以撒显现，说：「你不要下埃及去，要住在我所指示你的地。
26.en: The LORD appeared to him, and said, “Don’t go down into Egypt. Live in the land I will tell you about.

26.zh: 你寄居在这地，我必与你同在，赐福给你，因为我要将这些地都赐给你和你的后裔。我必坚定我向你父亚伯拉罕所起的誓。
26.en: Live in this land, and I will be with you, and will bless you. For I will give to you, and to your offspring, all these lands, and I will establish the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.

26.zh: 我要加增你的后裔，像天上的星那样多，又要将这些地都赐给你的后裔。并且地上万国必因你的后裔得福—
26.en: I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and will give all these lands to your offspring. In your offspring all the nations of the earth will be blessed,

26.zh: 都因亚伯拉罕听从我的话，遵守我的吩咐和我的命令、律例、法度。」
26.en: because Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my requirements, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws.”

26.zh: 以撒就住在基拉耳。
26.en: Isaac lived in Gerar.

26.zh: 那地方的人问到他的妻子，他便说：「那是我的妹子。」原来他怕说：「是我的妻子」；[他心里想]：「恐怕这地方的人为利百加的缘故杀我」，因为她容貌俊美。
26.en: The men of the place asked him about his wife. He said, “She is my sister,” for he was afraid to say, “My wife”, lest, he thought, “the men of the place might kill me for Rebekah, because she is beautiful to look at.”

26.zh: 他在那里住了许久。有一天，非利士人的王亚比米勒从窗户里往外观看，见以撒和他的妻子利百加戏玩。
26.en: When he had been there a long time, Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac was caressing Rebekah, his wife.

26.zh: 亚比米勒召了以撒来，对他说：「她实在是你的妻子，你怎么说她是你的妹子？」以撒说：「我心里想，恐怕我因她而死。」
26.en: Abimelech called Isaac, and said, “Behold, surely she is your wife. Why did you say, ‘She is my sister’?” Isaac said to him, “Because I said, ‘Lest I die because of her.’”

26.zh: 亚比米勒说：「你向我们做的是什么事呢？民中险些有人和你的妻同寝，把我们陷在罪里。」
26.en: Abimelech said, “What is this you have done to us? One of the people might easily have lain with your wife, and you would have brought guilt on us!”

26.zh: 于是亚比米勒晓谕众民说：「凡沾着这个人，或是他妻子的，定要把他治死。」
26.en: Abimelech commanded all the people, saying, “He who touches this man or his wife will surely be put to death.”

26.zh: 以撒在那地耕种，那一年有百倍的收成。耶和华赐福给他，
26.en: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. The LORD blessed him.

26.zh: 他就昌大，日增月盛，成了大富户。
26.en: The man grew great, and grew more and more until he became very great.

26.zh: 他有羊群牛群，又有许多仆人，非利士人就嫉妒他。
26.en: He had possessions of flocks, possessions of herds, and a great household. The Philistines envied him.

26.zh: 当他父亲亚伯拉罕在世的日子，他父亲的仆人所挖的井，非利士人全都塞住，填满了土。
26.en: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.

26.zh: 亚比米勒对以撒说：「你离开我们去吧。因为你比我们强盛得多。」
26.en: Abimelech said to Isaac, “Go away from us, for you are much mightier than we.”

26.zh: 以撒就离开那里，在基拉耳谷支搭帐棚，住在那里。
26.en: Isaac departed from there, encamped in the valley of Gerar, and lived there.

26.zh: 当他父亲亚伯拉罕在世之日所挖的水井因非利士人在亚伯拉罕死后塞住了，以撒就重新挖出来，仍照他父亲所叫的叫那些井的名字。
26.en: Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. He called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

26.zh: 以撒的仆人在谷中挖[井]，便得了一口活水井。
26.en: Isaac’s servants dug in the valley, and found there a well of flowing water.

26.zh: 基拉耳的牧人与以撒的牧人争竞，说：「这水是我们的。」以撒就给那井起名叫埃色，因为他们和他相争。
26.en: The herdsmen of Gerar argued with Isaac’s herdsmen, saying, “The water is ours.” So he called the name of the well Esek, because they contended with him.

26.zh: 以撒的仆人又挖了一口井，他们又为这井争竞，因此以撒给这井起名叫西提拿。
26.en: They dug another well, and they argued over that, also. So he called its name Sitnah.

26.zh: 以撒离开那里，又挖了一口井，他们不为这井争竞了，他就给那井起名叫利河伯。他说：「耶和华现在给我们宽阔之地，我们必在这地昌盛。」
26.en: He left that place, and dug another well. They didn’t argue over that one. So he called it Rehoboth. He said, “For now the LORD has made room for us, and we will be fruitful in the land.”

26.zh: 以撒从那里上别是巴去。
26.en: He went up from there to Beersheba.

26.zh: 当夜耶和华向他显现，说：「我是你父亲亚伯拉罕的　神，不要惧怕！因为我与你同在，要赐福给你，并要为我仆人亚伯拉罕的缘故，使你的后裔繁多。」
26.en: The LORD appeared to him the same night, and said, “I am the God of Abraham your father. Don’t be afraid, for I am with you, and will bless you, and multiply your offspring for my servant Abraham’s sake.”

26.zh: 以撒就在那里筑了一座坛，求告耶和华的名，并且支搭帐棚；他的仆人便在那里挖了一口井。
26.en: He built an altar there, and called on the LORD’s name, and pitched his tent there. There Isaac’s servants dug a well.

26.zh: 亚比米勒，同他的朋友亚户撒和他的军长非各，从基拉耳来见以撒。
26.en: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar with Ahuzzath his friend, and Phicol the captain of his army.

26.zh: 以撒对他们说：「你们既然恨我，打发我走了，为什么到我这里来呢？」
26.en: Isaac said to them, “Why have you come to me, since you hate me, and have sent me away from you?”

26.zh: 他们说：「我们明明地看见耶和华与你同在，便说，不如我们两下彼此起誓，彼此立约，
26.en: They said, “We saw plainly that the LORD was with you. We said, ‘Let there now be an oath between us, even between us and you, and let’s make a covenant with you,

26.zh: 使你不害我们，正如我们未曾害你，一味地厚待你，并且打发你平平安安地走。你是蒙耶和华赐福的了。」
26.en: that you will do us no harm, as we have not touched you, and as we have done to you nothing but good, and have sent you away in peace.’ You are now the blessed of the LORD.”

26.zh: 以撒就为他们设摆筵席，他们便吃了喝了。
26.en: He made them a feast, and they ate and drank.

26.zh: 他们清早起来彼此起誓。以撒打发他们走，他们就平平安安地离开他走了。
26.en: They rose up some time in the morning, and swore an oath to one another. Isaac sent them away, and they departed from him in peace.

26.zh: 那一天，以撒的仆人来，将挖井的事告诉他说：「我们得了水了。」
26.en: The same day, Isaac’s servants came, and told him concerning the well which they had dug, and said to him, “We have found water.”

26.zh: 他就给那井起名叫示巴；因此那城叫做别是巴，直到今日。
26.en: He called it “Shibah”. Therefore the name of the city is “Beersheba” to this day.

26.zh: 以扫四十岁的时候娶了赫人比利的女儿犹滴，与赫人以伦的女儿巴实抹为妻。
26.en: When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite.

26.zh: 她们常使以撒和利百加心里愁烦。
26.en: They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.

27.zh: 以撒年老，眼睛昏花，不能看见，就叫了他大儿子以扫来，说：「我儿。」以扫说：「我在这里。」
27.en: When Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, so that he could not see, he called Esau his elder son, and said to him, “My son?” He said to him, “Here I am.”

27.zh: 他说：「我如今老了，不知道哪一天死。
27.en: He said, “See now, I am old. I don’t know the day of my death.

27.zh: 现在拿你的器械，就是箭囊和弓，往田野去为我打猎，
27.en: Now therefore, please take your weapons, your quiver and your bow, and go out to the field, and get me venison.

27.zh: 照我所爱的做成美味，拿来给我吃，使我在未死之先给你祝福。」
27.en: Make me savory food, such as I love, and bring it to me, that I may eat, and that my soul may bless you before I die.”

27.zh: 以撒对他儿子以扫说话，利百加也听见了。以扫往田野去打猎，要得野味带来。
27.en: Rebekah heard when Isaac spoke to Esau his son. Esau went to the field to hunt for venison, and to bring it.

27.zh: 利百加就对她儿子雅各说：「我听见你父亲对你哥哥以扫说：
27.en: Rebekah spoke to Jacob her son, saying, “Behold, I heard your father speak to Esau your brother, saying,

27.zh: 『你去把野兽带来，做成美味给我吃，我好在未死之先，在耶和华面前给你祝福。』
27.en: ‘Bring me venison, and make me savory food, that I may eat, and bless you before the LORD before my death.’

27.zh: 现在，我儿，你要照着我所吩咐你的，听从我的话。
27.en: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice according to that which I command you.

27.zh: 你到羊群里去，给我拿两只肥山羊羔来，我便照你父亲所爱的给他做成美味。
27.en: Go now to the flock and get me two good young goats from there. I will make them savory food for your father, such as he loves.

27.zh: 你拿到你父亲那里给他吃，使他在未死之先给你祝福。」
27.en: You shall bring it to your father, that he may eat, so that he may bless you before his death.”

27.zh: 雅各对他母亲利百加说：「我哥哥以扫浑身是有毛的，我身上是光滑的；
27.en: Jacob said to Rebekah his mother, “Behold, Esau my brother is a hairy man, and I am a smooth man.

27.zh: 倘若我父亲摸着我，必以我为欺哄人的，我就招咒诅，不得祝福。」
27.en: What if my father touches me? I will seem to him as a deceiver, and I would bring a curse on myself, and not a blessing.”

27.zh: 他母亲对他说：「我儿，你招的咒诅归到我身上；你只管听我的话，去把羊羔给我拿来。」
27.en: His mother said to him, “Let your curse be on me, my son. Only obey my voice, and go get them for me.”

27.zh: 他便去拿来，交给他母亲；他母亲就照他父亲所爱的做成美味。
27.en: He went, and got them, and brought them to his mother. His mother made savory food, such as his father loved.

27.zh: 利百加又把家里所存大儿子以扫上好的衣服给她小儿子雅各穿上，
27.en: Rebekah took the good clothes of Esau, her elder son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son.

27.zh: 又用山羊羔皮包在雅各的手上和颈项的光滑处，
27.en: She put the skins of the young goats on his hands, and on the smooth of his neck.

27.zh: 就把所做的美味和饼交在她儿子雅各的手里。
27.en: She gave the savory food and the bread, which she had prepared, into the hand of her son Jacob.

27.zh: 雅各到他父亲那里说：「我父亲！」他说：「我在这里。我儿，你是谁？」
27.en: He came to his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am. Who are you, my son?”

27.zh: 雅各对他父亲说：「我是你的长子以扫；我已照你所吩咐我的行了。请起来坐着，吃我的野味，好给我祝福。」
27.en: Jacob said to his father, “I am Esau your firstborn. I have done what you asked me to do. Please arise, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.”

27.zh: 以撒对他儿子说：「我儿，你如何找得这么快呢？」他说：「因为耶和华—你的　神使我遇见好机会得着的。」
27.en: Isaac said to his son, “How is it that you have found it so quickly, my son?” He said, “Because the LORD your God gave me success.”

27.zh: 以撒对雅各说：「我儿，你近前来，我摸摸你，知道你真是我的儿子以扫不是。」
27.en: Isaac said to Jacob, “Please come near, that I may feel you, my son, whether you are really my son Esau or not.”

27.zh: 雅各就挨近他父亲以撒。以撒摸着他，说：「声音是雅各的声音，手却是以扫的手。」
27.en: Jacob went near to Isaac his father. He felt him, and said, “The voice is Jacob’s voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.”

27.zh: 以撒就辨不出他来；因为他手上有毛，像他哥哥以扫的手一样，就给他祝福；
27.en: He didn’t recognize him, because his hands were hairy, like his brother Esau’s hands. So he blessed him.

27.zh: 又说：「你真是我儿子以扫吗？」他说：「我是。」
27.en: He said, “Are you really my son Esau?” He said, “I am.”

27.zh: 以撒说：「你递给我，我好吃我儿子的野味，给你祝福。」雅各就递给他，他便吃了，又拿酒给他，他也喝了。
27.en: He said, “Bring it near to me, and I will eat of my son’s venison, that my soul may bless you.” He brought it near to him, and he ate. He brought him wine, and he drank.

27.zh: 他父亲以撒对他说：「我儿，你上前来与我亲嘴。」
27.en: His father Isaac said to him, “Come near now, and kiss me, my son.”

27.zh: 他就上前与父亲亲嘴。他父亲一闻他衣服上的香气，就给他祝福，说： 我儿的香气 如同耶和华赐福之田地的香气一样。
27.en: He came near, and kissed him. He smelled the smell of his clothing, and blessed him, and said, “Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a field which the LORD has blessed.

27.zh: 愿　神赐你天上的甘露， 地上的肥土， 并许多五谷新酒。
27.en: God give you of the dew of the sky, of the fatness of the earth, and plenty of grain and new wine.

27.zh: 愿多民事奉你， 多国跪拜你。 愿你作你弟兄的主； 你母亲的儿子向你跪拜。 凡咒诅你的，愿他受咒诅； 为你祝福的，愿他蒙福。
27.en: Let peoples serve you, and nations bow down to you. Be lord over your brothers. Let your mother’s sons bow down to you. Cursed be everyone who curses you. Blessed be everyone who blesses you.”

27.zh: 以撒为雅各祝福已毕，雅各从他父亲那里才出来，他哥哥以扫正打猎回来，
27.en: As soon as Isaac had finished blessing Jacob, and Jacob had just gone out from the presence of Isaac his father, Esau his brother came in from his hunting.

27.zh: 也做了美味，拿来给他父亲，说：「请父亲起来，吃你儿子的野味，好给我祝福。」
27.en: He also made savory food, and brought it to his father. He said to his father, “Let my father arise, and eat of his son’s venison, that your soul may bless me.”

27.zh: 他父亲以撒对他说：「你是谁？」他说：「我是你的长子以扫。」
27.en: Isaac his father said to him, “Who are you?” He said, “I am your son, your firstborn, Esau.”

27.zh: 以撒就大大地战兢，说：「你未来之先，是谁得了野味拿来给我呢？我已经吃了，为他祝福；他将来也必蒙福。」
27.en: Isaac trembled violently, and said, “Who, then, is he who has taken venison, and brought it to me, and I have eaten of all before you came, and have blessed him? Yes, he will be blessed.”

27.zh: 以扫听了他父亲的话，就放声痛哭，说：「我父啊，求你也为我祝福！」
27.en: When Esau heard the words of his father, he cried with an exceedingly great and bitter cry, and said to his father, “Bless me, even me also, my father.”

27.zh: 以撒说：「你兄弟已经用诡计来将你的福分夺去了。」
27.en: He said, “Your brother came with deceit, and has taken away your blessing.”

27.zh: 以扫说：「他名雅各，岂不是正对吗？因为他欺骗了我两次：他从前夺了我长子的名分，你看，他现在又夺了我的福分。」以扫又说：「你没有留下为我可祝的福吗？」
27.en: He said, “Isn’t he rightly named Jacob? For he has supplanted me these two times. He took away my birthright. See, now he has taken away my blessing.” He said, “Haven’t you reserved a blessing for me?”

27.zh: 以撒回答以扫说：「我已立他为你的主，使他的弟兄都给他作仆人，并赐他五谷新酒可以养生。我儿，现在我还能为你做什么呢？」
27.en: Isaac answered Esau, “Behold, I have made him your lord, and all his brothers I have given to him for servants. I have sustained him with grain and new wine. What then will I do for you, my son?”

27.zh: 以扫对他父亲说：「父啊，你只有一样可祝的福吗？我父啊，求你也为我祝福！」以扫就放声而哭。
27.en: Esau said to his father, “Do you have just one blessing, my father? Bless me, even me also, my father.” Esau lifted up his voice, and wept.

27.zh: 他父亲以撒说： 地上的肥土必为你所住； 天上的甘露必为你所得。
27.en: Isaac his father answered him, “Behold, your dwelling will be of the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of the sky from above.

27.zh: 你必倚靠刀剑度日， 又必事奉你的兄弟； 到你强盛的时候， 必从你颈项上挣开他的轭。
27.en: You will live by your sword, and you will serve your brother. It will happen, when you will break loose, that you will shake his yoke from off your neck.”

27.zh: 以扫因他父亲给雅各祝的福，就怨恨雅各，心里说：「为我父亲居丧的日子近了，到那时候，我要杀我的兄弟雅各。」
27.en: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.”

27.zh: 有人把利百加大儿子以扫的话告诉利百加，她就打发人去，叫了她小儿子雅各来，对他说：「你哥哥以扫[想要]杀你，报仇雪恨。
27.en: The words of Esau, her elder son, were told to Rebekah. She sent and called Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, “Behold, your brother Esau comforts himself about you by planning to kill you.

27.zh: 现在，我儿，你要听我的话：起来，逃往哈兰、我哥哥拉班那里去，
27.en: Now therefore, my son, obey my voice. Arise, flee to Laban, my brother, in Haran.

27.zh: 同他住些日子，直等你哥哥的怒气消了。
27.en: Stay with him a few days, until your brother’s fury turns away—

27.zh: 你哥哥向你消了怒气，忘了你向他所做的事，我便打发人去把你从那里带回来。为什么一日丧你们二人呢？」
27.en: until your brother’s anger turns away from you, and he forgets what you have done to him. Then I will send, and get you from there. Why should I be bereaved of you both in one day?”

27.zh: 利百加对以撒说：「我因这赫人的女子连性命都厌烦了；倘若雅各也娶赫人的女子为妻，像这些一样，我活着还有什么益处呢？」
27.en: Rebekah said to Isaac, “I am weary of my life because of the daughters of Heth. If Jacob takes a wife of the daughters of Heth, such as these, of the daughters of the land, what good will my life do me?”

28.zh: 以撒叫了雅各来，给他祝福，并嘱咐他说：「你不要娶迦南的女子为妻。
28.en: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.

28.zh: 你起身往巴旦·亚兰去，到你外祖彼土利家里，在你母舅拉班的女儿中娶一女为妻。
28.en: Arise, go to Paddan Aram, to the house of Bethuel your mother’s father. Take a wife from there from the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.

28.zh: 愿全能的　神赐福给你，使你生养众多，成为多族，
28.en: May God Almighty bless you, and make you fruitful, and multiply you, that you may be a company of peoples,

28.zh: 将应许亚伯拉罕的福赐给你和你的后裔，使你承受你所寄居的地为业，就是　神赐给亚伯拉罕的地。」
28.en: and give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your offspring with you, that you may inherit the land where you travel, which God gave to Abraham.”

28.zh: 以撒打发雅各走了，他就往巴旦·亚兰去，到亚兰人彼土利的儿子拉班那里。拉班是雅各、以扫的母舅。
28.en: Isaac sent Jacob away. He went to Paddan Aram to Laban, son of Bethuel the Syrian, the brother of Rebekah, Jacob’s and Esau’s mother.

28.zh: 以扫见以撒已经给雅各祝福，而且打发他往巴旦·亚兰去，在那里娶妻，并见祝福的时候嘱咐他说：「不要娶迦南的女子为妻」，
28.en: Now Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him away to Paddan Aram, to take him a wife from there, and that as he blessed him he gave him a command, saying, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan;”

28.zh: 又见雅各听从父母的话往巴旦·亚兰去了，
28.en: and that Jacob obeyed his father and his mother, and was gone to Paddan Aram.

28.zh: 以扫就晓得他父亲以撒看不中迦南的女子，
28.en: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.

28.zh: 便往以实玛利那里去，在他二妻之外又娶了玛哈拉为妻。她是亚伯拉罕儿子以实玛利的女儿，尼拜约的妹子。
28.en: So Esau went to Ishmael, and took, in addition to the wives that he had, Mahalath the daughter of Ishmael, Abraham’s son, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife.

28.zh: 雅各出了别是巴，向哈兰走去；
28.en: Jacob went out from Beersheba, and went toward Haran.

28.zh: 到了一个地方，因为太阳落了，就在那里住宿，便拾起那地方的一块石头枕在头下，在那里躺卧睡了，
28.en: He came to a certain place, and stayed there all night, because the sun had set. He took one of the stones of the place, and put it under his head, and lay down in that place to sleep.

28.zh: 梦见一个梯子立在地上，梯子的头顶着天，有　神的使者在梯子上，上去下来。
28.en: He dreamed and saw a stairway set upon the earth, and its top reached to heaven. Behold, the angels of God were ascending and descending on it.

28.zh: 耶和华站在梯子以上，说：「我是耶和华—你祖亚伯拉罕的　神，也是以撒的　神；我要将你现在所躺卧之地赐给你和你的后裔。
28.en: Behold, the LORD stood above it, and said, “I am the LORD, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will give the land you lie on to you and to your offspring.

28.zh: 你的后裔必像地上的尘沙那样多，必向东西南北开展；地上万族必因你和你的后裔得福。
28.en: Your offspring will be as the dust of the earth, and you will spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south. In you and in your offspring, all the families of the earth will be blessed.

28.zh: 我也与你同在。你无论往哪里去，我必保佑你，领你归回这地，总不离弃你，直到我成全了向你所应许的。」
28.en: Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of to you.”

28.zh: 雅各睡醒了，说：「耶和华真在这里，我竟不知道！」
28.en: Jacob awakened out of his sleep, and he said, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I didn’t know it.”

28.zh: 就惧怕，说：「这地方何等可畏！这不是别的，乃是　神的殿，也是天的门。」
28.en: He was afraid, and said, “How awesome this place is! This is none other than God’s house, and this is the gate of heaven.”

28.zh: 雅各清早起来，把所枕的石头立作柱子，浇油在上面。
28.en: Jacob rose up early in the morning, and took the stone that he had put under his head, and set it up for a pillar, and poured oil on its top.

28.zh: 他就给那地方起名叫伯特利；但那地方起先名叫路斯。
28.en: He called the name of that place Bethel, but the name of the city was Luz at the first.

28.zh: 雅各许愿说：「　神若与我同在，在我所行的路上保佑我，又给我食物吃，衣服穿，
28.en: Jacob vowed a vow, saying, “If God will be with me, and will keep me in this way that I go, and will give me bread to eat, and clothing to put on,

28.zh: 使我平平安安地回到我父亲的家，我就必以耶和华为我的　神。
28.en: so that I come again to my father’s house in peace, and the LORD will be my God,

28.zh: 我所立为柱子的石头也必作　神的殿；凡你所赐给我的，我必将十分之一献给你。」
28.en: then this stone, which I have set up for a pillar, will be God’s house. Of all that you will give me I will surely give a tenth to you.”

29.zh: 雅各起行，到了东方人之地，
29.en: Then Jacob went on his journey, and came to the land of the children of the east.

29.zh: 看见田间有一口井，有三群羊卧在井旁；因为人饮羊群都是用那井里的水。井口上的石头是大的。
29.en: He looked, and saw a well in the field, and saw three flocks of sheep lying there by it. For out of that well they watered the flocks. The stone on the well’s mouth was large.

29.zh: 常有羊群在那里聚集，牧人把石头转离井口饮羊，随后又把石头放在井口的原处。
29.en: There all the flocks were gathered. They rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the sheep, and put the stone back on the well’s mouth in its place.

29.zh: 雅各对牧人说：「弟兄们，你们是哪里来的？」他们说：「我们是哈兰来的。」
29.en: Jacob said to them, “My relatives, where are you from?” They said, “We are from Haran.”

29.zh: 他问他们说：「拿鹤的孙子拉班，你们认识吗？」他们说：「我们认识。」
29.en: He said to them, “Do you know Laban, the son of Nahor?” They said, “We know him.”

29.zh: 雅各说：「他平安吗？」他们说：「平安。看哪，他女儿拉结领着羊来了。」
29.en: He said to them, “Is it well with him?” They said, “It is well. See, Rachel, his daughter, is coming with the sheep.”

29.zh: 雅各说：「日头还高，不是羊群聚集的时候，你们不如饮羊，再去放一放。」
29.en: He said, “Behold, it is still the middle of the day, not time to gather the livestock together. Water the sheep, and go and feed them.”

29.zh: 他们说：「我们不能，必等羊群聚齐，人把石头转离井口才可饮羊。」
29.en: They said, “We can’t, until all the flocks are gathered together, and they roll the stone from the well’s mouth. Then we will water the sheep.”

29.zh: 雅各正和他们说话的时候，拉结领着她父亲的羊来了，因为那些羊是她牧放的。
29.en: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.

29.zh: 雅各看见母舅拉班的女儿拉结和母舅拉班的羊群，就上前把石头转离井口，饮他母舅拉班的羊群。
29.en: When Jacob saw Rachel the daughter of Laban, his mother’s brother, and the sheep of Laban, his mother’s brother, Jacob went near, and rolled the stone from the well’s mouth, and watered the flock of Laban his mother’s brother.

29.zh: 雅各与拉结亲嘴，就放声而哭。
29.en: Jacob kissed Rachel, and lifted up his voice, and wept.

29.zh: 雅各告诉拉结，自己是她父亲的外甥，是利百加的儿子，拉结就跑去告诉她父亲。
29.en: Jacob told Rachel that he was her father’s relative, and that he was Rebekah’s son. She ran and told her father.

29.zh: 拉班听见外甥雅各的信息，就跑去迎接，抱着他，与他亲嘴，领他到自己的家。雅各将一切的情由告诉拉班。
29.en: When Laban heard the news of Jacob, his sister’s son, he ran to meet Jacob, and embraced him, and kissed him, and brought him to his house. Jacob told Laban all these things.

29.zh: 拉班对他说：「你实在是我的骨肉。」雅各就和他同住了一个月。
29.en: Laban said to him, “Surely you are my bone and my flesh.” Jacob stayed with him for a month.

29.zh: 拉班对雅各说：「你虽是我的骨肉，岂可白白地服事我？请告诉我，你要什么为工价？」
29.en: Laban said to Jacob, “Because you are my relative, should you therefore serve me for nothing? Tell me, what will your wages be?”

29.zh: 拉班有两个女儿，大的名叫利亚，小的名叫拉结。
29.en: Laban had two daughters. The name of the elder was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.

29.zh: 利亚的眼睛没有神气，拉结却生得美貌俊秀。
29.en: Leah’s eyes were weak, but Rachel was beautiful in form and attractive.

29.zh: 雅各爱拉结，就说：「我愿为你小女儿拉结服事你七年。」
29.en: Jacob loved Rachel. He said, “I will serve you seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.”

29.zh: 拉班说：「我把她给你，胜似给别人，你与我同住吧！」
29.en: Laban said, “It is better that I give her to you, than that I should give her to another man. Stay with me.”

29.zh: 雅各就为拉结服事了七年；他因为深爱拉结，就看这七年如同几天。
29.en: Jacob served seven years for Rachel. They seemed to him but a few days, for the love he had for her.

29.zh: 雅各对拉班说：「日期已经满了，求你把我的妻子给我，我好与她同房。」
29.en: Jacob said to Laban, “Give me my wife, for my days are fulfilled, that I may go in to her.”

29.zh: 拉班就摆设筵席，请齐了那地方的众人。
29.en: Laban gathered together all the men of the place, and made a feast.

29.zh: 到晚上，拉班将女儿利亚送来给雅各，雅各就与她同房。
29.en: In the evening, he took Leah his daughter, and brought her to Jacob. He went in to her.

29.zh: 拉班又将婢女悉帕给女儿利亚作使女。
29.en: Laban gave Zilpah his servant to his daughter Leah for a servant.

29.zh: 到了早晨，雅各一看是利亚，就对拉班说：「你向我做的是什么事呢？我服事你，不是为拉结吗？你为什么欺哄我呢？」
29.en: In the morning, behold, it was Leah! He said to Laban, “What is this you have done to me? Didn’t I serve with you for Rachel? Why then have you deceived me?”

29.zh: 拉班说：「大女儿还没有给人，先把小女儿给人，在我们这地方没有这规矩。
29.en: Laban said, “It is not done so in our place, to give the younger before the firstborn.

29.zh: 你为这个满了七日，我就把那个也给你，你再为她服事我七年。」
29.en: Fulfill the week of this one, and we will give you the other also for the service which you will serve with me for seven more years.”

29.zh: 雅各就如此行。满了利亚的七日，拉班便将女儿拉结给雅各为妻。
29.en: Jacob did so, and fulfilled her week. He gave him Rachel his daughter as wife.

29.zh: 拉班又将婢女辟拉给女儿拉结作使女。
29.en: Laban gave Bilhah, his servant, to his daughter Rachel to be her servant.

29.zh: 雅各也与拉结同房，并且爱拉结胜似爱利亚，于是又服事了拉班七年。
29.en: He went in also to Rachel, and he loved also Rachel more than Leah, and served with him seven more years.

29.zh: 耶和华见利亚失宠，就使她生育，拉结却不生育。
29.en: The LORD saw that Leah was hated, and he opened her womb, but Rachel was barren.

29.zh: 利亚怀孕生子，就给他起名叫吕便，因而说：「耶和华看见我的苦情，如今我的丈夫必爱我。」
29.en: Leah conceived, and bore a son, and she named him Reuben. For she said, “Because the LORD has looked at my affliction; for now my husband will love me.”

29.zh: 她又怀孕生子，就说：「耶和华因为听见我失宠，所以又赐给我这个儿子」，于是给他起名叫西缅。
29.en: She conceived again, and bore a son, and said, “Because the LORD has heard that I am hated, he has therefore given me this son also.” She named him Simeon.

29.zh: 她又怀孕生子，起名叫利未，说：「我给丈夫生了三个儿子，他必与我联合。」
29.en: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “Now this time my husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons.” Therefore his name was called Levi.

29.zh: 她又怀孕生子，说：「这回我要赞美耶和华」，因此给他起名叫犹大。这才停了生育。
29.en: She conceived again, and bore a son. She said, “This time I will praise the LORD.” Therefore she named him Judah. Then she stopped bearing.

30.zh: 拉结见自己不给雅各生子，就嫉妒她姊姊，对雅各说：「你给我孩子，不然我就死了。」
30.en: When Rachel saw that she bore Jacob no children, Rachel envied her sister. She said to Jacob, “Give me children, or else I will die.”

30.zh: 雅各向拉结生气，说：「叫你不生育的是　神，我岂能代替他[作主]呢？」
30.en: Jacob’s anger burned against Rachel, and he said, “Am I in God’s place, who has withheld from you the fruit of the womb?”

30.zh: 拉结说：「有我的使女辟拉在这里，你可以与她同房，使她生子在我膝下，我便因她也得孩子。」
30.en: She said, “Behold, my maid Bilhah. Go in to her, that she may bear on my knees, and I also may obtain children by her.”

30.zh: 拉结就把她的使女辟拉给丈夫为妾；雅各便与她同房，
30.en: She gave him Bilhah her servant as wife, and Jacob went in to her.

30.zh: 辟拉就怀孕，给雅各生了一个儿子。
30.en: Bilhah conceived, and bore Jacob a son.

30.zh: 拉结说：「　神伸了我的冤，也听了我的声音，赐我一个儿子」，因此给他起名叫但。
30.en: Rachel said, “God has judged me, and has also heard my voice, and has given me a son.” Therefore she called his name Dan.

30.zh: 拉结的使女辟拉又怀孕，给雅各生了第二个儿子。
30.en: Bilhah, Rachel’s servant, conceived again, and bore Jacob a second son.

30.zh: 拉结说：「我与我姊姊大大相争，并且得胜」，于是给他起名叫拿弗他利。
30.en: Rachel said, “I have wrestled with my sister with mighty wrestlings, and have prevailed.” She named him Naphtali.

30.zh: 利亚见自己停了生育，就把使女悉帕给雅各为妾。
30.en: When Leah saw that she had finished bearing, she took Zilpah, her servant, and gave her to Jacob as a wife.

30.zh: 利亚的使女悉帕给雅各生了一个儿子。
30.en: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a son.

30.zh: 利亚说：「万幸！」于是给他起名叫迦得。
30.en: Leah said, “How fortunate!” She named him Gad.

30.zh: 利亚的使女悉帕又给雅各生了第二个儿子。
30.en: Zilpah, Leah’s servant, bore Jacob a second son.

30.zh: 利亚说：「我有福啊，众女子都要称我是有福的」，于是给他起名叫亚设。
30.en: Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.

30.zh: 割麦子的时候，吕便往田里去，寻见风茄，拿来给他母亲利亚。拉结对利亚说：「请你把你儿子的风茄给我些。」
30.en: Reuben went in the days of wheat harvest, and found mandrakes in the field, and brought them to his mother, Leah. Then Rachel said to Leah, “Please give me some of your son’s mandrakes.”

30.zh: 利亚说：「你夺了我的丈夫还算小事吗？你又要夺我儿子的风茄吗？」拉结说：「为你儿子的风茄，今夜他可以与你同寝。」
30.en: Leah said to her, “Is it a small matter that you have taken away my husband? Would you take away my son’s mandrakes, also?” Rachel said, “Therefore he will lie with you tonight for your son’s mandrakes.”

30.zh: 到了晚上，雅各从田里回来，利亚出来迎接他，说：「你要与我同寝，因为我实在用我儿子的风茄把你雇下了。」那一夜，雅各就与她同寝。
30.en: Jacob came from the field in the evening, and Leah went out to meet him, and said, “You must come in to me; for I have surely hired you with my son’s mandrakes.” He lay with her that night.

30.zh: 神应允了利亚，她就怀孕，给雅各生了第五个儿子。
30.en: God listened to Leah, and she conceived, and bore Jacob a fifth son.

30.zh: 利亚说：「　神给了我价值，因为我把使女给了我丈夫」，于是给他起名叫以萨迦。
30.en: Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.

30.zh: 利亚又怀孕，给雅各生了第六个儿子。
30.en: Leah conceived again, and bore a sixth son to Jacob.

30.zh: 利亚说：「　神赐我厚赏；我丈夫必与我同住，因我给他生了六个儿子」，于是给他起名西布伦。
30.en: Leah said, “God has endowed me with a good dowry. Now my husband will live with me, because I have borne him six sons.” She named him Zebulun.

30.zh: 后来又生了一个女儿，给她起名叫底拿。
30.en: Afterwards, she bore a daughter, and named her Dinah.

30.zh: 神顾念拉结，应允了她，使她能生育。
30.en: God remembered Rachel, and God listened to her, and opened her womb.

30.zh: 拉结怀孕生子，说：「　神除去了我的羞耻」，
30.en: She conceived, bore a son, and said, “God has taken away my reproach.”

30.zh: 就给他起名叫约瑟，意思说：「愿耶和华再增添我一个儿子。」
30.en: She named him Joseph, saying, “May the LORD add another son to me.”

30.zh: 拉结生约瑟之后，雅各对拉班说：「请打发我走，叫我回到我本乡本土去。
30.en: When Rachel had borne Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, “Send me away, that I may go to my own place, and to my country.

30.zh: 请你把我服事你所得的妻子和儿女给我，让我走；我怎样服事你，你都知道。」
30.en: Give me my wives and my children for whom I have served you, and let me go; for you know my service with which I have served you.”

30.zh: 拉班对他说：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，请你[仍与我同住]，[因为]我已算定，耶和华赐福与我是为你的缘故」；
30.en: Laban said to him, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, stay here, for I have divined that the LORD has blessed me for your sake.”

30.zh: 又说：「请你定你的工价，我就给你。」
30.en: He said, “Appoint me your wages, and I will give it.”

30.zh: 雅各对他说：「我怎样服事你，你的牲畜在我手里怎样，是你知道的。
30.en: Jacob said to him, “You know how I have served you, and how your livestock have fared with me.

30.zh: 我未来之先，你所有的很少，现今却发大众多，耶和华随我的脚步赐福与你。如今，我什么时候才为自己兴家立业呢？」
30.en: For it was little which you had before I came, and it has increased to a multitude. The LORD has blessed you wherever I turned. Now when will I provide for my own house also?”

30.zh: 拉班说：「我当给你什么呢？」雅各说：「什么你也不必给我，只有一件事，你若应承，我便仍旧牧放你的羊群。
30.en: Laban said, “What shall I give you?” Jacob said, “You shall not give me anything. If you will do this thing for me, I will again feed your flock and keep it.

30.zh: 今天我要走遍你的羊群，把绵羊中凡有点的、有斑的，和黑色的，并山羊中凡有斑的、有点的，都挑出来；将来[这一等的]就算我的工价。
30.en: I will pass through all your flock today, removing from there every speckled and spotted one, and every black one among the sheep, and the spotted and speckled among the goats. This will be my hire.

30.zh: 以后你来查看我的工价，凡在我手里的山羊不是有点有斑的，绵羊不是黑色的，那就算是我偷的；这样便可证出我的公义来。」
30.en: So my righteousness will answer for me hereafter, when you come concerning my hire that is before you. Every one that is not speckled and spotted among the goats, and black among the sheep, that might be with me, will be considered stolen.”

30.zh: 拉班说：「好啊！我情愿照着你的话行。」
30.en: Laban said, “Behold, let it be according to your word.”

30.zh: 当日，拉班把有纹的、有斑的公山羊，有点的、有斑的、有杂白纹的母山羊，并黑色的绵羊，都挑出来，交在他儿子们的手下，
30.en: That day, he removed the male goats that were streaked and spotted, and all the female goats that were speckled and spotted, every one that had white in it, and all the black ones among the sheep, and gave them into the hand of his sons.

30.zh: 又使自己和雅各相离三天的路程。雅各就牧养拉班其余的羊。
30.en: He set three days’ journey between himself and Jacob, and Jacob fed the rest of Laban’s flocks.

30.zh: 雅各拿杨树、杏树、枫树的嫩枝，将皮剥成白纹，使枝子露出白的来，
30.en: Jacob took to himself rods of fresh poplar, almond, and plane tree, peeled white streaks in them, and made the white appear which was in the rods.

30.zh: 将剥了皮的枝子，对着羊群，插在饮羊的水沟里和水槽里，羊来喝的时候，牝牡配合。
30.en: He set the rods which he had peeled opposite the flocks in the watering troughs where the flocks came to drink. They conceived when they came to drink.

30.zh: 羊对着枝子配合，就生下有纹的、有点的、有斑的来。
30.en: The flocks conceived before the rods, and the flocks produced streaked, speckled, and spotted.

30.zh: 雅各把羊羔分出来，使拉班的羊与这有纹和黑色的羊相对，把自己的羊另放一处，不叫他和拉班的羊混杂。
30.en: Jacob separated the lambs, and set the faces of the flocks toward the streaked and all the black in Laban’s flock. He put his own droves apart, and didn’t put them into Laban’s flock.

30.zh: 到羊群肥壮配合的时候，雅各就把枝子插在水沟里，使羊对着枝子配合。
30.en: Whenever the stronger of the flock conceived, Jacob laid the rods in front of the eyes of the flock in the watering troughs, that they might conceive among the rods;

30.zh: 只是到羊瘦弱配合的时候就不插枝子。这样，瘦弱的就归拉班，肥壮的就归雅各。
30.en: but when the flock were feeble, he didn’t put them in. So the feebler were Laban’s, and the stronger Jacob’s.

30.zh: 于是雅各极其发大，得了许多的羊群、仆婢、骆驼，和驴。
30.en: The man increased exceedingly, and had large flocks, female servants and male servants, and camels and donkeys.

31.zh: 雅各听见拉班的儿子们有话说：「雅各把我们父亲所有的都夺了去，并借着我们父亲的，得了这一切的荣耀。」
31.en: Jacob heard Laban’s sons’ words, saying, “Jacob has taken away all that was our father’s. He has obtained all this wealth from that which was our father’s.”

31.zh: 雅各见拉班的气色向他不如从前了。
31.en: Jacob saw the expression on Laban’s face, and, behold, it was not toward him as before.

31.zh: 耶和华对雅各说：「你要回你祖、你父之地，到你亲族那里去，我必与你同在。」
31.en: The LORD said to Jacob, “Return to the land of your fathers, and to your relatives, and I will be with you.”

31.zh: 雅各就打发人，叫拉结和利亚到田野羊群那里来，
31.en: Jacob sent and called Rachel and Leah to the field to his flock,

31.zh: 对她们说：「我看你们父亲的气色向我不如从前了；但我父亲的　神向来与我同在。
31.en: and said to them, “I see the expression on your father’s face, that it is not toward me as before; but the God of my father has been with me.

31.zh: 你们也知道，我尽了我的力量服事你们的父亲。
31.en: You know that I have served your father with all of my strength.

31.zh: 你们的父亲欺哄我，十次改了我的工价；然而　神不容他害我。
31.en: Your father has deceived me, and changed my wages ten times, but God didn’t allow him to hurt me.

31.zh: 他若说：『有点的归你作工价』，羊群所生的都有点；他若说：『有纹的归你作工价』，羊群所生的都有纹。
31.en: If he said, ‘The speckled will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore speckled. If he said, ‘The streaked will be your wages,’ then all the flock bore streaked.

31.zh: 这样，　神把你们父亲的牲畜夺来赐给我了。
31.en: Thus God has taken away your father’s livestock, and given them to me.

31.zh: 羊配合的时候，我梦中举目一看，见跳母羊的公羊都是有纹的、有点的、有花斑的。
31.en: During mating season, I lifted up my eyes, and saw in a dream, and behold, the male goats which leaped on the flock were streaked, speckled, and grizzled.

31.zh: 神的使者在那梦中呼叫我说：『雅各。』我说：『我在这里。』
31.en: The angel of God said to me in the dream, ‘Jacob,’ and I said, ‘Here I am.’

31.zh: 他说：『你举目观看，跳母羊的公羊都是有纹的、有点的、有花斑的；凡拉班向你所做的，我都看见了。
31.en: He said, ‘Now lift up your eyes, and behold, all the male goats which leap on the flock are streaked, speckled, and grizzled, for I have seen all that Laban does to you.

31.zh: 我是伯特利的　神；你在那里[用油]浇过柱子，向我许过愿。现今你起来，离开这地，回你本地去吧！』」
31.en: I am the God of Bethel, where you anointed a pillar, where you vowed a vow to me. Now arise, get out from this land, and return to the land of your birth.’”

31.zh: 拉结和利亚回答雅各说：「在我们父亲的家里还有我们可得的分吗？还有我们的产业吗？
31.en: Rachel and Leah answered him, “Is there yet any portion or inheritance for us in our father’s house?

31.zh: 我们不是被他当作外人吗？因为他卖了我们，吞了我们的价值。
31.en: Aren’t we considered as foreigners by him? For he has sold us, and has also used up our money.

31.zh: 神从我们父亲所夺出来的一切财物，那就是我们和我们孩子们的。现今凡　神所吩咐你的，你只管去行吧！」
31.en: For all the riches which God has taken away from our father are ours and our children’s. Now then, whatever God has said to you, do.”

31.zh: 雅各起来，使他的儿子和妻子都骑上骆驼，
31.en: Then Jacob rose up, and set his sons and his wives on the camels,

31.zh: 又带着他在巴旦·亚兰所得的一切牲畜和财物，往迦南地、他父亲以撒那里去了。
31.en: and he took away all his livestock, and all his possessions which he had gathered, including the livestock which he had gained in Paddan Aram, to go to Isaac his father, to the land of Canaan.

31.zh: 当时拉班剪羊毛去了，拉结偷了他父亲家中的神像。
31.en: Now Laban had gone to shear his sheep; and Rachel stole the teraphim that were her father’s.

31.zh: 雅各背着亚兰人拉班偷走了，并不告诉他，
31.en: Jacob deceived Laban the Syrian, in that he didn’t tell him that he was running away.

31.zh: 就带着所有的逃跑。他起身过大河，面向基列山行去。
31.en: So he fled with all that he had. He rose up, passed over the River, and set his face toward the mountain of Gilead.

31.zh: 到第三日，有人告诉拉班，雅各逃跑了。
31.en: Laban was told on the third day that Jacob had fled.

31.zh: 拉班带领他的众弟兄去追赶，追了七日，在基列山就追上了。
31.en: He took his relatives with him, and pursued him seven days’ journey. He overtook him in the mountain of Gilead.

31.zh: 夜间，　神到亚兰人拉班那里，在梦中对他说：「你要小心，不可与雅各说好说歹。」
31.en: God came to Laban the Syrian in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.”

31.zh: 拉班追上雅各。雅各在山上支搭帐棚；拉班和他的众弟兄也在基列山上支搭帐棚。
31.en: Laban caught up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban with his relatives encamped in the mountain of Gilead.

31.zh: 拉班对雅各说：「你做的是什么事呢？你背着我偷走了，又把我的女儿们带了去，如同用刀剑掳去的一般。
31.en: Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you have deceived me, and carried away my daughters like captives of the sword?

31.zh: 你为什么暗暗地逃跑，偷着走，并不告诉我，叫我可以欢乐、唱歌、击鼓、弹琴地送你回去？
31.en: Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn’t tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs, with tambourine and with harp;

31.zh: 又不容我与外孙和女儿亲嘴？你所行的真是愚昧！
31.en: and didn’t allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now you have done foolishly.

31.zh: 我手中原有能力害你，只是你父亲的　神昨夜对我说：『你要小心，不可与雅各说好说歹。』
31.en: It is in the power of my hand to hurt you, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.’

31.zh: 现在你虽然想你父家，不得不去，为什么又偷了我的神像呢？」
31.en: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”

31.zh: 雅各回答拉班说：「恐怕你把你的女儿从我夺去，所以我逃跑。
31.en: Jacob answered Laban, “Because I was afraid, for I said, ‘Lest you should take your daughters from me by force.’

31.zh: 至于你的神像，你在谁那里搜出来，就不容谁存活。当着我们的众弟兄，你认一认，在我这里有什么东西是你的，就拿去。」原来雅各不知道拉结偷了那些神像。
31.en: Anyone you find your gods with shall not live. Before our relatives, discern what is yours with me, and take it.” For Jacob didn’t know that Rachel had stolen them.

31.zh: 拉班进了雅各、利亚，并两个使女的帐棚，都没有搜出来，就从利亚的帐棚出来，进了拉结的帐棚。
31.en: Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two female servants; but he didn’t find them. He went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.

31.zh: 拉结已经把神像藏在骆驼的驮篓里，便坐在上头。拉班摸遍了那帐棚，并没有摸着。
31.en: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but didn’t find them.

31.zh: 拉结对她父亲说：「现在我身上不便，不能在你面前起来，求我主不要生气。」这样，拉班搜寻神像，竟没有搜出来。
31.en: She said to her father, “Don’t let my lord be angry that I can’t rise up before you; for I’m having my period.” He searched, but didn’t find the teraphim.

31.zh: 雅各就发怒斥责拉班说：「我有什么过犯，有什么罪恶，你竟这样火速地追我？
31.en: Jacob was angry, and argued with Laban. Jacob answered Laban, “What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have hotly pursued me?

31.zh: 你摸遍了我一切的家具，你搜出什么来呢？可以放在你我弟兄面前，叫他们在你我中间辨别辨别。
31.en: Now that you have felt around in all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my relatives and your relatives, that they may judge between us two.

31.zh: 我在你家这二十年，你的母绵羊、母山羊没有掉过胎。你群中的公羊，我没有吃过；
31.en: “These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young, and I haven’t eaten the rams of your flocks.

31.zh: 被野兽撕裂的，我没有带来给你，是我自己赔上。无论是白日，是黑夜，被偷去的，你都向我索要。
31.en: That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.

31.zh: 我白日受尽干热，黑夜受尽寒霜，不得合眼睡着，我常是这样。
31.en: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.

31.zh: 我这二十年在你家里，为你的两个女儿服事你十四年，为你的羊群服事你六年，你又十次改了我的工价。
31.en: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.

31.zh: 若不是我父亲以撒所敬畏的　神，就是亚伯拉罕的　神与我同在，你如今必定打发我空手而去。　神看见我的苦情和我的劳碌，就在昨夜责备你。」
31.en: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night.”

31.zh: 拉班回答雅各说：「这女儿是我的女儿，这些孩子是我的孩子，这些羊群也是我的羊群；凡在你眼前的都是我的。我的女儿并她们所生的孩子，我今日能向他们做什么呢？
31.en: Laban answered Jacob, “The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all that you see is mine! What can I do today to these my daughters, or to their children whom they have borne?

31.zh: 来吧！你我二人可以立约，作你我中间的证据。」
31.en: Now come, let’s make a covenant, you and I. Let it be for a witness between me and you.”

31.zh: 雅各就拿一块石头立作柱子，
31.en: Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

31.zh: 又对众弟兄说：「你们堆聚石头。」他们就拿石头来堆成一堆，大家便在旁边吃喝。
31.en: Jacob said to his relatives, “Gather stones.” They took stones, and made a heap. They ate there by the heap.

31.zh: 拉班称那石堆为伊迦尔·撒哈杜他，雅各却称那石堆为迦累得。
31.en: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.

31.zh: 拉班说：「今日这石堆作你我中间的证据。」因此这地方名叫迦累得，
31.en: Laban said, “This heap is witness between me and you today.” Therefore it was named Galeed

31.zh: 又叫米斯巴，意思说：「我们彼此离别以后，愿耶和华在你我中间鉴察。
31.en: and Mizpah, for he said, “The LORD watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.

31.zh: 你若苦待我的女儿，又在我的女儿以外另娶妻，虽没有人知道，却有　神在你我中间作见证。」
31.en: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take wives in addition to my daughters, no man is with us; behold, God is witness between me and you.”

31.zh: 拉班又说：「你看我在你我中间所立的这石堆和柱子。
31.en: Laban said to Jacob, “See this heap, and see the pillar, which I have set between me and you.

31.zh: 这石堆作证据，这柱子也作证据。我必不过这石堆去害你；你也不可过这石堆和柱子来害我。
31.en: May this heap be a witness, and the pillar be a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.

31.zh: 但愿亚伯拉罕的　神和拿鹤的　神，就是他们父亲的　神，在你我中间判断。」雅各就指着他父亲以撒所敬畏的　[神]起誓，
31.en: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of his father, Isaac.

31.zh: 又在山上献祭，请众弟兄来吃饭。他们吃了饭，便在山上住宿。
31.en: Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his relatives to eat bread. They ate bread, and stayed all night in the mountain.

31.zh: 拉班清早起来，与他外孙和女儿亲嘴，给他们祝福，回往自己的地方去了。
31.en: Early in the morning, Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. Laban departed and returned to his place.

32.zh: 雅各仍旧行路，　神的使者遇见他。
32.en: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

32.zh: 雅各看见他们就说：「这是　神的军兵」，于是给那地方起名叫玛哈念。
32.en: When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s army.” He called the name of that place Mahanaim.

32.zh: 雅各打发人先往西珥地去，就是以东地，见他哥哥以扫，
32.en: Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the field of Edom.

32.zh: 吩咐他们说：「你们对我主以扫说：『你的仆人雅各这样说：我在拉班那里寄居，直到如今。
32.en: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: ‘This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now.

32.zh: 我有牛、驴、羊群、仆婢，现在打发人来报告我主，为要在你眼前蒙恩。』」
32.en: I have cattle, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight.’”

32.zh: 所打发的人回到雅各那里，说：「我们到了你哥哥以扫那里，他带着四百人，正迎着你来。」
32.en: The messengers returned to Jacob, saying, “We came to your brother Esau. He is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him.”

32.zh: 雅各就甚惧怕，而且愁烦，便把那与他同在的人口和羊群、牛群、骆驼分做两队，
32.en: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. He divided the people who were with him, along with the flocks, the herds, and the camels, into two companies.

32.zh: 说：「以扫若来击杀这一队，剩下的那一队还可以逃避。」
32.en: He said, “If Esau comes to the one company, and strikes it, then the company which is left will escape.”

32.zh: 雅各说：「耶和华—我祖亚伯拉罕的　神，我父亲以撒的　神啊，你曾对我说：『回你本地本族去，我要厚待你。』
32.en: Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD, who said to me, ‘Return to your country, and to your relatives, and I will do you good,’

32.zh: 你向仆人所施的一切慈爱和诚实，我一点也不配得；我先前只拿着我的杖过这约旦河，如今我却成了两队了。
32.en: I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses, and of all the truth, which you have shown to your servant; for with just my staff I crossed over this Jordan; and now I have become two companies.

32.zh: 求你救我脱离我哥哥以扫的手；因为我怕他来杀我，连妻子带儿女一同杀了。
32.en: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and strike me and the mothers with the children.

32.zh: 你曾说：『我必定厚待你，使你的后裔如同海边的沙，多得不可胜数。』」
32.en: You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because there are so many.’”

32.zh: 当夜，雅各在那里住宿，就从他所有的物中拿礼物要送给他哥哥以扫：
32.en: He stayed there that night, and took from that which he had with him a present for Esau, his brother:

32.zh: 母山羊二百只，公山羊二十只，母绵羊二百只，公绵羊二十只，
32.en: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,

32.zh: 奶崽子的骆驼三十只—各带着崽子，母牛四十只，公牛十只，母驴二十匹，驴驹十匹；
32.en: thirty milk camels and their colts, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.

32.zh: 每样各分一群，交在仆人手下，就对仆人说：「你们要在我前头过去，使群群相离，有空闲的地方」；
32.en: He delivered them into the hands of his servants, every herd by itself, and said to his servants, “Pass over before me, and put a space between herd and herd.”

32.zh: 又吩咐尽先走的说：「我哥哥以扫遇见你的时候，问你说：『你是哪家的人？要往哪里去？你前头这些是谁的？』
32.en: He commanded the foremost, saying, “When Esau, my brother, meets you, and asks you, saying, ‘Whose are you? Where are you going? Whose are these before you?’

32.zh: 你就说：『是你仆人雅各的，是送给我主以扫的礼物；他自己也在我们后边。』」
32.en: Then you shall say, ‘They are your servant, Jacob’s. It is a present sent to my lord, Esau. Behold, he also is behind us.’”

32.zh: 又吩咐第二、第三，和一切赶群畜的人说：「你们遇见以扫的时候也要这样对他说；
32.en: He commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the herds, saying, “This is how you shall speak to Esau, when you find him.

32.zh: 并且你们要说：『你仆人雅各在我们后边。』」因雅各心里说：「我借着在我前头去的礼物解他的恨，然后再见他的面，或者他容纳我。」
