32.en: You shall say, ‘Not only that, but behold, your servant, Jacob, is behind us.’” For, he said, “I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.”

32.zh: 于是礼物先过去了；那夜，雅各在队中住宿。
32.en: So the present passed over before him, and he himself stayed that night in the camp.

32.zh: 他夜间起来，带着两个妻子，两个使女，并十一个儿子，都过了雅博渡口，
32.en: He rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.

32.zh: 先打发他们过河，又打发所有的都过去，
32.en: He took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.

32.zh: 只剩下雅各一人。有一个人来和他摔跤，直到黎明。
32.en: Jacob was left alone, and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day.

32.zh: 那人见自己胜不过他，就将他的大腿窝摸了一把，雅各的大腿窝正在摔跤的时候就扭了。
32.en: When he saw that he didn’t prevail against him, the man touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was strained as he wrestled.

32.zh: 那人说：「天黎明了，容我去吧！」雅各说：「你不给我祝福，我就不容你去。」
32.en: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”

32.zh: 那人说：「你名叫什么？」他说：「我名叫雅各。」
32.en: He said to him, “What is your name?” He said, “Jacob”.

32.zh: 那人说：「你的名不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列；因为你与　神与人较力，都得了胜。」
32.en: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”

32.zh: 雅各问他说：「请将你的名告诉我。」那人说：「何必问我的名？」于是在那里给雅各祝福。
32.en: Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.” He said, “Why is it that you ask what my name is?” So he blessed him there.

32.zh: 雅各便给那地方起名叫毗努伊勒，意思说：「我面对面见了　神，我的性命仍得保全。」
32.en: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel; for he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”

32.zh: 日头刚出来的时候，雅各经过毗努伊勒，他的大腿就瘸了。
32.en: The sun rose on him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped because of his thigh.

32.zh: 故此，以色列人不吃大腿窝的筋，直到今日，因为那人摸了雅各大腿窝的筋。
32.en: Therefore the children of Israel don’t eat the sinew of the hip, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day, because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew of the hip.

33.zh: 雅各举目观看，见以扫来了，后头跟着四百人，他就把孩子们分开交给利亚、拉结，和两个使女，
33.en: Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. He divided the children between Leah, Rachel, and the two servants.

33.zh: 并且叫两个使女和她们的孩子在前头，利亚和她的孩子在后头，拉结和约瑟在尽后头。
33.en: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.

33.zh: 他自己在他们前头过去，一连七次俯伏在地才就近他哥哥。
33.en: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

33.zh: 以扫跑来迎接他，将他抱住，又搂着他的颈项，与他亲嘴，两个人就哭了。
33.en: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.

33.zh: 以扫举目看见妇人孩子，就说：「这些和你同行的是谁呢？」雅各说：「这些孩子是　神施恩给你的仆人的。」
33.en: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, “Who are these with you?” He said, “The children whom God has graciously given your servant.”

33.zh: 于是两个使女和她们的孩子前来下拜；
33.en: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.

33.zh: 利亚和她的孩子也前来下拜；随后约瑟和拉结也前来下拜。
33.en: Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves. After them, Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

33.zh: 以扫说：「我所遇见的这些群畜是什么意思呢？」雅各说：「是要在我主面前蒙恩的。」
33.en: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company which I met?” Jacob said, “To find favor in the sight of my lord.”

33.zh: 以扫说：「兄弟啊，我的已经够了，你的仍归你吧！」
33.en: Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.”

33.zh: 雅各说：「不然，我若在你眼前蒙恩，就求你从我手里收下这礼物；因为我见了你的面，如同见了　神的面，并且你容纳了我。
33.en: Jacob said, “Please, no, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present at my hand, because I have seen your face, as one sees the face of God, and you were pleased with me.

33.zh: 求你收下我带来给你的礼物；因为　神恩待我，使我充足。」雅各再三地求他，他才收下了。
33.en: Please take the gift that I brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.” He urged him, and he took it.

33.zh: 以扫说：「我们可以起身前往，我在你前头走。」
33.en: Esau said, “Let’s take our journey, and let’s go, and I will go before you.”

33.zh: 雅各对他说：「我主知道孩子们年幼娇嫩，牛羊也正在乳养的时候，若是催赶一天，群畜都必死了。
33.en: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.

33.zh: 求我主在仆人前头走，我要量着在我面前群畜和孩子的力量慢慢地前行，直走到西珥我主那里。」
33.en: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”

33.zh: 以扫说：「容我把跟随我的人留几个在你这里。」雅各说：「何必呢？只要在我主眼前蒙恩就是了。」
33.en: Esau said, “Let me now leave with you some of the people who are with me.” He said, “Why? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”

33.zh: 于是，以扫当日起行，回往西珥去了。
33.en: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

33.zh: 雅各就往疏割去，在那里为自己盖造房屋，又为牲畜搭棚；因此那地方名叫疏割。
33.en: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

33.zh: 雅各从巴旦·亚兰回来的时候，平平安安地到了迦南地的示剑城，在城东支搭帐棚，
33.en: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped before the city.

33.zh: 就用一百块[银子]向示剑的父亲、哈抹的子孙买了支帐棚的那块地，
33.en: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.

33.zh: 在那里筑了一座坛，起名叫伊利·伊罗伊·以色列。
33.en: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.

34.zh: 利亚给雅各所生的女儿底拿出去，要见那地的女子们。
34.en: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

34.zh: 那地的主—希未人、哈抹的儿子示剑看见她，就拉住她，与她行淫，玷辱她。
34.en: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.

34.zh: 示剑的心系恋雅各的女儿底拿，喜爱这女子，甜言蜜语地安慰她。
34.en: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.

34.zh: 示剑对他父亲哈抹说：「求你为我聘这女子为妻。」
34.en: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”

34.zh: 雅各听见示剑玷污了他的女儿底拿。那时他的儿子们正和群畜在田野，雅各就闭口不言，等他们回来。
34.en: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field. Jacob held his peace until they came.

34.zh: 示剑的父亲哈抹出来见雅各，要和他商议。
34.en: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him.

34.zh: 雅各的儿子们听见这事，就从田野回来，人人忿恨，十分恼怒；因示剑在以色列家做了丑事，与雅各的女儿行淫，这本是不该做的事。
34.en: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter, a thing that ought not to be done.

34.zh: 哈抹和他们商议说：「我儿子示剑的心恋慕这女子，求你们将她给我的儿子为妻。
34.en: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.

34.zh: 你们与我们彼此结亲；你们可以把女儿给我们，也可以娶我们的女儿。
34.en: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.

34.zh: 你们与我们同住吧！这地都在你们面前，只管在此居住，做买卖，置产业。」
34.en: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”

34.zh: 示剑对女儿的父亲和弟兄们说：「但愿我在你们眼前蒙恩，你们向我要什么，我必给你们。
34.en: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you will tell me I will give.

34.zh: 任凭向我要多重的聘金和礼物，我必照你们所说的给你们；只要把女子给我为妻。」
34.en: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”

34.zh: 雅各的儿子们因为示剑玷污了他们的妹子底拿，就用诡诈的话回答示剑和他父亲哈抹，
34.en: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit when they spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,

34.zh: 对他们说：「我们不能把我们的妹子给没有受割礼的人为妻，因为那是我们的羞辱。
34.en: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.

34.zh: 惟有一件才可以应允：若你们所有的男丁都受割礼，和我们一样，
34.en: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised,

34.zh: 我们就把女儿给你们，也娶你们的女儿；我们便与你们同住，两下成为一样的人民。
34.en: then will we give our daughters to you; and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

34.zh: 倘若你们不听从我们受割礼，我们就带着妹子走了。」
34.en: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”

34.zh: 哈抹和他的儿子示剑喜欢这话。
34.en: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.

34.zh: 那少年人做这事并不迟延，因为他喜爱雅各的女儿；他在他父亲家中也是人最尊重的。
34.en: The young man didn’t wait to do this thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter, and he was honored above all the house of his father.

34.zh: 哈抹和他儿子示剑到本城的门口，对本城的人说：
34.en: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,

34.zh: 「这些人与我们和睦，不如许他们在这地居住，做买卖；这地也宽阔，足可容下他们。我们可以娶他们的女儿为妻，也可以把我们的女儿嫁给他们。
34.en: “These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it. For behold, the land is large enough for them. Let’s take their daughters to us for wives, and let’s give them our daughters.

34.zh: 惟有一件事我们必须做，他们才肯应允和我们同住，成为一样的人民：就是我们中间所有的男丁都要受割礼，和他们一样。
34.en: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.

34.zh: 他们的群畜、货财，和一切的牲口岂不都归我们吗？只要依从他们，他们就与我们同住。」
34.en: Won’t their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let’s give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”

34.zh: 凡从城门出入的人就都听从哈抹和他儿子示剑的话；于是凡从城门出入的男丁都受了割礼。
34.en: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.

34.zh: 到第三天，众人正在疼痛的时候，雅各的两个儿子，就是底拿的哥哥西缅和利未，各拿刀剑，趁着众人想不到的时候来到城中，把一切男丁都杀了，
34.en: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.

34.zh: 又用刀杀了哈抹和他儿子示剑，把底拿从示剑家里带出来就走了。
34.en: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.

34.zh: 雅各的儿子们因为他们的妹子受了玷污，就来到被杀的人那里，掳掠那城，
34.en: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.

34.zh: 夺了他们的羊群、牛群，和驴，并城里田间所有的；
34.en: They took their flocks, their herds, their donkeys, that which was in the city, that which was in the field,

34.zh: 又把他们一切货财、孩子、妇女，并各房中所有的，都掳掠去了。
34.en: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.

34.zh: 雅各对西缅和利未说：「你们连累我，使我在这地的居民中，就是在迦南人和比利洗人中，有了臭名。我的人丁既然稀少，他们必聚集来击杀我，我和全家的人都必灭绝。」
34.en: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather themselves together against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.”

34.zh: 他们说：「他岂可待我们的妹子如同妓女吗？」
34.en: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”

35.zh: 神对雅各说：「起来！上伯特利去，住在那里；要在那里筑一座坛给　神，就是你逃避你哥哥以扫的时候向你显现的那位。」
35.en: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”

35.zh: 雅各就对他家中的人并一切与他同在的人说：「你们要除掉你们中间的外邦神，也要自洁，更换衣裳。
35.en: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.

35.zh: 我们要起来，上伯特利去，在那里我要筑一座坛给　神，就是在我遭难的日子应允我[的祷告]、在我行的路上保佑我的那位。」
35.en: Let’s arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”

35.zh: 他们就把外邦人的神像和他们耳朵上的环子交给雅各；雅各都藏在示剑那里的橡树底下。
35.en: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

35.zh: 他们便起行前往。　神使那周围城邑的人都甚惊惧，就不追赶雅各的众子了。
35.en: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.

35.zh: 于是雅各和一切与他同在的人到了迦南地的路斯，就是伯特利。
35.en: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.

35.zh: 他在那里筑了一座坛，就给那地方起名叫伊勒·伯特利；因为他逃避他哥哥的时候，　神在那里向他显现。
35.en: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

35.zh: 利百加的奶母底波拉死了，就葬在伯特利下边橡树底下；那棵树名叫亚伦·巴古。
35.en: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.

35.zh: 雅各从巴旦·亚兰回来，　神又向他显现，赐福与他，
35.en: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.

35.zh: 且对他说：「你的名原是雅各，从今以后不要再叫雅各，要叫以色列。」这样，他就改名叫以色列。
35.en: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.

35.zh: 神又对他说：「我是全能的　神；你要生养众多，将来有一族和多国的民从你而生，又有君王从你而出。
35.en: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.

35.zh: 我所赐给亚伯拉罕和以撒的地，我要赐给你与你的后裔。」
35.en: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”

35.zh: 神就从那与雅各说话的地方升上去了。
35.en: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.

35.zh: 雅各便在那里立了一根石柱，在柱子上奠酒，浇油。
35.en: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.

35.zh: 雅各就给那地方起名叫伯特利。
35.en: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.

35.zh: 他们从伯特利起行，离以法他还有一段路程，拉结临产甚是艰难。
35.en: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.

35.zh: 正在艰难的时候，收生婆对她说：「不要怕，你又要得一个儿子了。」
35.en: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”

35.zh: 她将近于死，灵魂要走的时候，就给她儿子起名叫便·俄尼；他父亲却给他起名叫便雅悯。
35.en: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.

35.zh: 拉结死了，葬在以法他的路旁；以法他就是伯利恒。
35.en: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).

35.zh: 雅各在她的坟上立了一统碑，就是拉结的墓碑，到今日还在。
35.en: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.

35.zh: 以色列起行前往，在以得台那边支搭帐棚。
35.en: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

35.zh: 以色列住在那地的时候，吕便去与他父亲的妾辟拉同寝，以色列也听见了。 雅各共有十二个儿子。
35.en: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.

35.zh: 利亚所生的是雅各的长子吕便，还有西缅、利未、犹大、以萨迦、西布伦。
35.en: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

35.zh: 拉结所生的是约瑟、便雅悯。
35.en: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

35.zh: 拉结的使女辟拉所生的是但、拿弗他利。
35.en: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.

35.zh: 利亚的使女悉帕所生的是迦得、亚设。这是雅各在巴旦·亚兰所生的儿子。
35.en: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.

35.zh: 雅各来到他父亲以撒那里，到了基列·亚巴的幔利，乃是亚伯拉罕和以撒寄居的地方；基列·亚巴就是希伯 。
35.en: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.

35.zh: 以撒共活了一百八十岁。
35.en: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.

35.zh: 以撒年纪老迈，日子满足，气绝而死，归到他列祖那里。他两个儿子以扫、雅各把他埋葬了。
35.en: Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.

36.zh: 以扫就是以东，他的后代记在下面。
36.en: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).

36.zh: 以扫娶迦南的女子为妻，就是赫人以伦的女儿亚大和希未人祭便的孙女、亚拿的女儿阿何利巴玛，
36.en: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;

36.zh: 又娶了以实玛利的女儿、尼拜约的妹子巴实抹。
36.en: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

36.zh: 亚大给以扫生了以利法；巴实抹生了流珥；
36.en: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.

36.zh: 阿何利巴玛生了耶乌施、雅兰、可拉。这都是以扫的儿子，是在迦南地生的。
36.en: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

36.zh: 以扫带着他的妻子、儿女，与家中一切的人口，并他的牛羊、牲畜，和一切货财，就是他在迦南地所得的，往别处去，离了他兄弟雅各。
36.en: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.

36.zh: 因为二人的财物群畜甚多，寄居的地方容不下他们，所以不能同居。
36.en: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.

36.zh: 于是以扫住在西珥山里；以扫就是以东。
36.en: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.

36.zh: 以扫是西珥山里以东人的始祖，他的后代记在下面。
36.en: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:

36.zh: 以扫众子的名字如下。以扫的妻子亚大生以利法；以扫的妻子巴实抹生流珥。
36.en: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.

36.zh: 以利法的儿子是提幔、阿抹、洗玻、迦坦、基纳斯。
36.en: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

36.zh: 亭纳是以扫儿子以利法的妾；她给以利法生了亚玛力。这是以扫的妻子亚大的子孙。
36.en: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.

36.zh: 流珥的儿子是拿哈、谢拉、沙玛、米撒。这是以扫妻子巴实抹的子孙。
36.en: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

36.zh: 以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛是祭便的孙女，亚拿的女儿；她给以扫生了耶乌施、雅兰、可拉。
36.en: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

36.zh: 以扫子孙中作族长的记在下面。以扫的长子以利法的子孙中，有提幔族长、阿抹族长、洗玻族长、基纳斯族长、
36.en: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,

36.zh: 可拉族长、迦坦族长、亚玛力族长。这是在以东地从以利法所出的族长，都是亚大的子孙。
36.en: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.

36.zh: 以扫的儿子流珥的子孙中，有拿哈族长、谢拉族长、沙玛族长、米撒族长。这是在以东地从流珥所出的族长，都是以扫妻子巴实抹的子孙。
36.en: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

36.zh: 以扫的妻子阿何利巴玛的子孙中，有耶乌施族长、雅兰族长、可拉族长。这是从以扫妻子，亚拿的女儿，阿何利巴玛子孙中所出的族长。
36.en: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

36.zh: 以上的族长都是以扫的子孙；以扫就是以东。
36.en: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.

36.zh: 那地原有的居民—何利人西珥的子孙记在下面：就是罗坍、朔巴、祭便、亚拿、
36.en: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

36.zh: 底顺、以察、底珊。这是从以东地的何利人西珥子孙中所出的族长。
36.en: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

36.zh: 罗坍的儿子是何利、希幔；罗坍的妹子是亭纳。
36.en: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.

36.zh: 朔巴的儿子是亚勒文、玛拿辖、以巴录、示玻、阿南。
36.en: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

36.zh: 祭便的儿子是亚雅、亚拿（当时在旷野放他父亲祭便的驴，遇着温泉的，就是这亚拿）。
36.en: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.

36.zh: 亚拿的儿子是底顺；亚拿的女儿是阿何利巴玛。
36.en: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.

36.zh: 底顺的儿子是欣但、伊是班、益兰、基兰。
36.en: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

36.zh: 以察的儿子是辟罕、撒番、亚干。
36.en: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

36.zh: 底珊的儿子是乌斯、亚兰。
36.en: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

36.zh: 从何利人所出的族长记在下面：就是罗坍族长、朔巴族长、祭便族长、亚拿族长、
36.en: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

36.zh: 底顺族长、以察族长、底珊族长。这是从何利人所出的族长，都在西珥地，按着宗族作族长。
36.en: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

36.zh: 以色列人未有君王治理以先，在以东地作王的记在下面。
36.en: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.

36.zh: 比珥的儿子比拉在以东作王，他的[京]城名叫亭哈巴。
36.en: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.

36.zh: 比拉死了，波斯拉人谢拉的儿子约巴接续他作王。
36.en: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.

36.zh: 约巴死了，提幔地的人户珊接续他作王。
36.en: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

36.zh: 户珊死了，比达的儿子哈达接续他作王；这哈达就是在摩押地杀败米甸人的，他的[京]城名叫亚未得。
36.en: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.

36.zh: 哈达死了，玛士利加人桑拉接续他作王。
36.en: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

36.zh: 桑拉死了，大河边的利河伯人扫罗接续他作王。
36.en: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.

36.zh: 扫罗死了，亚革波的儿子巴勒·哈南接续他作王。
36.en: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

36.zh: 亚革波的儿子巴勒·哈南死了，哈达接续他作王，他的[京]城名叫巴乌；他的妻子名叫米希她别，是米·萨合的孙女，玛特列的女儿。
36.en: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

36.zh: 从以扫所出的族长，按着他们的宗族、住处、名字记在下面：就是亭纳族长、亚勒瓦族长、耶帖族长、
36.en: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

36.zh: 阿何利巴玛族长、以拉族长、比嫩族长、
36.en: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

36.zh: 基纳斯族长、提幔族长、米比萨族长、
36.en: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

36.zh: 玛基叠族长、以兰族长。这是以东人在所得为业的地上，按着他们的住处。（所有的族长都是以东人的始祖以扫的后代。）
36.en: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.

37.zh: 雅各住在迦南地，就是他父亲寄居的地。
37.en: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s travels, in the land of Canaan.

37.zh: 雅各的记略如下。 约瑟十七岁与他哥哥们一同牧羊。他是个童子，与他父亲的妾辟拉、悉帕的儿子们常在一处。约瑟将他哥哥们的恶行报给他们的父亲。
37.en: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.

37.zh: 以色列原来爱约瑟过于爱他的众子，因为约瑟是他年老生的；他给约瑟做了一件彩衣。
37.en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a tunic of many colors.

37.zh: 约瑟的哥哥们见父亲爱约瑟过于爱他们，就恨约瑟，不与他说和睦的话。
37.en: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.

37.zh: 约瑟做了一梦，告诉他哥哥们，他们就越发恨他。
37.en: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.

37.zh: 约瑟对他们说：「请听我所做的梦：
37.en: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:

37.zh: 我们在田里捆禾稼，我的捆起来站着，你们的捆来围着我的捆下拜。」
37.en: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”

37.zh: 他的哥哥们回答说：「难道你真要作我们的王吗？难道你真要管辖我们吗？」他们就因为他的梦和他的话越发恨他。
37.en: His brothers asked him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.

37.zh: 后来他又做了一梦，也告诉他的哥哥们说：「看哪，我又做了一梦，梦见太阳、月亮，与十一个星向我下拜。」
37.en: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”

37.zh: 约瑟将这梦告诉他父亲和他哥哥们，他父亲就责备他说：「你做的这是什么梦！难道我和你母亲、你弟兄果然要来俯伏在地，向你下拜吗？」
37.en: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to the earth before you?”

37.zh: 他哥哥们都嫉妒他，他父亲却把这话存在心里。
37.en: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.

37.zh: 约瑟的哥哥们往示剑去放他们父亲的羊。
37.en: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.

37.zh: 以色列对约瑟说：「你哥哥们不是在示剑放羊吗？你来，我要打发你往他们那里去。」约瑟说：「我在这里。」
37.en: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”

37.zh: 以色列说：「你去看看你哥哥们平安不平安，群羊平安不平安，就回来报信给我」；于是打发他出希伯 谷，他就往示剑去了。
37.en: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.” So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

37.zh: 有人遇见他在田野走迷了路，就问他说：「你找什么？」
37.en: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, “What are you looking for?”

37.zh: 他说：「我找我的哥哥们，求你告诉我，他们在何处放羊。」
37.en: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”

37.zh: 那人说：「他们已经走了，我听见他们说要往多坍去。」约瑟就去追赶他哥哥们，遇见他们在多坍。
37.en: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.

37.zh: 他们远远地看见他，趁他还没有走到跟前，大家就同谋要害死他，
37.en: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.

37.zh: 彼此说：「你看！那做梦的来了。
37.en: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.

37.zh: 来吧！我们将他杀了，丢在一个坑里，就说有恶兽把他吃了。我们且看他的梦将来怎么样。」
37.en: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”

37.zh: 吕便听见了，要救他脱离他们的手，说：「我们不可害他的性命」；
37.en: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”

37.zh: 又说：「不可流[他的]血，可以把他丢在这野地的坑里，不可下手害他。」吕便的意思是要救他脱离他们的手，把他归还他的父亲。
37.en: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.

37.zh: 约瑟到了他哥哥们那里，他们就剥了他的外衣，就是他穿的那件彩衣，
37.en: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him;

37.zh: 把他丢在坑里；那坑是空的，里头没有水。
37.en: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.

37.zh: 他们坐下吃饭，举目观看，见有一伙[米甸 的]以实玛利人从基列来，用骆驼驮着香料、乳香、没药，要带下埃及去。
37.en: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

37.zh: 犹大对众弟兄说：「我们杀我们的兄弟，藏了他的血有什么益处呢？
37.en: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?

37.zh: 我们不如将他卖给以实玛利人，不可下手害他；因为他是我们的兄弟，我们的骨肉。」众弟兄就听从了他。
37.en: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.

37.zh: 有些米甸的商人从那里经过，哥哥们就把约瑟从坑里拉上来，讲定二十舍客勒银子，把约瑟卖给以实玛利人。他们就把约瑟带到埃及去了。
37.en: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. The merchants brought Joseph into Egypt.

37.zh: 吕便回到坑边，见约瑟不在坑里，就撕裂衣服，
37.en: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.

37.zh: 回到兄弟们那里，说：「童子没有了。我往哪里去才好呢？」
37.en: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”

37.zh: 他们宰了一只公山羊，把约瑟的那件彩衣染了血，
37.en: They took Joseph’s tunic, and killed a male goat, and dipped the tunic in the blood.

37.zh: 打发人送到他们的父亲那里，说：「我们捡了这个；请认一认是你儿子的外衣不是？」
37.en: They took the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, and see if it is your son’s tunic or not.”

37.zh: 他认得，就说：「这是我儿子的外衣。有恶兽把他吃了，约瑟被撕碎了！撕碎了！」
37.en: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s tunic. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”

37.zh: 雅各便撕裂衣服，腰间围上麻布，为他儿子悲哀了多日。
37.en: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.

37.zh: 他的儿女都起来安慰他，他却不肯受安慰，说：「我必悲哀着下阴间，到我儿子那里。」约瑟的父亲就为他哀哭。
37.en: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son, mourning.” His father wept for him.

37.zh: 米甸人带约瑟到埃及，把他卖给法老的内臣—护卫长波提乏。
37.en: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.

38.zh: 那时，犹大离开他弟兄下去，到一个亚杜兰人名叫希拉的家里去。
38.en: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

38.zh: 犹大在那里看见一个迦南人名叫书亚的女儿，就娶她为妻，与她同房，
38.en: There, Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua. He took her, and went in to her.

38.zh: 她就怀孕生了儿子，犹大给他起名叫珥。
38.en: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.

38.zh: 她又怀孕生了儿子，母亲给他起名叫俄南。
38.en: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.

38.zh: 她复又生了儿子，给他起名叫示拉。她生示拉的时候，犹大正在基悉。
38.en: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.

38.zh: 犹大为长子珥娶妻，名叫她玛。
38.en: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

38.zh: 犹大的长子珥在耶和华眼中看为恶，耶和华就叫他死了。
38.en: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight. So the LORD killed him.

38.zh: 犹大对俄南说：「你当与你哥哥的妻子同房，向她尽你为弟的本分，为你哥哥生子立后。」
38.en: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”

38.zh: 俄南知道生子不归自己，所以同房的时候便遗在地，免得给他哥哥留后。
38.en: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.

38.zh: 俄南所做的在耶和华眼中看为恶，耶和华也就叫他死了。
38.en: The thing which he did was evil in the LORD’s sight, and he killed him also.

38.zh: 犹大心里说：「恐怕示拉也死，像他两个哥哥一样」，就对他儿妇她玛说：「你去，在你父亲家里守寡，等我儿子示拉长大。」她玛就回去，住在她父亲家里。
38.en: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up;” for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.

38.zh: 过了许久，犹大的妻子书亚的女儿死了。犹大得了安慰，就和他朋友亚杜兰人希拉上亭拿去，到他剪羊毛的人那里。
38.en: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.

38.zh: 有人告诉她玛说：「你的公公上亭拿剪羊毛去了。」
38.en: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”

38.zh: 她玛见示拉已经长大，还没有娶她为妻，就脱了她作寡妇的衣裳，用帕子蒙着脸，又遮住身体，坐在亭拿路上的伊拿印城门口。
38.en: She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.

38.zh: 犹大看见她，以为是妓女，因为她蒙着脸。
38.en: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.

38.zh: 犹大就转到她那里去，说：「来吧！让我与你同寝。」他原不知道是他的儿妇。她玛说：「你要与我同寝，把什么给我呢？」
38.en: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me?”

38.zh: 犹大说：「我从羊群里取一只山羊羔，打发人送来给你。」她玛说：「在未送以先，你愿意给我一个当头吗？」
38.en: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”

38.zh: 他说：「我给你什么当头呢？」她玛说：「你的印、你的带子，和你手里的杖。」犹大就给了她，与她同寝，她就从犹大怀了孕。
38.en: He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.

38.zh: 她玛起来走了，除去帕子，仍旧穿上作寡妇的衣裳。
38.en: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

38.zh: 犹大托他朋友亚杜兰人送一只山羊羔去，要从那女人手里取回当头来，却找不着她，
38.en: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.

38.zh: 就问那地方的人说：「伊拿印路旁的妓女在哪里？」他们说：「这里并没有妓女。」
38.en: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”

38.zh: 他回去见犹大说：「我没有找着她，并且那地方的人说：『这里没有妓女。』」
38.en: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”

38.zh: 犹大说：「我把这山羊羔送去了，你竟找不着她。任凭她拿去吧，免得我们被羞辱。」
38.en: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”

38.zh: 约过了三个月，有人告诉犹大说：「你的儿妇她玛作了妓女，且因行淫有了身孕。」犹大说：「拉出她来，把她烧了！」
38.en: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burned.”

38.zh: 她玛被拉出来的时候便打发人去见她公公，对他说：「这些东西是谁的，我就是从谁怀的孕。请你认一认，这印和带子并杖都是谁的？」
38.en: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “I am with child by the man who owns these.” She also said, “Please discern whose these are—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”

38.zh: 犹大承认说：「她比我更有义，因为我没有将她给我的儿子示拉。」从此犹大不再与她同寝了。
38.en: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.

38.zh: 她玛将要生产，不料她腹里是一对双生。
38.en: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.

38.zh: 到生产的时候，一个孩子伸出一只手来；收生婆拿红线拴在他手上，说：「这是头生的。」
38.en: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”

38.zh: 随后这孩子把手收回去，他哥哥生出来了；收生婆说：「你为什么抢着来呢？」因此给他起名叫法勒斯。
38.en: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.

38.zh: 后来，他兄弟那手上有红线的也生出来，就给他起名叫谢拉。
38.en: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.

39.zh: 约瑟被带下埃及去。有一个埃及人，是法老的内臣—护卫长波提乏，从那些带下他来的以实玛利人手下买了他去。
39.en: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there.

39.zh: 约瑟住在他主人埃及人的家中，耶和华与他同在，他就百事顺利。
39.en: The LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

39.zh: 他主人见耶和华与他同在，又见耶和华使他手里所办的尽都顺利，
39.en: His master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did prosper in his hand.

39.zh: 约瑟就在主人眼前蒙恩，伺候他主人，并且主人派他管理家务，把一切所有的都交在他手里。
39.en: Joseph found favor in his sight. He ministered to him, and Potiphar made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

39.zh: 自从主人派约瑟管理家务和他一切所有的，耶和华就因约瑟的缘故赐福与那埃及人的家；凡家里和田间一切所有的都蒙耶和华赐福。
39.en: From the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake. The LORD’s blessing was on all that he had, in the house and in the field.

39.zh: 波提乏将一切所有的都交在约瑟的手中，除了自己所吃的饭，别的事一概不知。 约瑟原来秀雅俊美。
39.en: He left all that he had in Joseph’s hand. He didn’t concern himself with anything, except for the food which he ate. Joseph was well-built and handsome.

39.zh: 这事以后，约瑟主人的妻以目送情给约瑟，说：「你与我同寝吧！」
39.en: After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”

39.zh: 约瑟不从，对他主人的妻说：「看哪，一切家务，我主人都不知道；他把所有的都交在我手里。
39.en: But he refused, and said to his master’s wife, “Behold, my master doesn’t know what is with me in the house, and he has put all that he has into my hand.

39.zh: 在这家里没有比我大的；并且他没有留下一样不交给我，只留下了你，因为你是他的妻子。我怎能作这大恶，得罪　神呢？」
39.en: No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”

39.zh: 后来她天天和约瑟说，约瑟却不听从她，不与她同寝，也不和她在一处。
39.en: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

39.zh: 有一天，约瑟进屋里去办事，家中人没有一个在那屋里，
39.en: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.

39.zh: 妇人就拉住他的衣裳，说：「你与我同寝吧！」约瑟把衣裳丢在妇人手里，跑到外边去了。
39.en: She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” He left his garment in her hand, and ran outside.

39.zh: 妇人看见约瑟把衣裳丢在她手里跑出去了，
39.en: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,

39.zh: 就叫了家里的人来，对他们说：「你们看！他带了一个希伯来人进入我们家里，要戏弄我们。他到我这里来，要与我同寝，我就大声喊叫。
39.en: she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, “Behold, he has brought a Hebrew in to us to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.

39.zh: 他听见我放声喊起来，就把衣裳丢在我这里，跑到外边去了。」
39.en: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

39.zh: 妇人把约瑟的衣裳放在自己那里，等着他主人回家，
39.en: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.

39.zh: 就对他如此如此说：「你所带到我们这里的那希伯来仆人进来要戏弄我，
39.en: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, “The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought to us, came in to me to mock me,

39.zh: 我放声喊起来，他就把衣裳丢在我这里，跑出去了。」
39.en: and as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

39.zh: 约瑟的主人听见他妻子对他所说的话，说「你的仆人如此如此待我」，他就生气，
39.en: When his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, “This is what your servant did to me,” his wrath was kindled.

39.zh: 把约瑟下在监里，就是王的囚犯被囚的地方。于是约瑟在那里坐监。
39.en: Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound, and he was there in custody.

39.zh: 但耶和华与约瑟同在，向他施恩，使他在司狱的眼前蒙恩。
39.en: But the LORD was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

39.zh: 司狱就把监里所有的囚犯都交在约瑟的手下；他们在那里所办的事都是经他的手。
39.en: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever they did there, he was responsible for it.

39.zh: 凡在约瑟手下的事，司狱一概不察，因为耶和华与约瑟同在；耶和华使他所做的尽都顺利。
39.en: The keeper of the prison didn’t look after anything that was under his hand, because the LORD was with him; and that which he did, the LORD made it prosper.

40.zh: 这事以后，埃及王的酒政和膳长得罪了他们的主—埃及王，
40.en: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.

40.zh: 法老就恼怒酒政和膳长这二臣，
40.en: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.

40.zh: 把他们下在护卫长府内的监里，就是约瑟被囚的地方。
40.en: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

40.zh: 护卫长把他们交给约瑟，约瑟便伺候他们；他们有些日子在监里。
40.en: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.

40.zh: 被囚在监之埃及王的酒政和膳长二人同夜各做一梦，各梦都有讲解。
40.en: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.

40.zh: 到了早晨，约瑟进到他们那里，见他们有愁闷的样子。
40.en: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad.

40.zh: 他便问法老的二臣，就是与他同囚在他主人府里的，说：「你们今日为什么面带愁容呢？」
40.en: He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”

40.zh: 他们对他说：「我们各人做了一梦，没有人能解。」约瑟说：「解梦不是出于　神吗？请你们将梦告诉我。」
40.en: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.” Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me.”

40.zh: 酒政便将他的梦告诉约瑟说：「我梦见在我面前有一棵葡萄树，
40.en: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me,

40.zh: 树上有三根枝子，好像发了芽，开了花，上头的葡萄都成熟了。
40.en: and in the vine were three branches. It was as though it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters produced ripe grapes.

40.zh: 法老的杯在我手中，我就拿葡萄挤在法老的杯里，将杯递在他手中。」
40.en: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.”

40.zh: 约瑟对他说：「你所做的梦是这样解：三根枝子就是三天；
40.en: Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.

40.zh: 三天之内，法老必提你出监，叫你官复原职，你仍要递杯在法老的手中，和先前作他的酒政一样。
40.en: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, the way you did when you were his cup bearer.

40.zh: 但你得好处的时候，求你记念我，施恩与我，在法老面前提说我，救我出这监牢。
40.en: But remember me when it is well with you. Please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.

40.zh: 我实在是从希伯来人之地被拐来的；我在这里也没有做过什么，叫他们把我下在监里。」
40.en: For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.”

40.zh: 膳长见梦解得好，就对约瑟说：「我在梦中见我头上顶着三筐白饼；
40.en: When the chief baker saw that the interpretation was good, he said to Joseph, “I also was in my dream, and behold, three baskets of white bread were on my head.

40.zh: 极上的筐子里有为法老烤的各样食物，有飞鸟来吃我头上筐子里的食物。」
40.en: In the uppermost basket there were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, and the birds ate them out of the basket on my head.”

40.zh: 约瑟说：「你的梦是这样解：三个筐子就是三天；
40.en: Joseph answered, “This is its interpretation. The three baskets are three days.

40.zh: 三天之内，法老必斩断你的头，把你挂在木头上，必有飞鸟来吃你身上的肉。」
40.en: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head from off you, and will hang you on a tree; and the birds will eat your flesh from off you.”

40.zh: 到了第三天，是法老的生日，他为众臣仆设摆筵席，把酒政和膳长提出监来，
40.en: On the third day, which was Pharaoh’s birthday, he made a feast for all his servants, and he lifted up the head of the chief cup bearer and the head of the chief baker among his servants.

40.zh: 使酒政官复原职，他仍旧递杯在法老手中；
40.en: He restored the chief cup bearer to his position again, and he gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand;

40.zh: 但把膳长挂起来，正如约瑟向他们所解的话。
40.en: but he hanged the chief baker, as Joseph had interpreted to them.

40.zh: 酒政却不记念约瑟，竟忘了他。
40.en: Yet the chief cup bearer didn’t remember Joseph, but forgot him.

41.zh: 过了两年，法老做梦，梦见自己站在河边，
41.en: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed, and behold, he stood by the river.

41.zh: 有七只母牛从河里上来，又美好又肥壮，在芦荻中吃[草]。
41.en: Behold, seven cattle came up out of the river. They were sleek and fat, and they fed in the marsh grass.

41.zh: 随后又有七只母牛从河里上来，又丑陋又干瘦，与那七只母牛一同站在河边。
41.en: Behold, seven other cattle came up after them out of the river, ugly and thin, and stood by the other cattle on the brink of the river.

41.zh: 这又丑陋又干瘦的七只母牛吃尽了那又美好又肥壮的七只母牛。法老就醒了。
41.en: The ugly and thin cattle ate up the seven sleek and fat cattle. So Pharaoh awoke.

41.zh: 他又睡着，第二回做梦，梦见一棵麦子长了七个穗子，又肥大又佳美，
41.en: He slept and dreamed a second time; and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, healthy and good.

41.zh: 随后又长了七个穗子，又细弱又被东风吹焦了。
41.en: Behold, seven heads of grain, thin and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

41.zh: 这细弱的穗子吞了那七个又肥大又饱满的穗子。法老醒了，不料是个梦。
41.en: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven healthy and full ears. Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.

41.zh: 到了早晨，法老心里不安，就差人召了埃及所有的术士和博士来；法老就把所做的梦告诉他们，却没有人能给法老圆解。
41.en: In the morning, his spirit was troubled, and he sent and called for all of Egypt’s magicians and wise men. Pharaoh told them his dreams, but there was no one who could interpret them to Pharaoh.

41.zh: 那时酒政对法老说：「我今日想起我的罪来。
41.en: Then the chief cup bearer spoke to Pharaoh, saying, “I remember my faults today.

41.zh: 从前法老恼怒臣仆，把我和膳长下在护卫长府内的监里。
41.en: Pharaoh was angry with his servants, and put me in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, with the chief baker.

41.zh: 我们二人同夜各做一梦，各梦都有讲解。
41.en: We dreamed a dream in one night, he and I. Each man dreamed according to the interpretation of his dream.

41.zh: 在那里同着我们有一个希伯来的少年人，是护卫长的仆人，我们告诉他，他就把我们的梦圆解，是按着各人的梦圆解的。
41.en: There was with us there a young man, a Hebrew, servant to the captain of the guard, and we told him, and he interpreted to us our dreams. He interpreted to each man according to his dream.

41.zh: 后来正如他给我们圆解的成就了：我官复原职，膳长被挂起来了。」
41.en: As he interpreted to us, so it was. He restored me to my office, and he hanged him.”

41.zh: 法老遂即差人去召约瑟，他们便急忙带他出监，他就剃头，刮脸，换衣裳，进到法老面前。
41.en: Then Pharaoh sent and called Joseph, and they brought him hastily out of the dungeon. He shaved himself, changed his clothing, and came in to Pharaoh.

41.zh: 法老对约瑟说：「我做了一梦，没有人能解；我听见人说，你听了梦就能解。」
41.en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it. I have heard it said of you, that when you hear a dream you can interpret it.”

41.zh: 约瑟回答法老说：「这不在乎我，　神必将平安的话回答法老。」
41.en: Joseph answered Pharaoh, saying, “It isn’t in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”

41.zh: 法老对约瑟说：「我梦见我站在河边，
41.en: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, “In my dream, behold, I stood on the brink of the river;

41.zh: 有七只母牛从河里上来，又肥壮又美好，在芦荻中吃草。
41.en: and behold, seven fat and sleek cattle came up out of the river. They fed in the marsh grass;

41.zh: 随后又有七只母牛上来，又软弱又丑陋又干瘦，在埃及遍地，我没有见过这样不好的。
41.en: and behold, seven other cattle came up after them, poor and very ugly and thin, such as I never saw in all the land of Egypt for ugliness.

41.zh: 这又干瘦又丑陋的母牛吃尽了那以先的七只肥母牛，
41.en: The thin and ugly cattle ate up the first seven fat cattle;

41.zh: 吃了以后却看不出是吃了，那丑陋的样子仍旧和先前一样。我就醒了。
41.en: and when they had eaten them up, it couldn’t be known that they had eaten them, but they were still ugly, as at the beginning. So I awoke.

41.zh: 我又梦见一棵麦子，长了七个穗子，又饱满又佳美，
41.en: I saw in my dream, and behold, seven heads of grain came up on one stalk, full and good;

41.zh: 随后又长了七个穗子，枯槁细弱，被东风吹焦了。
41.en: and behold, seven heads of grain, withered, thin, and blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them.

41.zh: 这些细弱的穗子吞了那七个佳美的穗子。我将这梦告诉了术士，却没有人能给我解说。」
41.en: The thin heads of grain swallowed up the seven good heads of grain. I told it to the magicians, but there was no one who could explain it to me.”

41.zh: 约瑟对法老说：「法老的梦乃是一个。　神已将所要做的事指示法老了。
41.en: Joseph said to Pharaoh, “The dream of Pharaoh is one. What God is about to do he has declared to Pharaoh.

41.zh: 七只好母牛是七年，七个好穗子也是七年；这梦乃是一个。
41.en: The seven good cattle are seven years; and the seven good heads of grain are seven years. The dream is one.

41.zh: 那随后上来的七只又干瘦又丑陋的母牛是七年，那七个虚空、被东风吹焦的穗子也是七年，都是七个荒年。
41.en: The seven thin and ugly cattle that came up after them are seven years, and also the seven empty heads of grain blasted with the east wind; they will be seven years of famine.

41.zh: 这就是我对法老所说，　神已将所要做的事显明给法老了。
41.en: That is the thing which I have spoken to Pharaoh. God has shown Pharaoh what he is about to do.

41.zh: 埃及遍地必来七个大丰年，
41.en: Behold, seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt are coming.

41.zh: 随后又要来七个荒年，甚至在埃及地都忘了先前的丰收，全地必被饥荒所灭。
41.en: Seven years of famine will arise after them, and all the plenty will be forgotten in the land of Egypt. The famine will consume the land,

41.zh: 因那以后的饥荒甚大，便不觉得先前的丰收了。
41.en: and the plenty will not be known in the land by reason of that famine which follows; for it will be very grievous.

41.zh: 至于法老两回做梦，是因　神命定这事，而且必速速成就。
41.en: The dream was doubled to Pharaoh, because the thing is established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.

41.zh: 所以，法老当拣选一个有聪明有智慧的人，派他治理埃及地。
41.en: “Now therefore let Pharaoh look for a discreet and wise man, and set him over the land of Egypt.

41.zh: 法老当这样行，又派官员管理这地。当七个丰年的时候，征收埃及地的五分之一，
41.en: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him appoint overseers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt’s produce in the seven plenteous years.

41.zh: 叫他们把将来丰年一切的粮食聚敛起来，积蓄五谷，收存在各城里做食物，归于法老的手下。
41.en: Let them gather all the food of these good years that come, and store grain under the hand of Pharaoh for food in the cities, and let them keep it.

41.zh: 所积蓄的粮食可以防备埃及地将来的七个荒年，免得这地被饥荒所灭。」
41.en: The food will be to supply the land against the seven years of famine, which will be in the land of Egypt; so that the land will not perish through the famine.”

41.zh: 法老和他一切臣仆都以这事为妙。
41.en: The thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.

41.zh: 法老对臣仆说：「像这样的人，有　神的灵在他里头，我们岂能找得着呢？」
41.en: Pharaoh said to his servants, “Can we find such a one as this, a man in whom is the Spirit of God?”

41.zh: 法老对约瑟说：「　神既将这事都指示你，可见没有人像你这样有聪明有智慧。
41.en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Because God has shown you all of this, there is no one so discreet and wise as you.

41.zh: 你可以掌管我的家；我的民都必听从你的话。惟独在宝座上我比你大。」
41.en: You shall be over my house. All my people will be ruled according to your word. Only in the throne I will be greater than you.”

41.zh: 法老又对约瑟说：「我派你治理埃及全地。」
41.en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I have set you over all the land of Egypt.”

41.zh: 法老就摘下手上打印的戒指，戴在约瑟的手上，给他穿上细麻衣，把金链戴在他的颈项上，
41.en: Pharaoh took off his signet ring from his hand, and put it on Joseph’s hand, and arrayed him in robes of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck.

41.zh: 又叫约瑟坐他的副车，喝道的在前呼叫说：「跪下。」这样，法老派他治理埃及全地。
41.en: He made him ride in the second chariot which he had. They cried before him, “Bow the knee!” He set him over all the land of Egypt.

41.zh: 法老对约瑟说：「我是法老，在埃及全地，若没有你的命令，不许人擅自办事。」
41.en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh. Without you, no man shall lift up his hand or his foot in all the land of Egypt.”

41.zh: 法老赐名给约瑟，叫撒发那忒·巴内亚，又将安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给他为妻。约瑟就出去巡行埃及地。
41.en: Pharaoh called Joseph’s name Zaphenath-Paneah. He gave him Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On as a wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.

41.zh: 约瑟见埃及王法老的时候年三十岁。他从法老面前出去，遍行埃及全地。
41.en: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.

41.zh: 七个丰年之内，地的出产极丰极盛，
41.en: In the seven plenteous years the earth produced abundantly.

41.zh: 约瑟聚敛埃及地七个丰年一切的粮食，把粮食积存在各城里；各城周围田地的粮食都积存在本城里。
41.en: He gathered up all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities. He stored food in each city from the fields around that city.

41.zh: 约瑟积蓄五谷甚多，如同海边的沙，无法计算，因为谷不可胜数。
41.en: Joseph laid up grain as the sand of the sea, very much, until he stopped counting, for it was without number.

41.zh: 荒年未到以前，安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给约瑟生了两个儿子。
41.en: To Joseph were born two sons before the year of famine came, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera priest of On, bore to him.

41.zh: 约瑟给长子起名叫玛拿西，因为[他说]：「　神使我忘了一切的困苦和我父的全家。」
41.en: Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh, “For”, he said, “God has made me forget all my toil, and all my father’s house.”

41.zh: 他给次子起名叫以法莲，因为[他说]：「　神使我在受苦的地方昌盛。」
41.en: The name of the second, he called Ephraim: “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”

41.zh: 埃及地的七个丰年一完，
41.en: The seven years of plenty, that were in the land of Egypt, came to an end.

41.zh: 七个荒年就来了。正如约瑟所说的，各地都有饥荒；惟独埃及全地有粮食。
41.en: The seven years of famine began to come, just as Joseph had said. There was famine in all lands, but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.

41.zh: 及至埃及全地有了饥荒，众民向法老哀求粮食，法老对他们说：「你们往约瑟那里去，凡他所说的，你们都要做。」
41.en: When all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread, and Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph. What he says to you, do.”

41.zh: 当时饥荒遍满天下，约瑟开了各处的仓，粜粮给埃及人；在埃及地饥荒甚大。
41.en: The famine was over all the surface of the earth. Joseph opened all the store houses, and sold to the Egyptians. The famine was severe in the land of Egypt.

41.zh: 各地的人都往埃及去，到约瑟那里籴粮，因为天下的饥荒甚大。
41.en: All countries came into Egypt, to Joseph, to buy grain, because the famine was severe in all the earth.

42.zh: 雅各见埃及有粮，就对儿子们说：「你们为什么彼此观望呢？
42.en: Now Jacob saw that there was grain in Egypt, and Jacob said to his sons, “Why do you look at one another?”

42.zh: 我听见埃及有粮，你们可以下去，从那里为我们籴些来，使我们可以存活，不至于死。」
42.en: He said, “Behold, I have heard that there is grain in Egypt. Go down there, and buy for us from there, so that we may live, and not die.”

42.zh: 于是，约瑟的十个哥哥都下埃及籴粮去了。
42.en: Joseph’s ten brothers went down to buy grain from Egypt.

42.zh: 但约瑟的兄弟便雅悯，雅各没有打发他和哥哥们同去，因为雅各说：「恐怕他遭害。」
42.en: But Jacob didn’t send Benjamin, Joseph’s brother, with his brothers; for he said, “Lest perhaps harm happen to him.”

42.zh: 来籴粮的人中有以色列的儿子们，因为迦南地也有饥荒。
42.en: The sons of Israel came to buy among those who came, for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

42.zh: 当时治理埃及地的是约瑟；粜粮给那地众民的就是他。约瑟的哥哥们来了，脸伏于地，向他下拜。
42.en: Joseph was the governor over the land. It was he who sold to all the people of the land. Joseph’s brothers came, and bowed themselves down to him with their faces to the earth.

42.zh: 约瑟看见他哥哥们，就认得他们，却装作生人，向他们说些严厉话，问他们说：「你们从哪里来？」他们说：「我们从迦南地来籴粮。」
42.en: Joseph saw his brothers, and he recognized them, but acted like a stranger to them, and spoke roughly with them. He said to them, “Where did you come from?” They said, “From the land of Canaan, to buy food.”

42.zh: 约瑟认得他哥哥们，他们却不认得他。
42.en: Joseph recognized his brothers, but they didn’t recognize him.

42.zh: 约瑟想起从前所做的那两个梦，就对他们说：「你们是奸细，来窥探这地的虚实。」
42.en: Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed about them, and said to them, “You are spies! You have come to see the nakedness of the land.”

42.zh: 他们对他说：「我主啊，不是的。仆人们是籴粮来的。
42.en: They said to him, “No, my lord, but your servants have come to buy food.

42.zh: 我们都是一个人的儿子，是诚实人；仆人们并不是奸细。」
42.en: We are all one man’s sons; we are honest men. Your servants are not spies.”

42.zh: 约瑟说：「不然，你们必是窥探这地的虚实来的。」
42.en: He said to them, “No, but you have come to see the nakedness of the land!”

42.zh: 他们说：「仆人们本是弟兄十二人，是迦南地一个人的儿子，顶小的现今在我们的父亲那里，有一个没有了。」
42.en: They said, “We, your servants, are twelve brothers, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and behold, the youngest is today with our father, and one is no more.”

42.zh: 约瑟说：「我才说你们是奸细，这话实在不错。
42.en: Joseph said to them, “It is like I told you, saying, ‘You are spies!’

42.zh: 我指着法老的性命起誓，若是你们的小兄弟不到这里来，你们就不得出这地方，从此就可以把你们证验出来了。
42.en: By this you shall be tested. By the life of Pharaoh, you shall not go out from here, unless your youngest brother comes here.

42.zh: 须要打发你们中间一个人去，把你们的兄弟带来。至于你们，都要囚在这里，好证验你们的话真不真，若不真，我指着法老的性命起誓，你们一定是奸细。」
42.en: Send one of you, and let him get your brother, and you shall be bound, that your words may be tested, whether there is truth in you, or else by the life of Pharaoh surely you are spies.”

42.zh: 于是约瑟把他们都下在监里三天。
42.en: He put them all together into custody for three days.

42.zh: 到第三天，约瑟对他们说：「我是敬畏　神的；你们照我的话行就可以存活。
42.en: Joseph said to them the third day, “Do this, and live, for I fear God.

42.zh: 你们如果是诚实人，可以留你们中间的一个人囚在监里，但你们可以带着粮食回去，救你们家里的饥荒。
42.en: If you are honest men, then let one of your brothers be bound in your prison; but you go, carry grain for the famine of your houses.

42.zh: 把你们的小兄弟带到我这里来，如此，你们的话便有证据，你们也不至于死。」他们就照样而行。
42.en: Bring your youngest brother to me; so will your words be verified, and you won’t die.” They did so.

42.zh: 他们彼此说：「我们在兄弟身上实在有罪。他哀求我们的时候，我们见他心里的愁苦，却不肯听，所以这场苦难临到我们身上。」
42.en: They said to one another, “We are certainly guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the distress of his soul, when he begged us, and we wouldn’t listen. Therefore this distress has come upon us.”

42.zh: 吕便说：「我岂不是对你们说过，不可伤害那孩子吗？只是你们不肯听，所以流他血的罪向我们追讨。」
42.en: Reuben answered them, saying, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘Don’t sin against the child,’ and you wouldn’t listen? Therefore also, behold, his blood is required.”

42.zh: 他们不知道约瑟听得出来，因为在他们中间用通事传话。
42.en: They didn’t know that Joseph understood them; for there was an interpreter between them.

42.zh: 约瑟转身退去，哭了一场，又回来对他们说话，就从他们中间挑出西缅来，在他们眼前把他捆绑。
42.en: He turned himself away from them, and wept. Then he returned to them, and spoke to them, and took Simeon from among them, and bound him before their eyes.

42.zh: 约瑟吩咐人把粮食装满他们的器具，把各人的银子归还在各人的口袋里，又给他们路上用的食物，人就照他的话办了。
42.en: Then Joseph gave a command to fill their bags with grain, and to restore each man’s money into his sack, and to give them food for the way. So it was done to them.

42.zh: 他们就把粮食驮在驴上，离开那里去了。
42.en: They loaded their donkeys with their grain, and departed from there.

42.zh: 到了住宿的地方，他们中间有一个人打开口袋，要拿料喂驴，才看见自己的银子仍在口袋里，
42.en: As one of them opened his sack to give his donkey food in the lodging place, he saw his money. Behold, it was in the mouth of his sack.

42.zh: 就对弟兄们说：「我的银子归还了，看哪，仍在我口袋里！」他们就提心吊胆，战战兢兢地彼此说：「这是　神向我们做什么呢？」
42.en: He said to his brothers, “My money is restored! Behold, it is in my sack!” Their hearts failed them, and they turned trembling to one another, saying, “What is this that God has done to us?”

42.zh: 他们来到迦南地、他们的父亲雅各那里，将所遭遇的事都告诉他，说：
42.en: They came to Jacob their father, to the land of Canaan, and told him all that had happened to them, saying,

42.zh: 「那地的主对我们说严厉的话，把我们当作窥探那地的奸细。
42.en: “The man, the lord of the land, spoke roughly with us, and took us for spies of the country.

42.zh: 我们对他说：『我们是诚实人，并不是奸细。
42.en: We said to him, ‘We are honest men. We are no spies.

42.zh: 我们本是弟兄十二人，都是一个父亲的儿子，有一个没有了，顶小的如今同我们的父亲在迦南地。』
42.en: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is no more, and the youngest is today with our father in the land of Canaan.’

42.zh: 那地的主对我们说：『若要我知道你们是诚实人，可以留下你们中间的一个人在我这里，你们可以带着[粮食]回去，救你们家里的饥荒。
42.en: The man, the lord of the land, said to us, ‘By this I will know that you are honest men: leave one of your brothers with me, and take grain for the famine of your houses, and go your way.

42.zh: 把你们的小兄弟带到我这里来，我便知道你们不是奸细，乃是诚实人。这样，我就把你们的弟兄交给你们，你们也可以在这地做买卖。』」
42.en: Bring your youngest brother to me. Then I will know that you are not spies, but that you are honest men. So I will deliver your brother to you, and you shall trade in the land.’”

42.zh: 后来他们倒口袋，不料，各人的银包都在口袋里；他们和父亲看见银包就都害怕。
42.en: As they emptied their sacks, behold, each man’s bundle of money was in his sack. When they and their father saw their bundles of money, they were afraid.

42.zh: 他们的父亲雅各对他们说：「你们使我丧失我的儿子：约瑟没有了，西缅也没有了，你们又要将便雅悯带去；这些事都归到我身上了。」
42.en: Jacob, their father, said to them, “You have bereaved me of my children! Joseph is no more, Simeon is no more, and you want to take Benjamin away. All these things are against me.”

42.zh: 吕便对他父亲说：「我若不带他回来交给你，你可以杀我的两个儿子。只管把他交在我手里，我必带他回来交给你。」
42.en: Reuben spoke to his father, saying, “Kill my two sons, if I don’t bring him to you. Entrust him to my care, and I will bring him to you again.”

42.zh: 雅各说：「我的儿子不可与你们一同下去；他哥哥死了，只剩下他，他若在你们所行的路上遭害，那便是你们使我白发苍苍、悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。」
42.en: He said, “My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he only is left. If harm happens to him along the way in which you go, then you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.”

43.zh: 那地的饥荒甚大。
43.en: The famine was severe in the land.

43.zh: 他们从埃及带来的粮食吃尽了，他们的父亲就对他们说：「你们再去给我籴些粮来。」
43.en: When they had eaten up the grain which they had brought out of Egypt, their father said to them, “Go again, buy us a little more food.”

43.zh: 犹大对他说：「那人谆谆地告诫我们说：『你们的兄弟若不与你们同来，你们就不得见我的面。』
43.en: Judah spoke to him, saying, “The man solemnly warned us, saying, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’

43.zh: 你若打发我们的兄弟与我们同去，我们就下去给你籴粮；
43.en: If you’ll send our brother with us, we’ll go down and buy you food;

43.zh: 你若不打发他去，我们就不下去，因为那人对我们说：『你们的兄弟若不与你们同来，你们就不得见我的面。』」
43.en: but if you don’t send him, we won’t go down, for the man said to us, ‘You shall not see my face, unless your brother is with you.’”

43.zh: 以色列说：「你们为什么这样害我，告诉那人你们还有兄弟呢？」
43.en: Israel said, “Why did you treat me so badly, telling the man that you had another brother?”

43.zh: 他们回答说：「那人详细问到我们和我们的亲属，说：『你们的父亲还在吗？你们还有兄弟吗？』我们就按着他所问的告诉他，焉能知道他要说『必须把你们的兄弟带下来』呢？」
43.en: They said, “The man asked directly concerning ourselves, and concerning our relatives, saying, ‘Is your father still alive? Have you another brother?’ We just answered his questions. Is there any way we could know that he would say, ‘Bring your brother down’?”

43.zh: 犹大又对他父亲以色列说：「你打发童子与我同去，我们就起身下去，好叫我们和你，并我们的[妇人]孩子，都得存活，不至于死。
43.en: Judah said to Israel, his father, “Send the boy with me, and we’ll get up and go, so that we may live, and not die, both we, and you, and also our little ones.

43.zh: 我为他作保；你可以从我手中追讨，我若不带他回来交在你面前，我情愿永远担罪。
43.en: I’ll be collateral for him. From my hand will you require him. If I don’t bring him to you, and set him before you, then let me bear the blame forever;

43.zh: 我们若没有耽搁，如今第二次都回来了。」
43.en: for if we hadn’t delayed, surely we would have returned a second time by now.”

43.zh: 他们的父亲以色列说：「若必须如此，你们就当这样行：可以将这地土产中最好的乳香、蜂蜜、香料、没药、榧子、杏仁都取一点，收在器具里，带下去送给那人作礼物，
43.en: Their father, Israel, said to them, “If it must be so, then do this: Take from the choice fruits of the land in your bags, and carry down a present for the man, a little balm, a little honey, spices and myrrh, nuts, and almonds;

43.zh: 又要手里加倍地带银子，并将归还在你们口袋内的银子仍带在手里；那或者是错了。
43.en: and take double money in your hand, and take back the money that was returned in the mouth of your sacks. Perhaps it was an oversight.

43.zh: 也带着你们的兄弟，起身去见那人。
43.en: Take your brother also, get up, and return to the man.

43.zh: 但愿全能的　神使你们在那人面前蒙怜悯，释放你们的那弟兄和便雅悯回来。我若丧了儿子，就丧了吧！」
43.en: May God Almighty give you mercy before the man, that he may release to you your other brother and Benjamin. If I am bereaved of my children, I am bereaved.”

43.zh: 于是，他们拿着那礼物，又手里加倍地带银子，并且带着便雅悯，起身下到埃及，站在约瑟面前。
43.en: The men took that present, and they took double money in their hand, and Benjamin; and got up, went down to Egypt, and stood before Joseph.

43.zh: 约瑟见便雅悯和他们同来，就对家宰说：「将这些人领到屋里。要宰杀牲畜，预备[筵席]，因为晌午这些人同我吃饭。」
43.en: When Joseph saw Benjamin with them, he said to the steward of his house, “Bring the men into the house, and butcher an animal, and prepare; for the men will dine with me at noon.”

43.zh: 家宰就遵着约瑟的命去行，领他们进约瑟的屋里。
43.en: The man did as Joseph commanded, and the man brought the men to Joseph’s house.

43.zh: 他们因为被领到约瑟的屋里，就害怕，说：「领我们到这里来，必是因为头次归还在我们口袋里的银子，找我们的错缝，下手害我们，强取我们为奴仆，抢夺我们的驴。」
43.en: The men were afraid, because they were brought to Joseph’s house; and they said, “Because of the money that was returned in our sacks the first time, we’re brought in; that he may seek occasion against us, attack us, and seize us as slaves, along with our donkeys.”

43.zh: 他们就挨近约瑟的家宰，在屋门口和他说话，
43.en: They came near to the steward of Joseph’s house, and they spoke to him at the door of the house,

43.zh: 说：「我主啊，我们头次下来实在是要籴粮。
43.en: and said, “Oh, my lord, we indeed came down the first time to buy food.

43.zh: 后来到了住宿的地方，我们打开口袋，不料，各人的银子，分量足数，仍在各人的口袋内，现在我们手里又带回来了。
43.en: When we came to the lodging place, we opened our sacks, and behold, each man’s money was in the mouth of his sack, our money in full weight. We have brought it back in our hand.

43.zh: 另外又带下银子来籴粮。不知道先前谁把银子放在我们的口袋里。」
43.en: We have brought down other money in our hand to buy food. We don’t know who put our money in our sacks.”

43.zh: 家宰说：「你们可以放心，不要害怕，是你们的　神和你们父亲的　神赐给你们财宝在你们的口袋里；你们的银子，我早已收了。」他就把西缅带出来，交给他们。
43.en: He said, “Peace be to you. Don’t be afraid. Your God, and the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks. I received your money.” He brought Simeon out to them.

43.zh: 家宰就领他们进约瑟的屋里，给他们水洗脚，又给他们草料喂驴。
43.en: The man brought the men into Joseph’s house, and gave them water, and they washed their feet. He gave their donkeys fodder.

43.zh: 他们就预备那礼物，等候约瑟晌午来，因为他们听见要在那里吃饭。
43.en: They prepared the present for Joseph’s coming at noon, for they heard that they should eat bread there.

43.zh: 约瑟来到家里，他们就把手中的礼物拿进屋去给他，又俯伏在地，向他下拜。
43.en: When Joseph came home, they brought him the present which was in their hand into the house, and bowed themselves down to the earth before him.

43.zh: 约瑟问他们好，又问：「你们的父亲—就是你们所说的那老人家平安吗？他还在吗？」
43.en: He asked them of their welfare, and said, “Is your father well, the old man of whom you spoke? Is he yet alive?”

43.zh: 他们回答说：「你仆人—我们的父亲平安；他还在。」于是他们低头下拜。
43.en: They said, “Your servant, our father, is well. He is still alive.” They bowed down humbly.

43.zh: 约瑟举目看见他同母的兄弟便雅悯，就说：「你们向我所说那顶小的兄弟就是这位吗？」又说：「小儿啊，愿　神赐恩给你！」
43.en: He lifted up his eyes, and saw Benjamin, his brother, his mother’s son, and said, “Is this your youngest brother, of whom you spoke to me?” He said, “God be gracious to you, my son.”

43.zh: 约瑟爱弟之情发动，就急忙寻找可哭之地，进入自己的屋里，哭了一场。
43.en: Joseph hurried, for his heart yearned over his brother; and he sought a place to weep. He entered into his room, and wept there.

43.zh: 他洗了脸出来，勉强隐忍，吩咐人摆饭。
43.en: He washed his face, and came out. He controlled himself, and said, “Serve the meal.”

43.zh: 他们就为约瑟单摆了一席，为那些人又摆了一席，也为和约瑟同吃饭的埃及人另摆了一席，因为埃及人不可和希伯来人一同吃饭；那原是埃及人所厌恶的。
43.en: They served him by himself, and them by themselves, and the Egyptians who ate with him by themselves, because the Egyptians don’t eat with the Hebrews, for that is an abomination to the Egyptians.

43.zh: 约瑟使众弟兄在他面前排列坐席，都按着长幼的次序，众弟兄就彼此诧异。
43.en: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his youth, and the men marveled with one another.

43.zh: 约瑟把他面前的食物分出来，送给他们；但便雅悯所得的比别人多五倍。他们就饮酒，和约瑟一同宴乐。
43.en: He sent portions to them from before him, but Benjamin’s portion was five times as much as any of theirs. They drank, and were merry with him.

44.zh: 约瑟吩咐家宰说：「把粮食装满这些人的口袋，尽着他们的驴所能驮的，又把各人的银子放在各人的口袋里，
44.en: He commanded the steward of his house, saying, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s money in his sack’s mouth.

44.zh: 并将我的银杯和那少年人籴粮的银子一同装在他的口袋里。」家宰就照约瑟所说的话行了；
44.en: Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, with his grain money.” He did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

44.zh: 天一亮就打发那些人带着驴走了。
44.en: As soon as the morning was light, the men were sent away, they and their donkeys.

44.zh: 他们出城走了不远，约瑟对家宰说：「起来，追那些人去，追上了就对他们说：『你们为什么以恶报善呢？
44.en: When they had gone out of the city, and were not yet far off, Joseph said to his steward, “Up, follow after the men. When you overtake them, ask them, ‘Why have you rewarded evil for good?

44.zh: 这不是我主人饮酒的杯吗？岂不是他占卜用的吗？你们这样行是作恶了。』」
44.en: Isn’t this that from which my lord drinks, and by which he indeed divines? You have done evil in so doing.’”

44.zh: 家宰追上他们，将这些话对他们说了。
44.en: He overtook them, and he spoke these words to them.

44.zh: 他们回答说：「我主为什么说这样的话呢？你仆人断不能做这样的事。
44.en: They said to him, “Why does my lord speak such words as these? Far be it from your servants that they should do such a thing!

44.zh: 你看，我们从前在口袋里所见的银子，尚且从迦南地带来还你，我们怎能从你主人家里偷窃金银呢？
44.en: Behold, the money, which we found in our sacks’ mouths, we brought again to you out of the land of Canaan. How then should we steal silver or gold out of your lord’s house?

44.zh: 你仆人中无论在谁那里搜出来，就叫他死，我们也作我主的奴仆。」
44.en: With whomever of your servants it is found, let him die, and we also will be my lord’s slaves.”

44.zh: 家宰说：「现在就照你们的话行吧！在谁那里搜出来，谁就作我的奴仆；其余的都没有罪。」
44.en: He said, “Now also let it be according to your words. He with whom it is found will be my slave; and you will be blameless.”

44.zh: 于是他们各人急忙把口袋卸在地上，各人打开口袋。
44.en: Then they hurried, and each man took his sack down to the ground, and each man opened his sack.

44.zh: 家宰就搜查，从年长的起到年幼的为止，那杯竟在便雅悯的口袋里搜出来。
44.en: He searched, beginning with the oldest, and ending at the youngest. The cup was found in Benjamin’s sack.

44.zh: 他们就撕裂衣服，各人把驮子抬在驴上，回城去了。
44.en: Then they tore their clothes, and each man loaded his donkey, and returned to the city.

44.zh: 犹大和他弟兄们来到约瑟的屋中，约瑟还在那里，他们就在他面前俯伏于地。
44.en: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph’s house, and he was still there. They fell on the ground before him.

44.zh: 约瑟对他们说：「你们做的是什么事呢？你们岂不知像我这样的人必能占卜吗？」
44.en: Joseph said to them, “What deed is this that you have done? Don’t you know that such a man as I can indeed do divination?”

44.zh: 犹大说：「我们对我主说什么呢？还有什么话可说呢？我们怎能自己表白出来呢？　神已经查出仆人的罪孽了。我们与那在他手中搜出杯来的都是我主的奴仆。」
44.en: Judah said, “What will we tell my lord? What will we speak? How will we clear ourselves? God has found out the iniquity of your servants. Behold, we are my lord’s slaves, both we and he also in whose hand the cup is found.”

44.zh: 约瑟说：「我断不能这样行！在谁的手中搜出杯来，谁就作我的奴仆；至于你们，可以平平安安地上你们父亲那里去。」
44.en: He said, “Far be it from me that I should do so. The man in whose hand the cup is found, he will be my slave; but as for you, go up in peace to your father.”

44.zh: 犹大挨近他，说：「我主啊，求你容仆人说一句话给我主听，不要向仆人发烈怒，因为你如同法老一样。
44.en: Then Judah came near to him, and said, “Oh, my lord, please let your servant speak a word in my lord’s ears, and don’t let your anger burn against your servant; for you are even as Pharaoh.

44.zh: 我主曾问仆人们说：『你们有父亲有兄弟没有？』
44.en: My lord asked his servants, saying, ‘Have you a father, or a brother?’

44.zh: 我们对我主说：『我们有父亲，已经年老，还有他老年所生的一个小孩子。他哥哥死了，他母亲只撇下他一人，他父亲疼爱他。』
44.en: We said to my lord, ‘We have a father, an old man, and a child of his old age, a little one; and his brother is dead, and he alone is left of his mother; and his father loves him.’

44.zh: 你对仆人说：『把他带到我这里来，叫我亲眼看看他。』
44.en: You said to your servants, ‘Bring him down to me, that I may set my eyes on him.’

44.zh: 我们对我主说：『童子不能离开他父亲，若是离开，他父亲必死。』
44.en: We said to my lord, ‘The boy can’t leave his father, for if he should leave his father, his father would die.’

44.zh: 你对仆人说：『你们的小兄弟若不与你们一同下来，你们就不得再见我的面。』
44.en: You said to your servants, ‘Unless your youngest brother comes down with you, you will see my face no more.’

44.zh: 我们上到你仆人—我们父亲那里，就把我主的话告诉了他。
44.en: When we came up to your servant my father, we told him the words of my lord.

44.zh: 我们的父亲说：『你们再去给我籴些粮来。』
44.en: Our father said, ‘Go again and buy us a little food.’

44.zh: 我们就说：『我们不能下去。我们的小兄弟若和我们同往，我们就可以下去。因为，小兄弟若不与我们同往，我们必不得见那人的面。』
44.en: We said, ‘We can’t go down. If our youngest brother is with us, then we will go down: for we may not see the man’s face, unless our youngest brother is with us.’

44.zh: 你仆人—我父亲对我们说：『你们知道我的妻子给我生了两个儿子。
44.en: Your servant, my father, said to us, ‘You know that my wife bore me two sons.

44.zh: 一个离开我出去了；我说他必是被撕碎了，直到如今我也没有见他。
44.en: One went out from me, and I said, “Surely he is torn in pieces;” and I haven’t seen him since.

44.zh: 现在你们又要把这个带去离开我，倘若他遭害，那便是你们使我白发苍苍、悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。』
44.en: If you take this one also from me, and harm happens to him, you will bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to Sheol.’

44.zh: 我父亲的命与这童子的命相连。如今我回到你仆人—我父亲那里，若没有童子与我们同在，
44.en: Now therefore when I come to your servant my father, and the boy is not with us; since his life is bound up in the boy’s life;

44.zh: 我们的父亲见没有童子，他就必死。这便是我们使你仆人—我们的父亲白发苍苍、悲悲惨惨地下阴间去了。
44.en: it will happen, when he sees that the boy is no more, that he will die. Your servants will bring down the gray hairs of your servant, our father, with sorrow to Sheol.

44.zh: 因为仆人曾向我父亲为这童子作保，说：『我若不带他回来交给父亲，我便在父亲面前永远担罪。』
44.en: For your servant became collateral for the boy to my father, saying, ‘If I don’t bring him to you, then I will bear the blame to my father forever.’

44.zh: 现在求你容仆人住下，替这童子作我主的奴仆，叫童子和他哥哥们一同上去。
44.en: Now therefore, please let your servant stay instead of the boy, my lord’s slave; and let the boy go up with his brothers.

44.zh: 若童子不和我同去，我怎能上去见我父亲呢？恐怕我看见灾祸临到我父亲身上。」
44.en: For how will I go up to my father, if the boy isn’t with me?—lest I see the evil that will come on my father.”

45.zh: 约瑟在左右站着的人面前情不自禁，吩咐一声说：「人都要离开我出去！」约瑟和弟兄们相认的时候并没有一人站在他面前。
45.en: Then Joseph couldn’t control himself before all those who stood before him, and he called out, “Cause everyone to go out from me!” No one else stood with him, while Joseph made himself known to his brothers.

45.zh: 他就放声大哭；埃及人和法老家中的人都听见了。
45.en: He wept aloud. The Egyptians heard, and the house of Pharaoh heard.

45.zh: 约瑟对他弟兄们说：「我是约瑟。我的父亲还在吗？」他弟兄不能回答，因为在他面前都惊惶。
45.en: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am Joseph! Does my father still live?” His brothers couldn’t answer him; for they were terrified at his presence.

45.zh: 约瑟又对他弟兄们说：「请你们近前来。」他们就近前来。他说：「我是你们的兄弟约瑟，就是你们所卖到埃及的。
45.en: Joseph said to his brothers, “Come near to me, please.” They came near. He said, “I am Joseph, your brother, whom you sold into Egypt.

45.zh: 现在，不要因为把我卖到这里自忧自恨。这是　神差我在你们以先来，为要保全生命。
45.en: Now don’t be grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me here, for God sent me before you to preserve life.

45.zh: 现在这地的饥荒已经二年了，还有五年不能耕种，不能收成。
45.en: For these two years the famine has been in the land, and there are yet five years, in which there will be no plowing and no harvest.

45.zh: 神差我在你们以先来，为要给你们存留余种在世上，又要大施拯救，保全你们的生命。
45.en: God sent me before you to preserve for you a remnant on the earth, and to save you alive by a great deliverance.

45.zh: 这样看来，差我到这里来的不是你们，乃是　神。他又使我如法老的父，作他全家的主，并埃及全地的宰相。
45.en: So now it wasn’t you who sent me here, but God, and he has made me a father to Pharaoh, lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.

45.zh: 你们要赶紧上到我父亲那里，对他说：『你儿子约瑟这样说：　神使我作全埃及的主，请你下到我这里来，不要耽延。
45.en: Hurry, and go up to my father, and tell him, ‘This is what your son Joseph says, “God has made me lord of all Egypt. Come down to me. Don’t wait.

45.zh: 你和你的儿子孙子，连牛群羊群，并一切所有的，都可以住在歌珊地，与我相近。
45.en: You shall dwell in the land of Goshen, and you will be near to me, you, your children, your children’s children, your flocks, your herds, and all that you have.

45.zh: 我要在那里奉养你；因为还有五年的饥荒，免得你和你的眷属，并一切所有的，都败落了。』
45.en: There I will provide for you; for there are yet five years of famine; lest you come to poverty, you, and your household, and all that you have.”’

45.zh: 况且你们的眼和我兄弟便雅悯的眼都看见是我亲口对你们说话。
45.en: Behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that it is my mouth that speaks to you.

45.zh: 你们也要将我在埃及一切的荣耀和你们所看见的事都告诉我父亲，又要赶紧地将我父亲搬到我这里来。」
45.en: You shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that you have seen. You shall hurry and bring my father down here.”

45.zh: 于是约瑟伏在他兄弟便雅悯的颈项上哭，便雅悯也在他的颈项上哭。
45.en: He fell on his brother Benjamin’s neck and wept, and Benjamin wept on his neck.

45.zh: 他又与众弟兄亲嘴，抱着他们哭，随后他弟兄们就和他说话。
45.en: He kissed all his brothers, and wept on them. After that his brothers talked with him.

45.zh: 这风声传到法老的宫里，说：「约瑟的弟兄们来了。」法老和他的臣仆都很喜欢。
45.en: The report of it was heard in Pharaoh’s house, saying, “Joseph’s brothers have come.” It pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants.

45.zh: 法老对约瑟说：「你吩咐你的弟兄们说：『你们要这样行：把驮子抬在牲口上，起身往迦南地去。
45.en: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Tell your brothers, ‘Do this: Load your animals, and go, travel to the land of Canaan.

45.zh: 将你们的父亲和你们的眷属都搬到我这里来，我要把埃及地的美物赐给你们，你们也要吃这地肥美的出产。
45.en: Take your father and your households, and come to me, and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and you will eat the fat of the land.’

45.zh: 现在我吩咐你们要这样行：从埃及地带着车辆去，把你们的孩子和妻子，并你们的父亲都搬来。
45.en: Now you are commanded to do this: Take wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

45.zh: 你们眼中不要爱惜你们的家具，因为埃及全地的美物都是你们的。』」
45.en: Also, don’t concern yourselves about your belongings, for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.”

45.zh: 以色列的儿子们就如此行。约瑟照着法老的吩咐给他们车辆和路上用的食物，
45.en: The sons of Israel did so. Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way.

45.zh: 又给他们各人一套衣服，惟独给便雅悯三百银子，五套衣服；
45.en: He gave each one of them changes of clothing, but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver and five changes of clothing.

45.zh: 送给他父亲公驴十匹，驮着埃及的美物，母驴十匹，驮着粮食与饼和菜，为他父亲路上用。
45.en: He sent the following to his father: ten donkeys loaded with the good things of Egypt, and ten female donkeys loaded with grain and bread and provision for his father by the way.

45.zh: 于是约瑟打发他弟兄们回去，又对他们说：「你们不要在路上相争。」
45.en: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, “See that you don’t quarrel on the way.”

45.zh: 他们从埃及上去，来到迦南地、他们的父亲雅各那里，
45.en: They went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan, to Jacob their father.

45.zh: 告诉他说：「约瑟还在，并且作埃及全地的宰相。」雅各心里冰凉，因为不信他们。
45.en: They told him, saying, “Joseph is still alive, and he is ruler over all the land of Egypt.” His heart fainted, for he didn’t believe them.

45.zh: 他们便将约瑟对他们说的一切话都告诉了他。他们父亲雅各又看见约瑟打发来接他的车辆，心就苏醒了。
45.en: They told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said to them. When he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob, their father, revived.

45.zh: 以色列说：「罢了！罢了！我的儿子约瑟还在，趁我未死以先，我要去见他一面。」
45.en: Israel said, “It is enough. Joseph my son is still alive. I will go and see him before I die.”

46.zh: 以色列带着一切所有的，起身来到别是巴，就献祭给他父亲以撒的　神。
46.en: Israel traveled with all that he had, and came to Beersheba, and offered sacrifices to the God of his father, Isaac.

46.zh: 夜间，　神在异象中对以色列说：「雅各！雅各！」他说：「我在这里。」
46.en: God spoke to Israel in the visions of the night, and said, “Jacob, Jacob!” He said, “Here I am.”

46.zh: 神说：「我是　神，就是你父亲的　神。你下埃及去不要害怕，因为我必使你在那里成为大族。
46.en: He said, “I am God, the God of your father. Don’t be afraid to go down into Egypt, for there I will make of you a great nation.

46.zh: 我要和你同下埃及去，也必定带你上来；约瑟必给你送终。」
46.en: I will go down with you into Egypt. I will also surely bring you up again. Joseph’s hand will close your eyes.”

46.zh: 雅各就从别是巴起行。以色列的儿子们使他们的父亲雅各和他们的妻子、儿女都坐在法老为雅各送来的车上。
46.en: Jacob rose up from Beersheba, and the sons of Israel carried Jacob, their father, their little ones, and their wives, in the wagons which Pharaoh had sent to carry him.

46.zh: 他们又带着迦南地所得的牲畜、货财来到埃及。雅各和他的一切子孙都一同来了。
46.en: They took their livestock, and their goods, which they had gotten in the land of Canaan, and came into Egypt—Jacob, and all his offspring with him,

46.zh: 雅各把他的儿子、孙子、女儿、孙女，并他的子子孙孙，一同带到埃及。
46.en: his sons, and his sons’ sons with him, his daughters, and his sons’ daughters, and he brought all his offspring with him into Egypt.

46.zh: 来到埃及的以色列人名字记在下面。雅各和他的儿孙：雅各的长子是吕便。
46.en: These are the names of the children of Israel, who came into Egypt, Jacob and his sons: Reuben, Jacob’s firstborn.

46.zh: 吕便的儿子是哈诺、法路、希斯伦、迦米。
46.en: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

46.zh: 西缅的儿子是耶母利、雅悯、阿辖、雅斤、琐辖，还有迦南女子所生的扫罗。
46.en: The sons of Simeon: Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar, and Shaul the son of a Canaanite woman.

46.zh: 利未的儿子是革顺、哥辖、米拉利。
46.en: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

46.zh: 犹大的儿子是珥、俄南、示拉、法勒斯、谢拉；惟有珥与俄南死在迦南地。法勒斯的儿子是希斯 、哈母勒。
46.en: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, Shelah, Perez, and Zerah; but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.

46.zh: 以萨迦的儿子是陀拉、普瓦、约伯、伸 。
46.en: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puvah, Iob, and Shimron.

46.zh: 西布伦的儿子是西烈、以伦、雅利。
46.en: The sons of Zebulun: Sered, Elon, and Jahleel.

46.zh: 这是利亚在巴旦·亚兰给雅各所生的儿子，还有女儿底拿。儿孙共有三十三人。
46.en: These are the sons of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob in Paddan Aram, with his daughter Dinah. All the souls of his sons and his daughters were thirty-three.

46.zh: 迦得的儿子是洗非芸、哈基、书尼、以斯本、以利、亚罗底、亚列利。
46.en: The sons of Gad: Ziphion, Haggi, Shuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, and Areli.

46.zh: 亚设的儿子是音拿、亦施瓦、亦施韦、比利亚，还有他们的妹子西拉。比利亚的儿子是希别、玛结。
46.en: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and Serah their sister. The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.

46.zh: 这是拉班给他女儿利亚的婢女悉帕从雅各所生的儿孙，共有十六人。
46.en: These are the sons of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to Leah, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob, even sixteen souls.

46.zh: 雅各之妻拉结的儿子是约瑟和便雅悯。
46.en: The sons of Rachel, Jacob’s wife: Joseph and Benjamin.

46.zh: 约瑟在埃及地生了玛拿西和以法莲，就是安城的祭司波提非拉的女儿亚西纳给约瑟生的。
46.en: To Joseph in the land of Egypt were born Manasseh and Ephraim, whom Asenath, the daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore to him.

46.zh: 便雅悯的儿子是比拉、比结、亚实别、基拉、乃幔、以希、罗实、母平、户平、亚勒。
46.en: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.

46.zh: 这是拉结给雅各所生的儿孙，共有十四人。
46.en: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

46.zh: 但的儿子是户伸。
46.en: The son of Dan: Hushim.

46.zh: 拿弗他利的儿子是雅薛、沽尼、耶色、示冷。
46.en: The sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel, Guni, Jezer, and Shillem.

46.zh: 这是拉班给他女儿拉结的婢女辟拉从雅各所生的儿孙，共有七人。
46.en: These are the sons of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to Rachel, his daughter, and these she bore to Jacob: all the souls were seven.

46.zh: 那与雅各同到埃及的，除了他儿妇之外，凡从他所生的，共有六十六人。
46.en: All the souls who came with Jacob into Egypt, who were his direct offspring, in addition to Jacob’s sons’ wives, all the souls were sixty-six.
