46.zh: 还有约瑟在埃及所生的两个儿子。雅各家来到埃及的共有七十人。
46.en: The sons of Joseph, who were born to him in Egypt, were two souls. All the souls of the house of Jacob, who came into Egypt, were seventy.

46.zh: 雅各打发犹大先去见约瑟，请派人引路往歌珊去；于是他们来到歌珊地。
46.en: Jacob sent Judah before him to Joseph, to show the way before him to Goshen, and they came into the land of Goshen.

46.zh: 约瑟套车往歌珊去，迎接他父亲以色列，及至见了面，就伏在父亲的颈项上，哭了许久。
46.en: Joseph prepared his chariot, and went up to meet Israel, his father, in Goshen. He presented himself to him, and fell on his neck, and wept on his neck a good while.

46.zh: 以色列对约瑟说：「我既得见你的面，知道你还在，就是死我也甘心。」
46.en: Israel said to Joseph, “Now let me die, since I have seen your face, that you are still alive.”

46.zh: 约瑟对他的弟兄和他父的全家说：「我要上去告诉法老，对他说：『我的弟兄和我父的全家从前在迦南地，现今都到我这里来了。
46.en: Joseph said to his brothers, and to his father’s house, “I will go up, and speak with Pharaoh, and will tell him, ‘My brothers, and my father’s house, who were in the land of Canaan, have come to me.

46.zh: 他们本是牧羊的人，以养牲畜为业；他们把羊群牛群和一切所有的都带来了。』
46.en: These men are shepherds, for they have been keepers of livestock, and they have brought their flocks, and their herds, and all that they have.’

46.zh: 等法老召你们的时候，问你们说：『你们以何事为业？』
46.en: It will happen, when Pharaoh summons you, and will say, ‘What is your occupation?’

46.zh: 你们要说：『你的仆人，从幼年直到如今，都以养牲畜为业，连我们的祖宗也都以此为业。』这样，你们可以住在歌珊地，因为凡牧羊的都被埃及人所厌恶。」
46.en: that you shall say, ‘Your servants have been keepers of livestock from our youth even until now, both we, and our fathers:’ that you may dwell in the land of Goshen; for every shepherd is an abomination to the Egyptians.”

47.zh: 约瑟进去告诉法老说：「我的父亲和我的弟兄带着羊群牛群，并一切所有的，从迦南地来了，如今在歌珊地。」
47.en: Then Joseph went in and told Pharaoh, and said, “My father and my brothers, with their flocks, their herds, and all that they own, have come out of the land of Canaan; and behold, they are in the land of Goshen.”

47.zh: 约瑟从他弟兄中挑出五个人来，引他们去见法老。
47.en: From among his brothers he took five men, and presented them to Pharaoh.

47.zh: 法老问约瑟的弟兄说：「你们以何事为业？」他们对法老说：「你仆人是牧羊的，连我们的祖宗也是牧羊的。」
47.en: Pharaoh said to his brothers, “What is your occupation?” They said to Pharaoh, “Your servants are shepherds, both we, and our fathers.”

47.zh: 他们又对法老说：「迦南地的饥荒甚大，仆人的羊群没有草吃，所以我们来到这地寄居。现在求你容仆人住在歌珊地。」
47.en: They also said to Pharaoh, “We have come to live as foreigners in the land, for there is no pasture for your servants’ flocks. For the famine is severe in the land of Canaan. Now therefore, please let your servants dwell in the land of Goshen.”

47.zh: 法老对约瑟说：「你父亲和你弟兄到你这里来了，
47.en: Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, “Your father and your brothers have come to you.

47.zh: 埃及地都在你面前，只管叫你父亲和你弟兄住在国中最好的地；他们可以住在歌珊地。你若知道他们中间有什么能人，就派他们看管我的牲畜。」
47.en: The land of Egypt is before you. Make your father and your brothers dwell in the best of the land. Let them dwell in the land of Goshen. If you know any able men among them, then put them in charge of my livestock.”

47.zh: 约瑟领他父亲雅各进到法老面前，雅各就给法老祝福。
47.en: Joseph brought in Jacob, his father, and set him before Pharaoh; and Jacob blessed Pharaoh.

47.zh: 法老问雅各说：「你平生的年日是多少呢？」
47.en: Pharaoh said to Jacob, “How old are you?”

47.zh: 雅各对法老说：「我寄居在世的年日是一百三十岁，我平生的年日又少又苦，不及我列祖在世寄居的年日。」
47.en: Jacob said to Pharaoh, “The years of my pilgrimage are one hundred thirty years. The days of the years of my life have been few and evil. They have not attained to the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.”

47.zh: 雅各又给法老祝福，就从法老面前出去了。
47.en: Jacob blessed Pharaoh, and went out from the presence of Pharaoh.

47.zh: 约瑟遵着法老的命，把埃及国最好的地，就是兰塞境内的地，给他父亲和弟兄居住，作为产业。
47.en: Joseph placed his father and his brothers, and gave them a possession in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, in the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded.

47.zh: 约瑟用粮食奉养他父亲和他弟兄，并他父亲全家的眷属，都是照各家的人口奉养他们。
47.en: Joseph provided his father, his brothers, and all of his father’s household with bread, according to the sizes of their families.

47.zh: 饥荒甚大，全地都绝了粮，甚至埃及地和迦南地[的人]因那饥荒的缘故都饿昏了。
47.en: There was no bread in all the land; for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan fainted by reason of the famine.

47.zh: 约瑟收聚了埃及地和迦南地所有的银子，就是众人籴粮的银子，约瑟就把那银子带到法老的宫里。
47.en: Joseph gathered up all the money that was found in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, for the grain which they bought: and Joseph brought the money into Pharaoh’s house.

47.zh: 埃及地和迦南地的银子都花尽了，埃及众人都来见约瑟，说：「我们的银子都用尽了，求你给我们粮食，我们为什么死在你面前呢？」
47.en: When the money was all spent in the land of Egypt, and in the land of Canaan, all the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, “Give us bread, for why should we die in your presence? For our money fails.”

47.zh: 约瑟说：「若是银子用尽了，可以把你们的牲畜给我，我就为你们的牲畜给你们粮食。」
47.en: Joseph said, “Give me your livestock; and I will give you food for your livestock, if your money is gone.”

47.zh: 于是他们把牲畜赶到约瑟那里，约瑟就拿粮食换了他们的牛、羊、驴、马；那一年因换他们一切的牲畜，就用粮食养活他们。
47.en: They brought their livestock to Joseph, and Joseph gave them bread in exchange for the horses, and for the flocks, and for the herds, and for the donkeys: and he fed them with bread in exchange for all their livestock for that year.

47.zh: 那一年过去，第二年他们又来见约瑟，说：「我们不瞒我主，我们的银子都花尽了，牲畜也都归了我主。我们在我主眼前，除了我们的身体和田地之外，一无所剩。
47.en: When that year was ended, they came to him the second year, and said to him, “We will not hide from my lord how our money is all spent, and the herds of livestock are my lord’s. There is nothing left in the sight of my lord, but our bodies, and our lands.

47.zh: 你何忍见我们人死地荒呢？求你用粮食买我们和我们的地，我们和我们的地就要给法老效力。又求你给我们种子，使我们得以存活，不至死亡，地土也不至荒凉。」
47.en: Why should we die before your eyes, both we and our land? Buy us and our land for bread, and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh. Give us seed, that we may live, and not die, and that the land won’t be desolate.”

47.zh: 于是，约瑟为法老买了埃及所有的地，埃及人因被饥荒所迫，各都卖了自己的田地；那地就都归了法老。
47.en: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt for Pharaoh, for every man of the Egyptians sold his field, because the famine was severe on them, and the land became Pharaoh’s.

47.zh: 至于百姓，约瑟叫他们，从埃及这边直到埃及那边，都各归各城。
47.en: As for the people, he moved them to the cities from one end of the border of Egypt even to the other end of it.

47.zh: 惟有祭司的地，约瑟没有买，因为祭司有从法老所得的常俸。他们吃法老所给的常俸，所以他们不卖自己的地。
47.en: Only he didn’t buy the land of the priests, for the priests had a portion from Pharaoh, and ate their portion which Pharaoh gave them. That is why they didn’t sell their land.

47.zh: 约瑟对百姓说：「我今日为法老买了你们和你们的地，看哪，这里有种子给你们，你们可以种地。
47.en: Then Joseph said to the people, “Behold, I have bought you and your land today for Pharaoh. Behold, here is seed for you, and you shall sow the land.

47.zh: 后来打粮食的时候，你们要把五分之一纳给法老，四分可以归你们做地里的种子，也做你们和你们家口孩童的食物。」
47.en: It will happen at the harvests, that you shall give a fifth to Pharaoh, and four parts will be your own, for seed of the field, for your food, for them of your households, and for food for your little ones.”

47.zh: 他们说：「你救了我们的性命。但愿我们在我主眼前蒙恩，我们就作法老的仆人。」
47.en: They said, “You have saved our lives! Let us find favor in the sight of my lord, and we will be Pharaoh’s servants.”

47.zh: 于是约瑟为埃及地定下常例，直到今日：法老必得五分之一，惟独祭司的地不归法老。
47.en: Joseph made it a statute concerning the land of Egypt to this day, that Pharaoh should have the fifth. Only the land of the priests alone didn’t become Pharaoh’s.

47.zh: 以色列人住在埃及的歌珊地。他们在那里置了产业，并且生育甚多。
47.en: Israel lived in the land of Egypt, in the land of Goshen; and they got themselves possessions therein, and were fruitful, and multiplied exceedingly.

47.zh: 雅各住在埃及地十七年，雅各平生的年日是一百四十七岁。
47.en: Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were one hundred forty-seven years.

47.zh: 以色列的死期临近了，他就叫了他儿子约瑟来，说：「我若在你眼前蒙恩，请你把手放在我大腿底下，用慈爱和诚实待我，请你不要将我葬在埃及。
47.en: The time came near that Israel must die, and he called his son Joseph, and said to him, “If now I have found favor in your sight, please put your hand under my thigh, and deal kindly and truly with me. Please don’t bury me in Egypt,

47.zh: 我与我祖我父同睡的时候，你要将我带出埃及，葬在他们所葬的地方。」约瑟说：「我必遵着你的命而行。」
47.en: but when I sleep with my fathers, you shall carry me out of Egypt, and bury me in their burying place.” Joseph said, “I will do as you have said.”

47.zh: 雅各说：「你要向我起誓。」约瑟就向他起了誓，于是以色列在床头上敬拜　[神]。
47.en: Israel said, “Swear to me,” and he swore to him. Then Israel bowed himself on the bed’s head.

48.zh: 这事以后，有人告诉约瑟说：「你的父亲病了。」他就带着两个儿子玛拿西和以法莲同去。
48.en: After these things, someone said to Joseph, “Behold, your father is sick.” He took with him his two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim.

48.zh: 有人告诉雅各说：「请看，你儿子约瑟到你这里来了。」以色列就勉强在床上坐起来。
48.en: Someone told Jacob, and said, “Behold, your son Joseph comes to you,” and Israel strengthened himself, and sat on the bed.

48.zh: 雅各对约瑟说：「全能的　神曾在迦南地的路斯向我显现，赐福与我，
48.en: Jacob said to Joseph, “God Almighty appeared to me at Luz in the land of Canaan, and blessed me,

48.zh: 对我说：『我必使你生养众多，成为多民，又要把这地赐给你的后裔，永远为业。』
48.en: and said to me, ‘Behold, I will make you fruitful, and multiply you, and I will make of you a company of peoples, and will give this land to your offspring after you for an everlasting possession.’

48.zh: 我未到埃及见你之先，你在埃及地所生的以法莲和玛拿西这两个儿子是我的，正如吕便和西缅是我的一样。
48.en: Now your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came to you into Egypt, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh, even as Reuben and Simeon, will be mine.

48.zh: 你在他们以后所生的就是你的，他们可以归于他们弟兄的名下得产业。
48.en: Your offspring, whom you become the father of after them, will be yours. They will be called after the name of their brothers in their inheritance.

48.zh: 至于我，我从巴旦来的时候，拉结死在我眼前，在迦南地的路上，离以法他还有一段路程，我就把她葬在以法他的路上（以法他就是伯利恒）。」
48.en: As for me, when I came from Paddan, Rachel died beside me in the land of Canaan on the way, when there was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and I buried her there on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).”

48.zh: 以色列看见约瑟的两个儿子，就说：「这是谁？」
48.en: Israel saw Joseph’s sons, and said, “Who are these?”

48.zh: 约瑟对他父亲说：「这是　神在这里赐给我的儿子。」以色列说：「请你领他们到我跟前，我要给他们祝福。」
48.en: Joseph said to his father, “They are my sons, whom God has given me here.” He said, “Please bring them to me, and I will bless them.”

48.zh: 以色列年纪老迈，眼睛昏花，不能看见。约瑟领他们到他跟前，他就和他们亲嘴，抱着他们。
48.en: Now the eyes of Israel were dim for age, so that he couldn’t see well. Joseph brought them near to him; and he kissed them, and embraced them.

48.zh: 以色列对约瑟说：「我想不到得见你的面，不料，　神又使我得见你的儿子。」
48.en: Israel said to Joseph, “I didn’t think I would see your face, and behold, God has let me see your offspring also.”

48.zh: 约瑟把两个儿子从以色列两膝中领出来，自己就脸伏于地下拜。
48.en: Joseph brought them out from between his knees, and he bowed himself with his face to the earth.

48.zh: 随后，约瑟又拉着他们两个，以法莲在他的右手里，对着以色列的左手，玛拿西在他的左手里，对着以色列的右手，领他们到以色列的跟前。
48.en: Joseph took them both, Ephraim in his right hand toward Israel’s left hand, and Manasseh in his left hand toward Israel’s right hand, and brought them near to him.

48.zh: 以色列伸出右手来，按在以法莲的头上（以法莲乃是次子），又剪搭过左手来，按在玛拿西的头上（玛拿西原是长子）。
48.en: Israel stretched out his right hand, and laid it on Ephraim’s head, who was the younger, and his left hand on Manasseh’s head, guiding his hands knowingly, for Manasseh was the firstborn.

48.zh: 他就给约瑟祝福说：「愿我祖亚伯拉罕和我父以撒所事奉的　神，就是一生牧养我直到今日的　神，
48.en: He blessed Joseph, and said, “The God before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, the God who has fed me all my life long to this day,

48.zh: 救赎我脱离一切患难的那使者，赐福与这两个童子。愿他们归在我的名下和我祖亚伯拉罕、我父以撒的名下。又愿他们在世界中生养众多。」
48.en: the angel who has redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads, and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac. Let them grow into a multitude upon the earth.”

48.zh: 约瑟见他父亲把右手按在以法莲的头上，就不喜悦，便提起他父亲的手，要从以法莲头上挪到玛拿西的头上。
48.en: When Joseph saw that his father laid his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it displeased him. He held up his father’s hand, to remove it from Ephraim’s head to Manasseh’s head.

48.zh: 约瑟对他父亲说：「我父，不是这样。这本是长子，求你把右手按在他的头上。」
48.en: Joseph said to his father, “Not so, my father, for this is the firstborn. Put your right hand on his head.”

48.zh: 他父亲不从，说：「我知道，我儿，我知道。他也必成为一族，也必昌大。只是他的兄弟将来比他还大；他兄弟的后裔要成为多族。」
48.en: His father refused, and said, “I know, my son, I know. He also will become a people, and he also will be great. However, his younger brother will be greater than he, and his offspring will become a multitude of nations.”

48.zh: 当日就给他们祝福说：「以色列人要指着你们祝福说：『愿　神使你如以法莲、玛拿西一样。』」于是立以法莲在玛拿西以上。
48.en: He blessed them that day, saying, “Israel will bless in your name, saying, ‘God make you as Ephraim and as Manasseh’” He set Ephraim before Manasseh.

48.zh: 以色列又对约瑟说：「我要死了，但　神必与你们同在，领你们回到你们列祖之地。
48.en: Israel said to Joseph, “Behold, I am dying, but God will be with you, and bring you again to the land of your fathers.

48.zh: 并且我从前用弓用刀从亚摩利人手下夺的那块地，我都赐给你，使你比众弟兄多得一分。」
48.en: Moreover I have given to you one portion above your brothers, which I took out of the hand of the Amorite with my sword and with my bow.”

49.zh: 雅各叫了他的儿子们来，说：「你们都来聚集，我好把你们日后必遇的事告诉你们。
49.en: Jacob called to his sons, and said: “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which will happen to you in the days to come.

49.zh: 雅各的儿子们，你们要聚集而听， 要听你们父亲以色列的话。
49.en: Assemble yourselves, and hear, you sons of Jacob. Listen to Israel, your father.

49.zh: 吕便哪，你是我的长子， 是我力量强壮的时候生的， 本当大有尊荣，权力超众。
49.en: “Reuben, you are my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, excelling in dignity, and excelling in power.

49.zh: 但你[放纵情欲，]滚沸如水， 必不得居首位； 因为你上了你父亲的床， 污秽了我的榻。
49.en: Boiling over like water, you shall not excel, because you went up to your father’s bed, then defiled it. He went up to my couch.

49.zh: 西缅和利未是弟兄； 他们的刀剑是残忍的器具。
49.en: “Simeon and Levi are brothers. Their swords are weapons of violence.

49.zh: 我的灵啊，不要与他们同谋； 我的心哪，不要与他们联络； 因为他们趁怒杀害人命， 任意砍断牛腿大筋。
49.en: My soul, don’t come into their council. My glory, don’t be united to their assembly; for in their anger they killed men. In their self-will they hamstrung cattle.

49.zh: 他们的怒气暴烈可咒； 他们的忿恨残忍可诅。 我要使他们分居在雅各[家里]， 散住在以色列[地中]。
49.en: Cursed be their anger, for it was fierce; and their wrath, for it was cruel. I will divide them in Jacob, and scatter them in Israel.

49.zh: 犹大啊，你弟兄们必赞美你； 你手必掐住仇敌的颈项； 你父亲的儿子们必向你下拜。
49.en: “Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down before you.

49.zh: 犹大是个小狮子； 我儿啊，你抓了食便上去。 你屈下身去，卧如公狮， 蹲如母狮，谁敢惹你？
49.en: Judah is a lion’s cub. From the prey, my son, you have gone up. He stooped down, he crouched as a lion, as a lioness. Who will rouse him up?

49.zh: 圭必不离犹大， 杖必不离他两脚之间， 直等细罗来到， 万民都必归顺。
49.en: The scepter will not depart from Judah, nor the ruler’s staff from between his feet, until he comes to whom it belongs. The obedience of the peoples will be to him.

49.zh: 犹大把小驴拴在葡萄树上， 把驴驹拴在美好的葡萄树上。 他在葡萄酒中洗了衣服， 在葡萄汁中洗了袍褂。
49.en: Binding his foal to the vine, his donkey’s colt to the choice vine, he has washed his garments in wine, his robes in the blood of grapes.

49.zh: 他的眼睛必因酒红润； 他的牙齿必因奶白亮。
49.en: His eyes will be red with wine, his teeth white with milk.

49.zh: 西布伦必住在海口， 必成为停船的海口； 他的境界必延到西顿。
49.en: “Zebulun will dwell at the haven of the sea. He will be for a haven of ships. His border will be on Sidon.

49.zh: 以萨迦是个强壮的驴， 卧在羊圈之中。
49.en: “Issachar is a strong donkey, lying down between the saddlebags.

49.zh: 他以安静为佳，以肥地为美， 便低肩背重，成为服苦的仆人。
49.en: He saw a resting place, that it was good, the land, that it was pleasant. He bows his shoulder to the burden, and becomes a servant doing forced labor.

49.zh: 但必判断他的民， 作以色列支派之一。
49.en: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.

49.zh: 但必作道上的蛇，路中的虺， 咬伤马蹄，使骑马的坠落于后。
49.en: Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls backward.

49.zh: 耶和华啊，我向来等候你的救恩。
49.en: I have waited for your salvation, LORD.

49.zh: 迦得必被敌军追逼， 他却要追逼他们的脚跟。
49.en: “A troop will press on Gad, but he will press on their heel.

49.zh: 亚设之地必出肥美的粮食， 且出君王的美味。
49.en: “Asher’s food will be rich. He will produce royal dainties.

49.zh: 拿弗他利是被释放的母鹿； 他出嘉美的言语。
49.en: “Naphtali is a doe set free, who bears beautiful fawns.

49.zh: 约瑟是多结果子的树枝， 是泉旁多结果的枝子； 他的枝条探出墙外。
49.en: “Joseph is a fruitful vine, a fruitful vine by a spring. His branches run over the wall.

49.zh: 弓箭手将他苦害， 向他射箭，逼迫他。
49.en: The archers have severely grieved him, shot at him, and persecuted him:

49.zh: 但他的弓仍旧坚硬； 他的手健壮敏捷。 这是因以色列的牧者，以色列的磐石— 就是雅各的大能者。
49.en: But his bow remained strong. The arms of his hands were made strong, by the hands of the Mighty One of Jacob, (from there is the shepherd, the stone of Israel),

49.zh: 你父亲的　神必帮助你； 那全能者必将天上所有的福， 地里所藏的福，以及生产乳养的福，都赐给你。
49.en: even by the God of your father, who will help you, by the Almighty, who will bless you, with blessings of heaven above, blessings of the deep that lies below, blessings of the breasts, and of the womb.

49.zh: 你父亲所祝的福 胜过我祖先所祝的福， 如永世的山岭，至极的边界； 这些福必降在约瑟的头上， 临到那与弟兄迥别之人的顶上。
49.en: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of my ancestors, above the boundaries of the ancient hills. They will be on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who is separated from his brothers.

49.zh: 便雅悯是个撕掠的狼， 早晨要吃他所抓的， 晚上要分他所夺的。」
49.en: “Benjamin is a ravenous wolf. In the morning he will devour the prey. At evening he will divide the plunder.”

49.zh: 这一切是以色列的十二支派；这也是他们的父亲对他们所说的话，为他们所祝的福，都是按着各人的福分为他们祝福。
49.en: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel, and this is what their father spoke to them, and blessed them. He blessed everyone according to his own blessing.

49.zh: 他又嘱咐他们说：「我将要归到我列祖那里，你们要将我葬在赫人以弗 田间的洞里，与我祖我父在一处，
49.en: He instructed them, and said to them, “I am to be gathered to my people. Bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

49.zh: 就是在迦南地幔利前、麦比拉田间的洞；那洞和田是亚伯拉罕向赫人以弗 买来为业，作坟地的。
49.en: in the cave that is in the field of Machpelah, which is before Mamre, in the land of Canaan, which Abraham bought with the field from Ephron the Hittite as a burial place.

49.zh: 他们在那里葬了亚伯拉罕和他妻子撒拉，又在那里葬了以撒和他的妻子利百加；我也在那里葬了利亚。
49.en: There they buried Abraham and Sarah, his wife. There they buried Isaac and Rebekah, his wife, and there I buried Leah:

49.zh: 那块田和田间的洞原是向赫人买的。」
49.en: the field and the cave that is therein, which was purchased from the children of Heth.”

49.zh: 雅各嘱咐众子已毕，就把脚收在床上，气绝而死，归他列祖那里去了。
49.en: When Jacob finished charging his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, breathed his last breath, and was gathered to his people.

50.zh: 约瑟伏在他父亲的面上哀哭，与他亲嘴。
50.en: Joseph fell on his father’s face, wept on him, and kissed him.

50.zh: 约瑟吩咐伺候他的医生用香料薰他父亲，医生就用香料薰了以色列。
50.en: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father; and the physicians embalmed Israel.

50.zh: 薰尸的常例是四十天；那四十天满了，埃及人为他哀哭了七十天。
50.en: Forty days were used for him, for that is how many days it takes to embalm. The Egyptians wept for Israel for seventy days.

50.zh: 为他哀哭的日子过了，约瑟对法老家中的人说：「我若在你们眼前蒙恩，请你们报告法老说：
50.en: When the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph spoke to Pharaoh’s staff, saying, “If now I have found favor in your eyes, please speak in the ears of Pharaoh, saying,

50.zh: 『我父亲要死的时候叫我起誓说：你要将我葬在迦南地，在我为自己所掘的坟墓里。』现在求你让我上去葬我父亲，以后我必回来。」
50.en: ‘My father made me swear, saying, “Behold, I am dying. Bury me in my grave which I have dug for myself in the land of Canaan.” Now therefore, please let me go up and bury my father, and I will come again.’”

50.zh: 法老说：「你可以上去，照着你父亲叫你起的誓，将他葬埋。」
50.en: Pharaoh said, “Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear.”

50.zh: 于是约瑟上去葬他父亲。与他一同上去的，有法老的臣仆和法老家中的长老，并埃及国的长老，
50.en: Joseph went up to bury his father; and with him went up all the servants of Pharaoh, the elders of his house, all the elders of the land of Egypt,

50.zh: 还有约瑟的全家和他的弟兄们，并他父亲的眷属；只有他们的[妇人]孩子，和羊群牛群，都留在歌珊地。
50.en: all the house of Joseph, his brothers, and his father’s house. Only their little ones, their flocks, and their herds, they left in the land of Goshen.

50.zh: 又有车辆马兵，和他一同上去；那一帮人甚多。
50.en: Both chariots and horsemen went up with him. It was a very great company.

50.zh: 他们到了约旦河外、亚达的禾场，就在那里大大地号咷痛哭。约瑟为他父亲哀哭了七天。
50.en: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, which is beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented with a very great and severe lamentation. He mourned for his father seven days.

50.zh: 迦南的居民见亚达禾场上的哀哭，就说：「这是埃及人一场极大的哀哭。」因此那地方名叫亚伯·麦西，是在约旦河东。
50.en: When the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, saw the mourning in the floor of Atad, they said, “This is a grievous mourning by the Egyptians.” Therefore its name was called Abel Mizraim, which is beyond the Jordan.

50.zh: 雅各的儿子们就遵着他父亲所吩咐的办了，
50.en: His sons did to him just as he commanded them,

50.zh: 把他搬到迦南地，葬在幔利前、麦比拉田间的洞里；那洞和田是亚伯拉罕向赫人以弗 买来为业，作坟地的。
50.en: for his sons carried him into the land of Canaan, and buried him in the cave of the field of Machpelah, which Abraham bought with the field, as a possession for a burial site, from Ephron the Hittite, near Mamre.

50.zh: 约瑟葬了他父亲以后，就和众弟兄，并一切同他上去葬他父亲的人，都回埃及去了。
50.en: Joseph returned into Egypt—he, and his brothers, and all that went up with him to bury his father, after he had buried his father.

50.zh: 约瑟的哥哥们见父亲死了，就说：「或者约瑟怀恨我们，照着我们从前待他一切的恶足足地报复我们。」
50.en: When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all the evil which we did to him.”

50.zh: 他们就打发人去见约瑟，说：「你父亲未死以先吩咐说：
50.en: They sent a message to Joseph, saying, “Your father commanded before he died, saying,

50.zh: 『你们要对约瑟这样说：从前你哥哥们恶待你，求你饶恕他们的过犯和罪恶。』如今求你饶恕你父亲　神之仆人的过犯。」他们对约瑟说这话，约瑟就哭了。
50.en: ‘You shall tell Joseph, “Now please forgive the disobedience of your brothers, and their sin, because they did evil to you.”’ Now, please forgive the disobedience of the servants of the God of your father.” Joseph wept when they spoke to him.

50.zh: 他的哥哥们又来俯伏在他面前，说：「我们是你的仆人。」
50.en: His brothers also went and fell down before his face; and they said, “Behold, we are your servants.”

50.zh: 约瑟对他们说：「不要害怕，我岂能代替　神呢？
50.en: Joseph said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for am I in the place of God?

50.zh: 从前你们的意思是要害我，但　神的意思原是好的，要保全许多人的性命，成就今日的光景。
50.en: As for you, you meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive, as is happening today.

50.zh: 现在你们不要害怕，我必养活你们和你们的[妇人]孩子。」于是约瑟用亲爱的话安慰他们。
50.en: Now therefore don’t be afraid. I will provide for you and your little ones.” He comforted them, and spoke kindly to them.

50.zh: 约瑟和他父亲的眷属都住在埃及。约瑟活了一百一十岁。
50.en: Joseph lived in Egypt, he, and his father’s house. Joseph lived one hundred ten years.

50.zh: 约瑟得见以法莲第三代的子孙。玛拿西的孙子、玛吉的儿子也养在约瑟的膝上。
50.en: Joseph saw Ephraim’s children to the third generation. The children also of Machir, the son of Manasseh, were born on Joseph’s knees.

50.zh: 约瑟对他弟兄们说：「我要死了，但　神必定看顾你们，领你们从这地上去，到他起誓所应许给亚伯拉罕、以撒、雅各之地。」
50.en: Joseph said to his brothers, “I am dying, but God will surely visit you, and bring you up out of this land to the land which he swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.”

50.zh: 约瑟叫以色列的子孙起誓说：「　神必定看顾你们；你们要把我的骸骨从这里搬上去。」
50.en: Joseph took an oath from the children of Israel, saying, “God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here.”

50.zh: 约瑟死了，正一百一十岁。人用香料将他薰了，把他收殓在棺材里，停在埃及。
50.en: So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.
